<file path=".agent/skills/brand-identity/resources/tech-stack.md">
# Preferred Tech Stack & Implementation Rules

When generating code or UI components for this brand, you **MUST** strictly adhere to the following technology choices.

## Core Stack
* **Framework:** Expo/React Native (TypeScript preferred)
* **Styling Engine:** Tailwind CSS / NativeWind (Mandatory. Do not use plain CSS or styled-components unless explicitly asked.)
* **Component Library:** Custom primitives or shadcn-inspired components for React Native.
* **Icons:** Lucide React / Lucide React Native

## Implementation Guidelines

### 1. Tailwind Usage
* Use utility classes directly in `className` (via NativeWind).
* Utilize the color tokens defined in `design-tokens.json` (e.g., use `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` instead of hardcoded hex values).
* **Dark Mode:** Support dark mode using Tailwind's `dark:` variant modifier.

### 2. Component Patterns
* **Buttons:** Primary actions must use the solid Primary color. Secondary actions should use the 'Ghost' or 'Outline' variants.
* **Forms:** Labels must always be placed *above* input fields. Use standard Tailwind spacing (e.g., `gap-4` between form items).
* **Layout:** Use Flexbox via Tailwind/NativeWind utilities for all layout structures.

### 3. Forbidden Patterns
* Do NOT use jQuery.
* Do NOT use Bootstrap classes.
* Do NOT create new CSS files; keep styles located within component files via Tailwind.
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/brand-identity/resources/voice-tone.md">
# Copywriting: Voice & Tone Guidelines

When generating text, adhere to this brand persona.

## Brand Personality Keywords
* Professional but approachable
* Direct and efficient
* Tech-savvy but jargon-free
* Empathetic (Teacher-focused)

## Grammar & Mechanics rules
* **Headings:** Use Title Case for main headings (H1, H2). Use sentence case for subheadings (H3+).
* **Punctuation:** Avoid exclamation points (!) in standard interface copy. Use periods for complete sentences.
* **Clarity:** Prefer active voice over passive voice. Keep sentences concise.

## Terminology Guide

| Do Not Use | Use Instead |
| :--- | :--- |
| "Utilize" | "Use" |
| "In order to..." | "To..." |
| "User" | "Student" or "Teacher" |
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/aggregation.md">
### Pattern 2: Error Aggregation

Collect multiple errors instead of failing on first error.

```typescript
class ErrorCollector {
  private errors: Error[] = [];

  add(error: Error): void {
    this.errors.push(error);
  }

  hasErrors(): boolean {
    return this.errors.length > 0;
  }

  getErrors(): Error[] {
    return [...this.errors];
  }

  throw(): never {
    if (this.errors.length === 1) {
      throw this.errors[0];
    }
    throw new AggregateError(
      this.errors,
      `${this.errors.length} errors occurred`,
    );
  }
}

// Usage: Validate multiple fields
function validateUser(data: any): User {
  const errors = new ErrorCollector();

  if (!data.email) {
    errors.add(new ValidationError("Email is required"));
  } else if (!isValidEmail(data.email)) {
    errors.add(new ValidationError("Email is invalid"));
  }

  if (!data.name || data.name.length < 2) {
    errors.add(new ValidationError("Name must be at least 2 characters"));
  }

  if (!data.age || data.age < 18) {
    errors.add(new ValidationError("Age must be 18 or older"));
  }

  if (errors.hasErrors()) {
    errors.throw();
  }

  return data as User;
}
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/circuit-breaker.md">
### Pattern 1: Circuit Breaker

Prevent cascading failures in distributed systems.

```python
from enum import Enum
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Callable, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')

class CircuitState(Enum):
    CLOSED = "closed"       # Normal operation
    OPEN = "open"          # Failing, reject requests
    HALF_OPEN = "half_open"  # Testing if recovered

class CircuitBreaker:
    def __init__(
        self,
        failure_threshold: int = 5,
        timeout: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=60),
        success_threshold: int = 2
    ):
        self.failure_threshold = failure_threshold
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.success_threshold = success_threshold
        self.failure_count = 0
        self.success_count = 0
        self.state = CircuitState.CLOSED
        self.last_failure_time = None

    def call(self, func: Callable[[], T]) -> T:
        if self.state == CircuitState.OPEN:
            if datetime.now() - self.last_failure_time > self.timeout:
                self.state = CircuitState.HALF_OPEN
                self.success_count = 0
            else:
                raise Exception("Circuit breaker is OPEN")

        try:
            result = func()
            self.on_success()
            return result
        except Exception as e:
            self.on_failure()
            raise

    def on_success(self):
        self.failure_count = 0
        if self.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN:
            self.success_count += 1
            if self.success_count >= self.success_threshold:
                self.state = CircuitState.CLOSED
                self.success_count = 0

    def on_failure(self):
        self.failure_count += 1
        self.last_failure_time = datetime.now()
        if self.failure_count >= self.failure_threshold:
            self.state = CircuitState.OPEN

# Usage
circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker()

def fetch_data():
    return circuit_breaker.call(lambda: external_api.get_data())
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/degradation.md">
### Pattern 3: Graceful Degradation

Provide fallback functionality when errors occur.

```python
from typing import Optional, Callable, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')

def with_fallback(
    primary: Callable[[], T],
    fallback: Callable[[], T],
    log_error: bool = True
) -> T:
    """Try primary function, fall back to fallback on error."""
    try:
        return primary()
    except Exception as e:
        if log_error:
            logger.error(f"Primary function failed: {e}")
        return fallback()

# Usage
def get_user_profile(user_id: str) -> UserProfile:
    return with_fallback(
        primary=lambda: fetch_from_cache(user_id),
        fallback=lambda: fetch_from_database(user_id)
    )

# Multiple fallbacks
def get_exchange_rate(currency: str) -> float:
    return (
        try_function(lambda: api_provider_1.get_rate(currency))
        or try_function(lambda: api_provider_2.get_rate(currency))
        or try_function(lambda: cache.get_rate(currency))
        or DEFAULT_RATE
    )

def try_function(func: Callable[[], Optional[T]]) -> Optional[T]:
    try:
        return func()
    except Exception:
        return None
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/go.md">
### Go Error Handling

**Explicit Error Returns:**

```go
// Basic error handling
func getUser(id string) (*User, error) {
    user, err := db.QueryUser(id)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to query user: %w", err)
    }
    if user == nil {
        return nil, errors.New("user not found")
    }
    return user, nil
}

// Custom error types
type ValidationError struct {
    Field   string
    Message string
}

func (e *ValidationError) Error() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("validation failed for %s: %s", e.Field, e.Message)
}

// Sentinel errors for comparison
var (
    ErrNotFound     = errors.New("not found")
    ErrUnauthorized = errors.New("unauthorized")
    ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("invalid input")
)

// Error checking
user, err := getUser("123")
if err != nil {
    if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
        // Handle not found
    } else {
        // Handle other errors
    }
}

// Error wrapping and unwrapping
func processUser(id string) error {
    user, err := getUser(id)
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("process user failed: %w", err)
    }
    // Process user
    return nil
}

// Unwrap errors
err := processUser("123")
if err != nil {
    var valErr *ValidationError
    if errors.As(err, &valErr) {
        fmt.Printf("Validation error: %s\n", valErr.Field)
    }
}
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/python.md">
### Python Error Handling

**Custom Exception Hierarchy:**

```python
class ApplicationError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all application errors."""
    def __init__(self, message: str, code: str = None, details: dict = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.details = details or {}
        self.timestamp = datetime.utcnow()

class ValidationError(ApplicationError):
    """Raised when validation fails."""
    pass

class NotFoundError(ApplicationError):
    """Raised when resource not found."""
    pass

class ExternalServiceError(ApplicationError):
    """Raised when external service fails."""
    def __init__(self, message: str, service: str, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(message, **kwargs)
        self.service = service

# Usage
def get_user(user_id: str) -> User:
    user = db.query(User).filter_by(id=user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise NotFoundError(
            f"User not found",
            code="USER_NOT_FOUND",
            details={"user_id": user_id}
        )
    return user
```

**Context Managers for Cleanup:**

```python
from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def database_transaction(session):
    """Ensure transaction is committed or rolled back."""
    try:
        yield session
        session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()

# Usage
with database_transaction(db.session) as session:
    user = User(name="Alice")
    session.add(user)
    # Automatic commit or rollback
```

**Retry with Exponential Backoff:**

```python
import time
from functools import wraps
from typing import TypeVar, Callable

T = TypeVar('T')

def retry(
    max_attempts: int = 3,
    backoff_factor: float = 2.0,
    exceptions: tuple = (Exception,)
):
    """Retry decorator with exponential backoff."""
    def decorator(func: Callable[..., T]) -> Callable[..., T]:
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs) -> T:
            last_exception = None
            for attempt in range(max_attempts):
                try:
                    return func(*args, **kwargs)
                except exceptions as e:
                    last_exception = e
                    if attempt < max_attempts - 1:
                        sleep_time = backoff_factor ** attempt
                        time.sleep(sleep_time)
                        continue
                    raise
            raise last_exception
        return wrapper
    return decorator

# Usage
@retry(max_attempts=3, exceptions=(NetworkError,))
def fetch_data(url: str) -> dict:
    response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/rust.md">
### Rust Error Handling

**Result and Option Types:**

```rust
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{self, Read};

// Result type for operations that can fail
fn read_file(path: &str) -> Result<String, io::Error> {
    let mut file = File::open(path)?;  // ? operator propagates errors
    let mut contents = String::new();
    file.read_to_string(&mut contents)?;
    Ok(contents)
}

// Custom error types
#[derive(Debug)]
enum AppError {
    Io(io::Error),
    Parse(std::num::ParseIntError),
    NotFound(String),
    Validation(String),
}

impl From<io::Error> for AppError {
    fn from(error: io::Error) -> Self {
        AppError::Io(error)
    }
}

// Using custom error type
fn read_number_from_file(path: &str) -> Result<i32, AppError> {
    let contents = read_file(path)?;  // Auto-converts io::Error
    let number = contents.trim().parse()
        .map_err(AppError::Parse)?;   // Explicitly convert ParseIntError
    Ok(number)
}

// Option for nullable values
fn find_user(id: &str) -> Option<User> {
    users.iter().find(|u| u.id == id).cloned()
}

// Combining Option and Result
fn get_user_age(id: &str) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    find_user(id)
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::NotFound(id.to_string()))
        .map(|user| user.age)
}
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/resources/typescript.md">
### TypeScript/JavaScript Error Handling

**Custom Error Classes:**

```typescript
// Custom error classes
class ApplicationError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public code: string,
    public statusCode: number = 500,
    public details?: Record<string, any>,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = this.constructor.name;
    Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
  }
}

class ValidationError extends ApplicationError {
  constructor(message: string, details?: Record<string, any>) {
    super(message, "VALIDATION_ERROR", 400, details);
  }
}

class NotFoundError extends ApplicationError {
  constructor(resource: string, id: string) {
    super(`${resource} not found`, "NOT_FOUND", 404, { resource, id });
  }
}

// Usage
function getUser(id: string): User {
  const user = users.find((u) => u.id === id);
  if (!user) {
    throw new NotFoundError("User", id);
  }
  return user;
}
```

**Result Type Pattern:**

```typescript
// Result type for explicit error handling
type Result<T, E = Error> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E };

// Helper functions
function Ok<T>(value: T): Result<T, never> {
  return { ok: true, value };
}

function Err<E>(error: E): Result<never, E> {
  return { ok: false, error };
}

// Usage
function parseJSON<T>(json: string): Result<T, SyntaxError> {
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(json) as T;
    return Ok(value);
  } catch (error) {
    return Err(error as SyntaxError);
  }
}

// Consuming Result
const result = parseJSON<User>(userJson);
if (result.ok) {
  console.log(result.value.name);
} else {
  console.error("Parse failed:", result.error.message);
}

// Chaining Results
function chain<T, U, E>(
  result: Result<T, E>,
  fn: (value: T) => Result<U, E>,
): Result<U, E> {
  return result.ok ? fn(result.value) : result;
}
```

**Async Error Handling:**

```typescript
// Async/await with proper error handling
async function fetchUserOrders(userId: string): Promise<Order[]> {
  try {
    const user = await getUser(userId);
    const orders = await getOrders(user.id);
    return orders;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
      return []; // Return empty array for not found
    }
    if (error instanceof NetworkError) {
      // Retry logic
      return retryFetchOrders(userId);
    }
    // Re-throw unexpected errors
    throw error;
  }
}

// Promise error handling
function fetchData(url: string): Promise<Data> {
  return fetch(url)
    .then((response) => {
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new NetworkError(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error("Fetch failed:", error);
      throw error;
    });
}
```
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/error-handling-patterns/SKILL.md">
---
name: error-handling-patterns
description: Master error handling patterns across languages including exceptions, Result types, error propagation, and graceful degradation to build resilient applications. Use when implementing error handling, designing APIs, or improving application reliability.
---

# Error Handling Patterns

Build resilient applications with robust error handling strategies that gracefully handle failures and provide excellent debugging experiences.

## When to Use This Skill

- Implementing error handling in new features
- Designing error-resilient APIs
- Debugging production issues
- Improving application reliability
- Creating better error messages for users and developers
- Implementing retry and circuit breaker patterns
- Handling async/concurrent errors
- Building fault-tolerant distributed systems

## Core Concepts

### 1. Error Handling Philosophies

**Exceptions vs Result Types:**

- **Exceptions**: Traditional try-catch, disrupts control flow
- **Result Types**: Explicit success/failure, functional approach
- **Error Codes**: C-style, requires discipline
- **Option/Maybe Types**: For nullable values

**When to Use Each:**

- Exceptions: Unexpected errors, exceptional conditions
- Result Types: Expected errors, validation failures
- Panics/Crashes: Unrecoverable errors, programming bugs

### 2. Error Categories

**Recoverable Errors:**

- Network timeouts
- Missing files
- Invalid user input
- API rate limits

**Unrecoverable Errors:**

- Out of memory
- Stack overflow
- Programming bugs (null pointer, etc.)

## Language-Specific Patterns

### Python Error Handling
See [python.md](resources/python.md) for custom exception hierarchies, context managers, and retry decorators.

### TypeScript/JavaScript Error Handling
See [typescript.md](resources/typescript.md) for custom error classes, Result types, and async error handling patterns.

### Rust Error Handling
See [rust.md](resources/rust.md) for Result/Option types and propagation patterns.

### Go Error Handling
See [go.md](resources/go.md) for explicit error returns and wrapping.

## Universal Patterns

### Pattern 1: Circuit Breaker
Prevent cascading failures in distributed systems. See [circuit-breaker.md](resources/circuit-breaker.md).

### Pattern 2: Error Aggregation
Collect multiple errors instead of failing on first error. See [aggregation.md](resources/aggregation.md).

### Pattern 3: Graceful Degradation
Provide fallback functionality when errors occur. See [degradation.md](resources/degradation.md).

## Best Practices

1. **Fail Fast**: Validate input early, fail quickly
2. **Preserve Context**: Include stack traces, metadata, timestamps
3. **Meaningful Messages**: Explain what happened and how to fix it
4. **Log Appropriately**: Error = log, expected failure = don't spam logs
5. **Handle at Right Level**: Catch where you can meaningfully handle
6. **Clean Up Resources**: Use try-finally, context managers, defer
7. **Don't Swallow Errors**: Log or re-throw, don't silently ignore
8. **Type-Safe Errors**: Use typed errors when possible

## Common Pitfalls

- **Catching Too Broadly**: `except Exception` hides bugs
- **Empty Catch Blocks**: Silently swallowing errors
- **Logging and Re-throwing**: Creates duplicate log entries
- **Not Cleaning Up**: Forgetting to close files, connections
- **Poor Error Messages**: "Error occurred" is not helpful
- **Returning Error Codes**: Use exceptions or Result types
- **Ignoring Async Errors**: Unhandled promise rejections

## Resources

- [Exception Hierarchy Design](resources/exception-hierarchy-design.md)
- [Error Recovery Strategies](resources/error-recovery-strategies.md)
- [Async Error Handling](resources/async-error-handling.md)
- [Error Handling Checklist](resources/error-handling-checklist.md)
- [Error Message Guide](resources/error-message-guide.md)
- [Error Analyzer Script](scripts/error-analyzer.py)
</file>

<file path=".agent/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md">
---
name: reviewing-code
description: Performs comprehensive code reviews for pull requests or specific files. Use when the user asks for a code review, feedback on a PR, or to check for best practices and potential bugs.
---

# Reviewing Code

## When to use this skill
- When the user submits code for review.
- Before merging a feature branch.
- When searching for architectural inconsistencies or performance bottlenecks.

## Workflow
1. [ ] Analyze the scope of changes (diffs or specific files).
2. [ ] Identify architectural patterns and verify compliance.
3. [ ] Check for common pitfalls (security, performance, edge cases).
4. [ ] Provide a structured feedback report with actionable suggestions.
5. [ ] (Optional) Apply suggested fixes if requested by the user.

## Instructions

### 1. Analysis Phase
- Use `git diff` to understand the context of the changes if in a git repository.
- Review `tsconfig.json` or project-specific config files to understand strictness levels.

### 2. Review Criteria
- **Patterns**: Verify usage of established project patterns (e.g., Tailwind classes, React hooks, service layers).
- **Security**: Look for hardcoded secrets, lack of input validation, or unsafe data handling.
- **Performance**: Identify unnecessary re-renders, slow database queries, or inefficient loops.

### 3. Feedback Format
Keep feedback concise and actionable. Use code blocks for suggested improvements:

```typescript
// Prefer:
const data = useMemo(() => compute(items), [items]);

// Instead of:
const data = compute(items); // Re-computes on every render
```

## Resources
- [review.sh](scripts/review.sh) - A script for automated linting and static analysis.
</file>

<file path=".agent/skill-creator-instructions.md">
# Antigravity Skill Creator System Instructions
You are an expert developer specializing in creating "Skills" for the Antigravity agent environment. Your goal is to generate high-quality, predictable, and efficient `.agent/skills/` directories based on user requirements.

## 1. Core Structural Requirements
Every skill you generate must follow this folder hierarchy:
- `<skill-name>/`
    - `SKILL.md` (Required: Main logic and instructions)
    - `scripts/` (Optional: Helper scripts)
    - `examples/` (Optional: Reference implementations)
    - `resources/` (Optional: Templates or assets)

## 2. YAML Frontmatter Standards
The `SKILL.md` must start with YAML frontmatter following these strict rules:
- **name**: Gerund form (e.g., `testing-code`, `managing-databases`). Max 64 chars. Lowercase, numbers, and hyphens only. No "claude" or "anthropic" in the name.
- **description**: Written in **third person**. Must include specific triggers/keywords. Max 1024 chars. (e.g., "Extracts text from PDFs. Use when the user mentions document processing or PDF files.")

## 3. Writing Principles (The "Claude Way")
When writing the body of `SKILL.md`, adhere to these best practices:

* **Conciseness**: Assume the agent is smart. Do not explain what a PDF or a Git repo is. Focus only on the unique logic of the skill.
* **Progressive Disclosure**: Keep `SKILL.md` under 500 lines. If more detail is needed, link to secondary files (e.g., `[See ADVANCED.md](ADVANCED.md)`) only one level deep.
* **Forward Slashes**: Always use `/` for paths, never `\`.
* **Degrees of Freedom**: 
    - Use **Bullet Points** for high-freedom tasks (heuristics).
    - Use **Code Blocks** for medium-freedom (templates).
    - Use **Specific Bash Commands** for low-freedom (fragile operations).

## 4. Workflow & Feedback Loops
For complex tasks, include:
1.  **Checklists**: A markdown checklist the agent can copy and update to track state.
2.  **Validation Loops**: A "Plan-Validate-Execute" pattern. (e.g., Run a script to check a config file BEFORE applying changes).
3.  **Error Handling**: Instructions for scripts should be "black boxes"—tell the agent to run `--help` if they are unsure.

## 5. Output Template
When asked to create a skill, output the result in this format:

### [Folder Name]
**Path:** `.agent/skills/[skill-name]/`

### [SKILL.md]
```markdown
---
name: [gerund-name]
description: [3rd-person description]
---

# [Skill Title]

## When to use this skill
- [Trigger 1]
- [Trigger 2]

## Workflow
[Insert checklist or step-by-step guide here]

## Instructions
[Specific logic, code snippets, or rules]

## Resources
- [Link to scripts/ or resources/]
[Supporting Files]
(If applicable, provide the content for scripts/ or examples/)
```
</file>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator, FlatList } from 'react-native';
import { TeacherService, TeacherStats, StudentActivity, TeamActivity } from '@/lib/teacher';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function AnalyticsScreen() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<TeacherStats | null>(null);
  const [studentActivity, setStudentActivity] = useState<StudentActivity[]>([]);
  const [teamActivity, setTeamActivity] = useState<TeamActivity[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const [statsData, students, teams] = await Promise.all([
        TeacherService.getStats(),
        TeacherService.getStudentActivity(),
        TeacherService.getTeamActivity()
      ]);
      setStats(statsData);
      setStudentActivity(students);
      setTeamActivity(teams);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.center, { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Theme.colors.accent} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>PERFORMANCE REPORTS</Text>
      
      {/* Student Activity Log */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>STUDENT ACTIVITY LOG</Text>
          <View style={styles.tableHeader}>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 2 }]}>STUDENT</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 2 }]}>CONTEST</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 1, textAlign: 'right' }]}>SCORE</Text>
          </View>
          {studentActivity.map((item) => (
            <View key={item.id} style={styles.activityEntry}>
              <View style={styles.tableRow}>
                <View style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.rowTextMain}>{item.studentName}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.rowTextSub}>{item.date}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 2, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.rowText}>{item.contest}</Text>
                  <View style={[styles.badge, item.type === 'contest' ? styles.contestBadge : styles.practiceBadge]}>
                    <Text style={styles.badgeText}>{item.type.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
                <Text style={[
                  styles.rowText, 
                  { flex: 1, textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: '800' },
                  item.score >= 90 ? { color: '#4CAF50' } : item.score < 80 ? { color: '#F44336' } : { color: Theme.colors.accent }
                ]}>
                  {item.score}%
                </Text>
              </View>
              {item.parts && (
                <View style={styles.partScoresList}>
                  {item.parts.map((part, idx) => (
                    <View key={idx} style={styles.partRow}>
                      <Text style={styles.partName}>{part.name.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.partScore}>{part.score}%</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Team Activity Log */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>TEAM PERFORMANCE (GROUPS)</Text>
          <View style={styles.tableHeader}>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 2 }]}>TEAM/GROUP</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 2 }]}>CONTEST</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.columnHeader, { flex: 1, textAlign: 'right' }]}>SCORE</Text>
          </View>
          {teamActivity.map((item) => (
            <View key={item.id} style={styles.activityEntry}>
              <View style={styles.tableRow}>
                <View style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.rowTextMain}>{item.teamName}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.rowTextSub}>{item.date}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 2, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.rowText}>{item.contest}</Text>
                  <View style={[styles.badge, item.type === 'contest' ? styles.contestBadge : styles.practiceBadge]}>
                    <Text style={styles.badgeText}>{item.type.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
                <Text style={[styles.rowText, { flex: 1, textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: '800', color: Theme.colors.accent }]}>
                  {item.score}%
                </Text>
              </View>
              {item.parts && (
                <View style={styles.partScoresList}>
                  {item.parts.map((part, idx) => (
                    <View key={idx} style={styles.partRow}>
                      <Text style={styles.partName}>{part.name.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.partScore}>{part.score}%</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>CLASSROOM PERFORMANCE</Text>
          <View style={styles.mockChart}>
            <View style={[styles.bar, { height: '60%' }]} />
            <View style={[styles.bar, { height: '80%', backgroundColor: Theme.colors.accent }]} />
            <View style={[styles.bar, { height: '40%' }]} />
            <View style={[styles.bar, { height: '90%', backgroundColor: '#00f2ff' }]} />
            <View style={[styles.bar, { height: '70%' }]} />
          </View>
        </View>
      </motion.div>

      <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>ENGAGEMENT STATS</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={styles.stat}>
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>85%</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>PARTICIPATION</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.stat}>
             <Text style={styles.statValue}>12h</Text>
             <Text style={styles.statLabel}>AVG. PRACTICE</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

<file path="app/(admin)/assessments.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, Alert, ScrollView, Modal, SectionList, TextInput } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { TeacherService, Assessment, AssessmentQuestion } from '@/lib/teacher';
import { generateQuizQuestions } from '@/lib/senior-quiz';
import { ALL_CONTESTS } from '@/constants/contests';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
// import { SectionList, TextInput, ViewToken } from 'react-native'; // This line is now redundant as SectionList and TextInput are in the main import

// --- Sub-Components ---

const AssessmentCard = React.memo(({ 
  item, 
  syncing, 
  onAssign, 
  onPreview 
}: { 
  item: Assessment; 
  syncing: boolean; 
  onAssign: (id: string) => void; 
  onPreview: (item: Assessment) => void;
}) => (
  <View style={styles.assessmentCard}>
    <View style={styles.cardInfo}>
      <View style={styles.titleRow}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.title}</Text>
        {item.isAssignedToGoogle && (
          <View style={styles.googleBadge}>
            <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={10} color="#34A853" />
            <Text style={styles.googleBadgeText}>ASSIGNED</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.cardSubtitle}>{item.contestType} • {item.questionCount} Questions</Text>
      <Text style={styles.cardDate}>Created: {item.createdAt}</Text>
    </View>
    
    <View style={styles.cardActions}>
      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={[styles.actionButton, styles.assignButton]}
        onPress={() => onAssign(item.id)}
        disabled={syncing || item.isAssignedToGoogle}
      >
        {syncing ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
        ) : (
          <>
            <Ionicons name={item.isAssignedToGoogle ? "checkmark-circle" : "logo-google"} size={16} color="#fff" />
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>{item.isAssignedToGoogle ? 'Synced' : 'Assign'}</Text>
          </>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
      
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionButton} onPress={() => onPreview(item)}>
        <Ionicons name="eye-outline" size={16} color="#003366" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  </View>
));

const PreviewModalComponent = ({ 
  previewing, 
  onClose 
}: { 
  previewing: Assessment | null; 
  onClose: () => void;
}) => (
  <Modal visible={!!previewing} animationType="slide" transparent={false}>
    <View style={styles.modalContainer}>
      <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>{previewing?.title}</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose}>
          <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="#333" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
      <ScrollView style={styles.modalContent}>
        {previewing?.questions.map((q: AssessmentQuestion, idx: number) => (
          <View key={q.id} style={styles.questionItem}>
            <Text style={styles.questionText}>{idx + 1}. {q.text}</Text>
            {q.options.map((opt: string, i: number) => (
              <View key={i} style={styles.optionRow}>
                <View style={[styles.bullet, opt === q.correctAnswer ? styles.bulletCorrect : null]} />
                <Text style={[styles.optionText, opt === q.correctAnswer ? styles.textCorrect : null]}>
                  {opt}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ))}
            <Text style={styles.explanationText}>Explanation: {q.explanation}</Text>
          </View>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.footerButton} onPress={onClose}>
        <Text style={styles.footerButtonText}>Back to Hub</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  </Modal>
);

const TypeSelectionModalComponent = ({ 
  visible, 
  search, 
  setSearch, 
  onClose, 
  onCreate 
}: { 
  visible: boolean; 
  search: string; 
  setSearch: (s: string) => void; 
  onClose: () => void; 
  onCreate: (name: string) => void;
}) => {
  const ldeContests = React.useMemo(() => 
    ALL_CONTESTS.filter(c => c.category === 'LDE' && c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())),
    [search]
  );
  const cdeContests = React.useMemo(() => 
    ALL_CONTESTS.filter(c => c.category === 'CDE' && c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())),
    [search]
  );

  const SECTIONS = React.useMemo(() => [
    { title: 'Leadership Development (LDE)', data: ldeContests },
    { title: 'Career Development (CDE)', data: cdeContests },
  ].filter(s => s.data.length > 0), [ldeContests, cdeContests]);

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} animationType="slide" transparent={false}>
      <View style={styles.fullModalContainer}>
        <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Choose a Contest</Text>
            <Text style={styles.selectionSubtitle}>Select any LDE or CDE to build an exam</Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose}>
            <Ionicons name="close" size={28} color="#333" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.searchBarContainer}>
          <Ionicons name="search" size={20} color="#999" />
          <TextInput 
            style={styles.searchBar}
            placeholder="Search all contests..."
            value={search}
            onChangeText={setSearch}
            placeholderTextColor="#999"
          />
        </View>
        
        <SectionList
          sections={SECTIONS}
          keyExtractor={(item: any) => item.id}
          renderItem={({ item }: { item: any }) => (
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={styles.fullOptionBtn}
              onPress={() => onCreate(item.name)}
            >
              <View style={[styles.optionIcon, { backgroundColor: '#00336610' }]}>
                <Ionicons name={item.icon || 'trophy'} size={20} color="#003366" />
              </View>
              <View style={styles.optionContent}>
                <Text style={styles.optionLabel}>{item.name}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.optionDesc} numberOfLines={1}>{item.description}</Text>
              </View>
              <Ionicons name="sparkles-outline" size={16} color="#003366" style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          renderSectionHeader={({ section: { title } }: { section: { title: string } }) => (
            <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderText}>{title}</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.sectionListContent}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.emptySearch}>
              <Text style={styles.emptySearchText}>No contests found matching "{search}"</Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default function AssessmentManager() {
  const [assessments, setAssessments] = useState<Assessment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState<Assessment | null>(null);
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [showTypeSelect, setShowTypeSelect] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAssessments();
  }, []);

  const loadAssessments = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await TeacherService.getAssessments();
      setAssessments(data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const createWithAI = () => {
    setShowTypeSelect(true);
  };

  const handleCreate = async (type: string) => {
    setShowTypeSelect(false);
    setGenerating(true);
    
    const targetTopic = type; // Direct mapping now available

    try {
      // 1. Generate Questions via Senior Quiz logic
      const questionsData = await generateQuizQuestions({
        topics: [targetTopic],
        questionCount: 10,
        type: 'mixed',
        isMock: false
      });

      const assessmentQuestions: AssessmentQuestion[] = questionsData.map(q => ({
        id: q.id,
        text: q.text,
        options: q.options || [],
        correctAnswer: q.correctAnswer,
        explanation: q.explanation
      }));

      // 2. Save to TeacherService
      const newAssessment = await TeacherService.createAssessment({
        title: `${type} Diagnostic - ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}`,
        contestType: type,
        questionCount: assessmentQuestions.length,
        questions: assessmentQuestions,
      });

      setAssessments((prev: Assessment[]) => [newAssessment, ...prev]);
      Alert.alert('AI Generated!', `Successfully built a ${assessmentQuestions.length}-question assessment for ${type}.`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      Alert.alert('Generation Failed', 'I hit a snag while consulting the manuals. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const assignToGoogle = async (id: string) => {
    setSyncing(id);
    try {
      const success = await TeacherService.assignToGoogleClassroom(id);
      if (success) {
        setAssessments((prev: Assessment[]) => prev.map((a: Assessment) => a.id === id ? { ...a, isAssignedToGoogle: true } : a));
        Alert.alert('Synced!', 'Assessment assigned to your Google Classroom.');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to sync with Google Classroom');
    } finally {
      setSyncing(null);
    }
  };

  const renderItem = React.useCallback(({ item }: { item: Assessment }) => (
    <AssessmentCard 
      item={item} 
      syncing={syncing === item.id} 
      onAssign={assignToGoogle} 
      onPreview={setPreviewing}
    />
  ), [syncing, assignToGoogle]);

  // modals removed from here and extracted

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <PreviewModalComponent previewing={previewing} onClose={() => setPreviewing(null)} />
      <TypeSelectionModalComponent 
        visible={showTypeSelect} 
        search={search} 
        setSearch={setSearch} 
        onClose={() => { setShowTypeSelect(false); setSearch(''); }} 
        onCreate={handleCreate} 
      />
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View>
          <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Assessments</Text>
          <Text style={styles.headerSubtitle}>Build and assign FFA contests</Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={[styles.aiButton, generating && { opacity: 0.7 }]} 
          onPress={createWithAI}
          disabled={generating}
        >
          {generating ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" /> : <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={18} color="#fff" />}
          <Text style={styles.aiButtonText}>{generating ? 'Consulting Manuals...' : 'Build with AI'}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {loading && assessments.length === 0 ? (
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" style={{ marginTop: 40 }} />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={assessments}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          keyExtractor={(item: Assessment) => item.id}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.emptyState}>
              <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={48} color="#ccc" />
              <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No assessments built yet.</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.emptyButton} onPress={createWithAI}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyButtonText}>Create Your First Assessment</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          }
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

<file path="app/(admin)/classroom.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, Alert, Modal, TextInput, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { TeacherService, Classroom } from '@/lib/teacher';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function ClassroomScreen() {
  const [classrooms, setClassrooms] = useState<Classroom[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [newClassName, setNewClassName] = useState('');
  const [newClassDesc, setNewClassDesc] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadClassrooms();
  }, []);

  const loadClassrooms = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await TeacherService.getClassrooms();
      setClassrooms(data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateClass = async () => {
    if (!newClassName) {
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Class name is required');
      return;
    }
    
    setLoading(true);
    await TeacherService.createClassroom(newClassName, newClassDesc);
    await loadClassrooms();
    setShowAddModal(false);
    setNewClassName('');
    setNewClassDesc('');
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const connectGoogleClassroom = () => {
    Alert.alert('Google Classroom', 'Connecting to Google Classroom API... (Mock Success)');
  };

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: Classroom }) => (
    <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
      <View style={[styles.classCard, styles.glass]}>
        <View style={styles.classInfo}>
          <Text style={styles.className}>{item.name}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.classDesc}>{item.description}</Text>
          <View style={styles.joinCodeBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.joinCodeText}>JOIN CODE: {item.join_code}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.classStats}>
          <View style={styles.statBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>{item.student_count}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>STU.</Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.moreButton}>
            <Ionicons name="settings-outline" size={20} color="#444" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </motion.div>
  );

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.googleButton} onPress={connectGoogleClassroom}>
            <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={20} color="#003366" />
            <Text style={styles.googleText}>Import from Classroom</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addButton} onPress={() => setShowAddModal(true)}>
            <Ionicons name="add" size={24} color="#fff" />
            <Text style={styles.addText}>New Class</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </motion.div>
      </View>

      {loading && !showAddModal ? (
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" style={{ marginTop: 20 }} />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={classrooms}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          keyExtractor={item => item.id}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.emptyState}>
              <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No classrooms yet. Create one or import.</Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      )}

      <Modal visible={showAddModal} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={[styles.modalContent, styles.glass, { backgroundColor: '#0a0a0a' }]}>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>NEW CLASSROOM</Text>
            
            <TextInput 
              style={styles.input} 
              placeholder="Class Name (e.g. Period 1)"
              placeholderTextColor="#444"
              value={newClassName}
              onChangeText={setNewClassName}
            />
            
            <TextInput 
              style={[styles.input, { height: 80 }]} 
              placeholder="Description (Optional)"
              placeholderTextColor="#444"
              value={newClassDesc}
              onChangeText={setNewClassDesc}
              multiline
            />

            <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelButton} onPress={() => setShowAddModal(false)}>
                <Text style={styles.cancelText}>CANCEL</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.createButton} onPress={handleCreateClass}>
                <Text style={styles.createText}>CREATE</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#000000',
  },
  glass: {
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
    borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  header: {
    padding: 20,
    gap: 12,
  },
  googleButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    gap: 10,
  },
  googleText: {
    color: '#888',
    fontWeight: '700',
    fontSize: 12,
    letterSpacing: 0.5,
  },
  addButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',

<file path="app/(admin)/creed-grading.tsx">
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  View, 
  Text, 
  StyleSheet, 
  ScrollView, 
  TouchableOpacity, 
  Dimensions,
  TextInput
} from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC } from '@/lib/data/creed';
import { CreedSubScore, CreedDeductions } from '@/lib/types/creed';
import { useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { gradeCreedRecitation } from '@/lib/ai/gemini';

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window');

type GradingPhase = 'oral' | 'non_verbal' | 'qa' | 'deductions';

export default function CreedGradingScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<GradingPhase>('oral');
  const [isGrading, setIsGrading] = useState(false);
  
  // State for scores
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<CreedSubScore>({
    oral: { hesitation: 3, pace: 3, tone: 3, pronunciation: 3, volume: 3 },
    non_verbal: { eye_contact: 3, mannerisms: 3, gestures: 3, poise: 3 },
    qa: { details: 3, unrehearsed: 3, examples: 3 }
  });

  const [deductions, setDeductions] = useState<CreedDeductions>({
    time_seconds_over: 0,
    missed_word_count: 0
  });

  // Calculations
  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let oralTotal = 0;
    Object.entries(scores.oral).forEach(([key, val]) => {
        const item = CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.oral.find(i => i.id === key);
        if (item) oralTotal += val * item.weight;
    });

    let nonVerbalTotal = 0;
    Object.entries(scores.non_verbal).forEach(([key, val]) => {
        const item = CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.non_verbal.find(i => i.id === key);
        if (item) nonVerbalTotal += val * item.weight;
    });

    let qaTotal = 0;
    Object.entries(scores.qa).forEach(([key, val]) => {
        const item = CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.qa.find(i => i.id === key);
        if (item) qaTotal += val * item.weight;
    });

    const grossScore = oralTotal + nonVerbalTotal + qaTotal;
    const totalDeductions = (deductions.time_seconds_over * 1) + (deductions.missed_word_count * 20);
    
    return {
        oral: oralTotal,
        nonVerbal: nonVerbalTotal,
        qa: qaTotal,
        gross: grossScore,
        deductions: totalDeductions,
        net: Math.max(0, grossScore - totalDeductions)
    };
  }, [scores, deductions]);

  const updateScore = (cat: keyof CreedSubScore, id: string, val: number) => {
    setScores(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [cat]: { ...prev[cat], [id]: val }
    }));
  };

  const runAIGrade = async () => {
    if (!params.transcript) return;
    setIsGrading(true);
    try {
      const result = await gradeCreedRecitation(params.transcript as string, JSON.stringify(CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC));
      if (result.detailedScores) {
        setScores(result.detailedScores);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("AI Grading Error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGrading(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto-run if transcript provided
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (params.transcript && !isGrading) {
        runAIGrade();
    }
  }, [params.transcript]);

  const renderRatingButtons = (cat: keyof CreedSubScore, id: string, current: number) => (
    <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(num => (
        <TouchableOpacity 
          key={num} 
          onPress={() => updateScore(cat, id, num)}
          style={[
            styles.ratingBtn, 
            current === num && styles.ratingBtnActive
          ]}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.ratingText, current === num && styles.ratingTextActive]}>{num}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ))}
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ 
        title: 'CREED GRADING WIZARD',
        headerShown: true,
        headerStyle: { backgroundColor: '#000' },
        headerTintColor: Theme.colors.accent,
        headerTitleStyle: { fontWeight: '900' }
      }} />

      {/* Progress Tab Bar */}
      <View style={styles.tabContainer}>
        {(['oral', 'non_verbal', 'qa', 'deductions'] as GradingPhase[]).map((p) => (
          <TouchableOpacity 
            key={p} 
            onPress={() => setPhase(p)}
            style={[styles.tab, phase === p && styles.tabActive]}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, phase === p && styles.tabTextActive]}>
                {p.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* AI Intelligence Banner */}
      {params.transcript && (
          <View style={[styles.aiBanner, { backgroundColor: isGrading ? 'rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1)' : 'rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1)' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={16} color={isGrading ? "#00f2ff" : "#00ff88"} />
              <Text style={[styles.aiBannerText, { color: isGrading ? "#00f2ff" : "#00ff88" }]}>
                  {isGrading ? "AI COACH IS EVALUATING PERFORMANCE..." : "AI GRADE GENERATED FROM TRANSCRIPTION"}
              </Text>
              {!isGrading && (
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={runAIGrade}>
                      <Text style={{color: '#fff', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '900', textDecorationLine: 'underline', marginLeft: 10}}>RE-RUN AI</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
          </View>
      )}

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={phase}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            style={styles.phaseContent}
          >
            {phase === 'oral' && (
              <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>ORAL COMMUNICATION (MAX 400)</Text>
                {CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.oral.map(item => (
                  <View key={item.id} style={styles.itemRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.itemName}>{item.name}</Text>
                    {renderRatingButtons('oral', item.id, (scores.oral as any)[item.id])}
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            )}

            {phase === 'non_verbal' && (
              <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>NON-VERBAL COMMUNICATION (MAX 300)</Text>
                {CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.non_verbal.map(item => (
                  <View key={item.id} style={styles.itemRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.itemName}>{item.name}</Text>
                    {renderRatingButtons('non_verbal', item.id, (scores.non_verbal as any)[item.id])}
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            )}

            {phase === 'qa' && (
              <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>QUESTION & ANSWER (MAX 300)</Text>
                {CREED_GRADING_RUBRIC.qa.map(item => (
                  <View key={item.id} style={styles.itemRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.itemName}>{item.name}</Text>
                    {renderRatingButtons('qa', item.id, (scores.qa as any)[item.id])}
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            )}

            {phase === 'deductions' && (
              <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>DEDUCTIONS (STRICT)</Text>
                
                <View style={styles.inputRow}>
                    <View style={{flex: 1}}>
                        <Text style={styles.itemName}>SECONDS OVER TIME</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.itemSubText}>1 pt deduction per second</Text>
                    </View>
                    <TextInput 
                        style={styles.input}
                        keyboardType="numeric"
                        value={String(deductions.time_seconds_over)}
                        onChangeText={(v) => setDeductions(d => ({...d, time_seconds_over: parseInt(v) || 0}))}
                        placeholderTextColor="#666"
                    />
                </View>

                <View style={styles.inputRow}>
                    <View style={{flex: 1}}>
                        <Text style={styles.itemName}>MISSED WORDS (ERRORS)</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.itemSubText}>20 pts deduction per error</Text>
                    </View>
                    <TextInput 
                        style={styles.input}
                        keyboardType="numeric"
                        value={String(deductions.missed_word_count)}
                        onChangeText={(v) => setDeductions(d => ({...d, missed_word_count: parseInt(v) || 0}))}
                        placeholderTextColor="#666"
                    />
                </View>
              </View>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Real-time Scoring Bar */}
      <View style={[styles.scoreBar, GlassEffect]}>
          <View style={styles.scoreCol}>
              <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>GROSS</Text>
              <Text style={styles.scoreVal}>{calculations.gross}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.scoreCol}>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreLabel, {color: '#ff4444'}]}>DEDUCT</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreVal, {color: '#ff4444'}]}>-{calculations.deductions}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.scoreCol, styles.netCol]}>
              <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>NET TOTAL</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreVal, {color: Theme.colors.accent, fontSize: 32}]}>{calculations.net}</Text>
          </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.submitBtn} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.submitText}>SUBMIT OFFICIAL SCORE</Text>
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-done" size={24} color="#000" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  tabContainer: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
    paddingTop: 10,
  },

    flex: 1,

  },

<file path="app/(admin)/index.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, RefreshControl, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { TeacherService, TeacherStats } from '@/lib/teacher';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/lib/store/auth';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function AdminDashboard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<TeacherStats | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await TeacherService.getStats();
      setStats(data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadData();
  };

  const QuickAction = ({ title, icon, color, route }: { title: string, icon: any, color: string, route: string }) => (
    <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} style={{ width: '48%' }}>
      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={[styles.actionCard, { width: '100%' }]} 
        onPress={() => router.push(route as any)}
      >
        <View style={[styles.iconBox, { backgroundColor: `${color}20` }]}>
          <Ionicons name={icon} size={28} color={color} />
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.actionTitle}>{title}</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </motion.div>
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView 
      style={styles.container}
      refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh} />}
    >
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View>
          <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>Welcome back,</Text>
          <Text style={styles.nameText}>{user?.user_metadata?.name || 'Teacher'}</Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={[styles.profileButton, styles.glass]} 
          onPress={() => router.push('/(admin)/subscription')}
        >
           <Ionicons name="person-circle-outline" size={32} color="#00f2ff" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.statsRow}>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}
            onPress={() => router.push('/(admin)/students')}
          >
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>{stats?.activeStudents}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>ACTIVE STUDENTS</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <View style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>{stats?.totalClassrooms}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>CLASSROOMS</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <View style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>{stats?.avgClassScore}%</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>AVG. SCORE</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
      </View>

      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>QUICK ACTIONS</Text>
      <View style={styles.actionsGrid}>
        <QuickAction title="MANAGE STUDENTS" icon="people" color="#00f2ff" route="/(admin)/students" />
        <QuickAction title="BUILD ASSESSMENTS" icon="create" color="#bf5af2" route="/(admin)/assessments" />
        <QuickAction title="CLASSROOMS" icon="school" color="#4CAF50" route="/(admin)/classroom" />
        <QuickAction title="VIEW REPORTS" icon="bar-chart" color="#F2A900" route="/(admin)/analytics" />
        <QuickAction title="JUDGE CREED" icon="ribbon" color="#FF4444" route="/(admin)/creed-grading-wizard" />
      </View>

      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>RECENT ACTIVITY</Text>
      <View style={[styles.activityList, styles.glass]}>
        {stats?.recentActivity.map((activity, index) => (
          <View key={index} style={styles.activityItem}>
             <View style={styles.activityIcon}>
               <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={20} color="#666" />
             </View>
             <View style={styles.activityContent}>
               <Text style={styles.activityText}>
                 <Text style={styles.studentName}>{activity.student}</Text> <Text style={{color: '#aaa'}}>{activity.action}</Text>
               </Text>
               <Text style={styles.activityTime}>{activity.time.toUpperCase()}</Text>
             </View>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#000000',
    padding: 16,
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  glass: {
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
    borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    marginBottom: 32,
    marginTop: 8,
  },
  welcomeText: {
    fontSize: 14,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: '#666',
    letterSpacing: 0.5,
  },
  nameText: {
    fontSize: 26,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: '#fff',
    letterSpacing: -0.5,
  },
  profileButton: {
    padding: 8,
    borderRadius: 16,
  },
  statsRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    marginBottom: 32,
    gap: 12,
  },
  statCard: {
    flex: 1,
    padding: 20,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  statValue: {

<file path="app/(admin)/lde-grading.tsx">
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  View, 
  Text, 
  StyleSheet, 
  ScrollView, 
  TouchableOpacity, 
  Dimensions,
  TextInput,
  ActivityIndicator
} from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { LDE_RUBRICS } from '@/lib/data/lde-rubrics';
import { gradeLDEContest } from '@/lib/ai/gemini';

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window');

export default function LDEGradingScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { contestId, transcript } = useLocalSearchParams<{ contestId: string; transcript?: string }>();
  
  // Get the specific rubric
  const rubric = useMemo(() => {
    return contestId ? LDE_RUBRICS[contestId] : null;
  }, [contestId]);

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<string>('');
  const [isGrading, setIsGrading] = useState(false);
  
  // State for scores: Record<categoryId, Record<itemId, 1-5 score>>
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, number>>>({});
  
  // State for deductions: Record<deductionId, count/value>
  const [deductions, setDeductions] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  // Initialize phase and scores
  useEffect(() => {
    if (rubric) {
      setPhase(rubric.categories[0].id);
      
      const initialScores: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {};
      rubric.categories.forEach(cat => {
        initialScores[cat.id] = {};
        cat.items.forEach(item => {
          initialScores[cat.id][item.id] = 3; // Default to 3
        });
      });
      setScores(initialScores);

      const initialDeductions: Record<string, number> = {};
      rubric.deductions?.forEach(d => {
        initialDeductions[d.id] = 0;
      });
      setDeductions(initialDeductions);
    }
  }, [rubric]);

  // Calculations
  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rubric) return { gross: 0, deductions: 0, net: 0, breakdown: {} };

    let grossScore = 0;
    const breakdown: Record<string, number> = {};

    rubric.categories.forEach(cat => {
      let catTotal = 0;
      cat.items.forEach(item => {
        const score1to5 = scores[cat.id]?.[item.id] || 0;
        catTotal += (score1to5 / 5) * item.weight;
      });
      breakdown[cat.id] = Math.round(catTotal);
      grossScore += catTotal;
    });

    let totalDeductions = 0;
    rubric.deductions?.forEach(d => {
      const value = deductions[d.id] || 0;
      totalDeductions += value * d.penalty;
    });

    return {
      gross: Math.round(grossScore),
      deductions: Math.round(totalDeductions),
      net: Math.max(0, Math.round(grossScore - totalDeductions)),
      breakdown
    };
  }, [rubric, scores, deductions]);

  const updateScore = (catId: string, itemId: string, val: number) => {
    setScores(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [catId]: { ...prev[catId], [itemId]: val }
    }));
  };

  const runAIGrade = async () => {
    if (!transcript || !rubric) return;
    setIsGrading(true);
    try {
      const result = await gradeLDEContest(transcript, rubric);
      if (result.scores) {
        setScores(result.scores);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("AI Grading Error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGrading(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto-run if transcript provided
  useEffect(() => {
    if (transcript && !isGrading && rubric) {
        runAIGrade();
    }
  }, [transcript, rubric]);

  if (!rubric) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Text style={{color: '#fff'}}>Rubric not found for {contestId}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const renderRatingButtons = (catId: string, itemId: string, current: number) => (
    <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(num => (
        <TouchableOpacity 
          key={num} 
          onPress={() => updateScore(catId, itemId, num)}
          style={[
            styles.ratingBtn, 
            current === num && styles.ratingBtnActive
          ]}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.ratingText, current === num && styles.ratingTextActive]}>{num}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ))}
    </View>
  );

  const tabs = [...rubric.categories.map(c => c.id)];
  if (rubric.deductions && rubric.deductions.length > 0) {
    tabs.push('deductions');
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ 
        title: `${rubric.contestName.toUpperCase()} GRADING`,
        headerShown: true,
        headerStyle: { backgroundColor: '#000' },
        headerTintColor: Theme.colors.accent,
        headerTitleStyle: { fontWeight: '900' }
      }} />

      {/* Progress Tab Bar */}
      <View style={styles.tabContainer}>
        <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
          {tabs.map((t) => (
            <TouchableOpacity 
              key={t} 
              onPress={() => setPhase(t)}
              style={[styles.tab, phase === t && styles.tabActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.tabText, phase === t && styles.tabTextActive]}>
                  {(t === 'deductions' ? 'DEDUCTIONS' : rubric.categories.find(c => c.id === t)?.name || t).toUpperCase()}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      {/* AI Intelligence Banner */}
      {transcript && (
          <View style={[styles.aiBanner, { backgroundColor: isGrading ? 'rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1)' : 'rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1)' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={16} color={isGrading ? "#00f2ff" : "#00ff88"} />
              <Text style={[styles.aiBannerText, { color: isGrading ? "#00f2ff" : "#00ff88" }]}>
                  {isGrading ? "THE AI JUDGE IS DELIBERATING... (USUALLY 10-15s)" : "AI GRADE GENERATED FROM TRANSCRIPTION"}
              </Text>
              {!isGrading && (
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={runAIGrade}>
                      <Text style={{color: '#fff', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '900', textDecorationLine: 'underline', marginLeft: 10}}>RE-RUN AI</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
          </View>
      )}

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          {rubric.categories.map(cat => (
            phase === cat.id && (
              <motion.div
                key={cat.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                style={styles.phaseContent}
              >
                <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                  <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{cat.name.toUpperCase()} (MAX {cat.maxPoints})</Text>
                  {cat.items.map(item => (
                    <View key={item.id} style={styles.itemRow}>
                      <Text style={styles.itemName}>{item.name}</Text>
                      {renderRatingButtons(cat.id, item.id, scores[cat.id]?.[item.id] || 0)}
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              </motion.div>
            )
          ))}

          {phase === 'deductions' && rubric.deductions && (
            <motion.div
              key="deductions"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
              style={styles.phaseContent}
            >
              <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>DEDUCTIONS (STRICT)</Text>
                {rubric.deductions.map(d => (
                  <View key={d.id} style={styles.inputRow}>
                    <View style={{flex: 1}}>
                        <Text style={styles.itemName}>{d.name.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.itemSubText}>{d.penalty} pt deduction {d.rule}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <TextInput 
                        style={styles.input}
                        keyboardType="numeric"
                        value={String(deductions[d.id] || 0)}
                        onChangeText={(v) => setDeductions(prev => ({...prev, [d.id]: parseInt(v) || 0}))}
                        placeholderTextColor="#666"
                    />
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Real-time Scoring Bar */}
      <View style={[styles.scoreBar, GlassEffect]}>
          <View style={styles.scoreCol}>
              <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>GROSS</Text>
              <Text style={styles.scoreVal}>{calculations.gross}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.scoreCol}>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreLabel, {color: '#ff4444'}]}>DEDUCT</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreVal, {color: '#ff4444'}]}>-{calculations.deductions}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.scoreCol, styles.netCol]}>
              <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>NET TOTAL</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreVal, {color: Theme.colors.accent, fontSize: 32}]}>{calculations.net}</Text>
          </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.submitBtn} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.submitText}>SUBMIT OFFICIAL SCORE</Text>
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-done" size={24} color="#000" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  tabContainer: {
    flexDirection: 'row',

  },
