<file path="app/contest/spanish-creed-speaking.tsx">
/**
 * Spanish Creed Speaking Contest Screen
 * Allows users to record their presentation in Spanish and get AI feedback
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, Alert, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import VideoRecorder from '../../components/contest/VideoRecorder';
import { transcribeAudio } from '../../lib/ai/whisper';
import { calculateSpanishAccuracy, FFA_CREED_SPANISH, SPANISH_CREED_QUESTIONS, AccuracyResult } from '../../lib/scoring/spanish-creed';
import { evaluateAnswer, AIAnalysisResult } from '../../lib/ai/claude';
import { gradeSpanishCreedRecitation, CreedGradingResult } from '../../lib/ai/gemini';
import { SPANISH_CREED_RUBRIC } from '../../lib/data/official-spanish-creed-data';
import { useAuthStore } from '../../lib/store/auth';
import { saveSession, updateProgress } from '../../lib/data';
import { useHistoryStore } from '../../lib/store/history';

type ContestStep = 'intro' | 'reciting' | 'qa' | 'processing' | 'results';

export default function SpanishCreedSpeakingScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  
  // State for the contest progression
  const [step, setStep] = useState<ContestStep>('intro');
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [activeQuestion, setActiveQuestion] = useState("");
  const [selectedQuestions, setSelectedQuestions] = useState<typeof SPANISH_CREED_QUESTIONS>([]);
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState<number>(0);
  
  // Storage for video URIs
  const [recitationUri, setRecitationUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [qaUris, setQaUris] = useState<string[]>([]);
  
  // Results storage
  const [recitationResult, setRecitationResult] = useState<{
    transcription: string, 
    accuracy: AccuracyResult, 
    grading: CreedGradingResult
  } | null>(null);
  
  const [qaResults, setQaResults] = useState<{
    question: string, 
    transcription: string, 
    analysis: AIAnalysisResult
  }[]>([]);
  
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  // Start the contest
  const startContest = () => {
    setRecitationResult(null);
    setQaResults([]);
    setRecitationUri(null);
    setQaUris([]);
    setStartTime(Date.now());
    setStep('reciting');
  };

  const handleRecitationComplete = (uri: string) => {
    setRecitationUri(uri);
    startQA();
  };

  const startQA = () => {
    const shuffled = [...SPANISH_CREED_QUESTIONS].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const selected = shuffled.slice(0, 3);
    setSelectedQuestions(selected);
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
    setActiveQuestion(selected[0].question_text);
    setStep('qa');
  };

  const handleRecordingComplete = (uri: string) => {
    if (step === 'reciting') {
      handleRecitationComplete(uri);
    } else if (step === 'qa') {
      handleAnswerComplete(uri);
    }
  };

  const handleAnswerComplete = (uri: string) => {
    const nextUris = [...qaUris, uri];
    setQaUris(nextUris);
    
    if (nextUris.length === 3) {
      processFinalResults(recitationUri!, nextUris);
    } else {
      const nextIndex = currentQuestionIndex + 1;
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(nextIndex);
      setActiveQuestion(selectedQuestions[nextIndex].question_text);
      // Keep state as 'qa' to stay in recording view
    }
  };

  const processFinalResults = async (recUri: string, qUris: string[]) => {
    setStep('processing');
    setIsProcessing(true);
    
    try {
      const whisperApiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2 || '';
      const claudeApiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '';
      const rubricString = JSON.stringify(SPANISH_CREED_RUBRIC);

      // 1. Process Recitation
      let recitationText = "";
      if (whisperApiKey) {
        const result = await transcribeAudio(recUri, whisperApiKey, 'es');
        recitationText = result.text;
      } else {
        recitationText = FFA_CREED_SPANISH.fullText;
      }
      
      const acc = calculateSpanishAccuracy(recitationText, undefined);
      const grading = await gradeSpanishCreedRecitation(recitationText, rubricString);
      setRecitationResult({ transcription: recitationText, accuracy: acc, grading });

      // 2. Process QA
      const qaFinal: typeof qaResults = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < qUris.length; i++) {
        let qText = "";
        if (whisperApiKey) {
          const result = await transcribeAudio(qUris[i], whisperApiKey, 'es');
          qText = result.text;
        } else {
          qText = "Creo que el futuro de la agricultura..."; 
        }

        let analysis: AIAnalysisResult;
        if (claudeApiKey) {
          analysis = await evaluateAnswer(selectedQuestions[i].question_text, qText, claudeApiKey);
        } else {
          analysis = { score: 85, feedback: ["Buena perspectiva."], sentiment: "Reflexivo" };
        }
        qaFinal.push({ question: selectedQuestions[i].question_text, transcription: qText, analysis });
      }
      setQaResults(qaFinal);
      setStep('results');

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Delayed Processing Spanish Error:", error);
      Alert.alert("Error", "No se pudieron procesar los resultados. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo.");
      setStep('intro');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const finishContest = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      router.back();
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const oralScore = recitationResult?.grading.oralScore || 0;
      const nonVerbalScore = recitationResult?.grading.nonVerbalScore || 0;
      const qaTotalMatchesRubric = qaResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.analysis.score, 0);

      const finalScore = oralScore + nonVerbalScore + qaTotalMatchesRubric;
      const timeSpent = Math.round((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);

      const sessId = await saveSession({
        user_id: user.id,
        contest_id: 'lde-spanish-creed',
        score: finalScore,
        time_spent_seconds: timeSpent,
        completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        metadata: {
          accuracy_score: recitationResult?.accuracy.score,
          oral_score: oralScore,
          non_verbal_score: nonVerbalScore,
          qa_score: qaTotalMatchesRubric
        }
      });

      if (sessId) {
        await updateProgress(user.id, 'lde-spanish-creed', finalScore, timeSpent);
      }
      
      useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
          type: 'spanish-creed-speaking',
          score: finalScore,
          maxScore: 1000,
          details: {
             oral: oralScore,
             nonVerbal: nonVerbalScore,
             qa: qaTotalMatchesRubric,
             feedback: recitationResult?.grading.feedback
          },
          metadata: {
              accuracy: recitationResult?.accuracy.score
          }
      });

      router.back();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Save error:", error);
      Alert.alert("Error", "No se pudo guardar el resultado.");
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // CALCULATE DISPLAY SCORES
  const oralScore = recitationResult?.grading.oralScore || 0;
  const nonVerbalScore = recitationResult?.grading.nonVerbalScore || 0;
  const qaTotal = qaResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.analysis.score, 0);
  const finalScore = oralScore + nonVerbalScore + qaTotal;

  if (step === 'reciting' || step === 'qa') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.recordContainer}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <View style={styles.recordHeader}>
          {step === 'reciting' ? (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Recitación Completa</Text>
              <Text style={styles.stepInstruction}>Recita todo el Credo claramente frente a la cámara</Text>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Pregunta {currentQuestionIndex + 1} de 3</Text>
              <View style={styles.questionCard}>
                <Text style={styles.questionText}>{activeQuestion}</Text>
              </View>
            </>
          )}
        </View>
        <VideoRecorder onRecordingComplete={handleRecordingComplete} />
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.closeButton} onPress={() => setStep('intro')}>
          <Ionicons name="close" size={32} color="white" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen 
        options={{ 
          title: 'Concurso de Credo en Español',
          headerTintColor: '#fff',
          headerStyle: { backgroundColor: '#003366' },
        }} 
      />

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
        {step === 'intro' && (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Concurso Oficial LDE</Text>
            <Text style={styles.description}>
              Este concurso se califica estrictamente según la rúbrica oficial:
              {"\n\n"}• COMUNICACIÓN ORAL (400 pts)
              {"\n"}• COMUNICACIÓN NO VERBAL (300 pts)
              {"\n"}• PREGUNTAS Y RESPUESTAS VERBALES (300 pts)
            </Text>
            
            <View style={styles.contestBreakdown}>
              <View style={styles.breakdownItem}>
                <Ionicons name="mic" size={24} color="#003366" />
                <Text style={styles.breakdownText}>1 Recitación (Oral/No Verbal)</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.breakdownItem}>
                <Ionicons name="chatbubbles" size={24} color="#003366" />
                <Text style={styles.breakdownText}>3 Preguntas (300 pts Total)</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryButton} onPress={startContest}>
              <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Iniciar Concurso</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        {step === 'processing' && (
          <View style={styles.centerContent}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" />
            <Text style={styles.processingText}>El juez está calificando...</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subProcessingText}>Evaluando todas las grabaciones (aprox 45s).</Text>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
                style={styles.cancelBtn} 
                onPress={() => setStep('intro')}
            >
                <Text style={styles.cancelText}>CANCELAR Y REINICIAR</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        {step === 'results' && (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <View style={styles.resultHeader}>
              <Ionicons name="trophy" size={48} color="#FFD700" />
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.resultTitle}>Concurso Completado</Text>
                <Text style={styles.resultScore}>Puntuación: {finalScore}/1000</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.statsGrid}>
              <View style={styles.statBox}>
                <Text style={styles.statLabel}>Oral</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statValue}>{oralScore}/400</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.statBox}>
                <Text style={styles.statLabel}>No Verbal</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statValue}>{nonVerbalScore}/300</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.statBox}>
                <Text style={styles.statLabel}>Preguntas</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statValue}>{qaTotal}/300</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.resultSection}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Comentarios del Juez:</Text>
              {recitationResult?.grading.feedback.map((fb, idx) => (
                 <Text key={idx} style={styles.feedbackText}>• {fb}</Text>
              ))}
              <Text style={[styles.feedbackText, { marginTop: 10, fontWeight: 'bold' }]}>
                Sentimiento: {recitationResult?.grading.sentiment}
              </Text>

              <View style={{ marginTop: 20, padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5', borderRadius: 8 }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: '#666' }}>VERIFICACIÓN DE PRECISIÓN</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#333' }}>
                  Precisión de Palabras: {recitationResult?.accuracy.score}%
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={[styles.primaryButton, isSaving && { opacity: 0.7 }]} 
              onPress={finishContest}
              disabled={isSaving}
            >
              {isSaving ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="white" />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Finalizar y Guardar</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TextInput, Alert, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';

export default function AgAdvocacySetup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState('');

  const startPractice = () => {
    console.log("Start Practice pressed with topic:", topic);
    if (!topic.trim()) {
        Alert.alert("Topic Required", "Please enter your advocacy topic so we can generate relevant questions.");
        return;
    }
    
    try {
        console.log("Pushing route:", `/practice/ag-advocacy/record?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic.trim())}`);
        router.push(`/practice/ag-advocacy/record?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic.trim())}`);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Navigation error:", error);
        Alert.alert("Error", "Could not start recording session.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Ionicons name="megaphone-outline" size={48} color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.title}>Agricultural Advocacy</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Promote Agriculture to Consumers</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Your Advocacy Topic</Text>
        <Text style={styles.text}>
          Enter the main topic or theme of your presentation (e.g., "GMO Safety", "Water Conservation", "Farm to Table").
          The AI Judge will generate specific questions based on this topic.
        </Text>
        
        <TextInput
            style={styles.input}
            placeholder="Enter your topic here..."
            value={topic}
            onChangeText={setTopic}
            placeholderTextColor="#999"
        />
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Contest Rules</Text>
        <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
            <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={20} color={Colors.darkGray} />
            <Text style={styles.ruleText}>Presentation: 5-8 minutes</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
            <Ionicons name="help-circle-outline" size={20} color={Colors.darkGray} />
            <Text style={styles.ruleText}>Q&A: 5 minutes</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
            <Ionicons name="people-outline" size={20} color={Colors.darkGray} />
            <Text style={styles.ruleText}>Team Size: 3-5 Members</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Scoring Rubric (1000 pts)</Text>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Creativity & Innovation</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>150 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Ag Industry Knowledge</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>150 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Overall Quality</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>125 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Expression & Enthusiasm</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>125 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Organization</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>100 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Response to Questions</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>200 pts</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.rubricItem}><Text style={styles.rubricLabel}>• Clarity, Interest, Teamwork</Text><Text style={styles.rubricValue}>150 pts</Text></View>
      </View>
      
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startBtn} onPress={startPractice}>
        <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Practice</Text>
        <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
      
      <View style={{height: 40}} />
    </ScrollView>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

  cardTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 10 },

  ruleRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8, gap: 10 },

<file path="app/practice/ag-advocacy/record.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Platform, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions, useMicrophonePermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { generateAgAdvocacyQuestions, analyzeAgAdvocacy } from '../../../lib/scoring/ag-advocacy';
import { transcribeAudio } from '@/lib/ai/whisper';

type Phase = 'setup' | 'presentation' | 'questions' | 'processing';

export default function AgAdvocacyRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { topic } = useLocalSearchParams<{ topic?: string }>();
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [micPermission, requestMicPermission] = useMicrophonePermissions();

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('setup');
  const phaseRef = useRef<Phase>(phase);
  
  useEffect(() => { phaseRef.current = phase; }, [phase]);

  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingQuestions, setIsLoadingQuestions] = useState(false);
  const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);

  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Generate questions based on the user's topic
    const loadQuestions = async () => {
        setIsLoadingQuestions(true);
        // Use provided topic or a default fallback
        const effectiveTopic = topic || "General Agriculture";
        const q = await generateAgAdvocacyQuestions(effectiveTopic);
        setQuestions(q);
        setIsLoadingQuestions(false);
    };
    loadQuestions();

    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  }, [topic]);

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const getTimerColor = () => {
    // 5-8 minutes target
    if (seconds > 480) return Colors.error; // > 8 mins
    if (seconds >= 420) return Colors.warning; // > 7 mins (Warning)
    if (seconds >= 300) return Colors.success; // > 5 mins (Good)
    return Colors.white; // Under time
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    if (recording) return;

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
            const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
            chunksRef.current = [];
            
            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data); };
            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
                const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                setVideoUri(url);
                
                if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                    processSubmission(url);
                }
                stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            };
            
            mediaRecorder.start();
            setRecording(true);
            setSeconds(0);
            timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            Alert.alert("Error", "Could not access camera/mic");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!cameraRef.current) return;
    try {
        setRecording(true);
        setSeconds(0);
        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        
        const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({ maxDuration: 1200 }); // 20 mins max
        if (video) {
            setVideoUri(video.uri);
            if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                processSubmission(video.uri);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        setRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        mediaRecorderRef.current?.stop();
    } else {
        cameraRef.current?.stopRecording();
    }
    setRecording(false);
    clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  };

  const nextPhase = () => {
      if (phase === 'setup') {
          setPhase('presentation');
          startRecording();
      } else if (phase === 'presentation') {
          setPhase('questions');
      } else if (phase === 'questions') {
          finishContest();
      }
  };

  const finishContest = () => {
      phaseRef.current = 'processing';
      setPhase('processing');
      stopRecording();
  };



// ... inside processSubmission ...
  const processSubmission = async (uri: string) => {
      try {
          const apiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2;
          if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Missing API Key");

          let transcript = "";
          try {
             const result = await transcribeAudio(uri, apiKey);
             transcript = result.text;
             console.log("Transcription:", transcript.substring(0, 50) + "...");
          } catch (tErr) {
             console.error("Transcription failed:", tErr);
             transcript = ""; // Empty transcript triggers the low score safeguard
          }

          const score = await analyzeAgAdvocacy(transcript, questions);
          
          router.push({
              pathname: '/practice/ag-advocacy/result',
              params: {
                  score: JSON.stringify(score),
                  videoUri: uri
              }
              // TODO: Pass transcript to result screen if needed (omitted for now to match result.tsx props)
          });
      } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
          Alert.alert("Error", "Scoring failed.");
          router.back();
      }
  };

  if (!permission?.granted || !micPermission?.granted) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <Text style={styles.permTitle}>Permissions Required</Text>
              <Text style={styles.permSub}>We need access to your camera and microphone to record your practice.</Text>
              
              {!permission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="camera" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Camera Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
              
              {!micPermission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestMicPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="mic" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Microphone Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
          </View>
      );
  }

  if (phase === 'processing' && videoUri) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={{ marginTop: 20, fontSize: 18, color: Colors.navy }}>Judging Advocacy...</Text>
          </View>
      );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <CameraView style={styles.camera} ref={cameraRef}>
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
            <View style={[styles.timerBadge, { borderColor: getTimerColor() }]}>
                <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: recording ? 'red' : 'gray' }]} />
                <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(seconds)}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.targetBadge}>Ag Advocacy</Text>
        </View>

        {phase === 'setup' && (
            <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Agricultural Advocacy</Text>
                <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{topic || "Promote Agriculture"}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.info}>Time Limit: 5-8 Minutes</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Recording</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'presentation' && (
            <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.phaseLabel}>PHASE: PRESENTATION</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>End Presentation</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={24} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'questions' && (
             <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Question {currentQIndex + 1}/5</Text>
                {isLoadingQuestions ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                ) : (
                    <View style={styles.qCard}>
                        <Text style={styles.qText}>{questions[currentQIndex]}</Text>
                    </View>
                )}
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={() => {
                    if (currentQIndex < 4) setCurrentQIndex(i => i + 1);
                    else nextPhase();
                }}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>{currentQIndex < 4 ? "Next Question" : "Finish"}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
             </View>
        )}
      </CameraView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'black' },
  centered: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20 },
  camera: { flex: 1 },
  topBar: { paddingTop: 60, alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  timerBadge: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 10, borderRadius: 20, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', borderWidth: 2 },
  dot: { width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 6, marginRight: 8 },
  timerText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] },
  targetBadge: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', padding: 5, borderRadius: 4 },
  
  centerOverlay: { position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: 20 },
  bottomOverlay: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, left: 0, right: 0, alignItems: 'center' },
  
  title: { color: 'white', fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, textAlign: 'center' },
  subtitle: { color: Colors.gold, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 20 },
  info: { color: '#DDD', marginBottom: 30 },
  phaseLabel: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, letterSpacing: 1 },
  
  startBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, paddingHorizontal: 40, paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 30 },
  nextBtn: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', paddingHorizontal: 30, paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 30, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'white', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  btnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 18 },
  
  qCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 30, width: '100%' },
  qText: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, textAlign: 'center' },

  // Permissions
  permTitle: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 10 },
  permSub: { fontSize: 16, color: '#666', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 30, paddingHorizontal: 40 },
  permBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 24, paddingVertical: 14, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16, gap: 12, minWidth: 250, justifyContent: 'center' },
  permBtnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 16 },
});

<file path="app/practice/ag-advocacy/result.tsx">
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import ScoreCircle from '@/components/ScoreCircle';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function AgAdvocacyResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { score, videoUri } = useLocalSearchParams<{ score: string; videoUri: string }>();
  
  const result = score ? JSON.parse(score) : null;

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Advocacy Results</Text>
      </View>

      {videoUri && (
          <View style={styles.videoContainer}>
             {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
                <video 
                    src={videoUri} 
                    controls 
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', backgroundColor: 'black' }} 
                />
             ) : (
                <Video
                    source={{ uri: videoUri }}
                    style={styles.video}
                    useNativeControls
                    resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
                    shouldPlay
                />
             )}
          </View>
      )}

      {result ? (
        <View style={styles.scoreContainer}>
          <ScoreCircle percentage={Math.round(result.totalScore / 10)} size={120} label="Score / 1000" />
          <Text style={styles.totalScoreText}>{result.totalScore} Points</Text>

          <View style={styles.feedbackCard}>
            <Text style={styles.feedbackTitle}>Judges Feedback</Text>
            <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{result.feedback}</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.breakdown}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionHeader}>Score Breakdown</Text>
              
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Response to Questions</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.responseToQuestions}/200</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Use of Creativity</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.creativity}/150</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Industry Knowledge</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.knowledge}/150</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Expression/Enthusiasm</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.expression}/125</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Overall Quality</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.overallQuality}/125</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Organization</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.organization}/100</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Clarity & Conciseness</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.clarity}/50</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Ability to Hold Interest</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.interest}/50</Text></View>
              <View style={styles.row}><Text style={styles.label}>Equal Participation</Text><Text style={styles.value}>{result.participation}/50</Text></View>
          </View>
        
            {result.strengths && result.strengths.length > 0 && (
                <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                    <Text style={[styles.sectionHeader, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
                    {result.strengths.map((s: string, i: number) => (
                        <View key={i} style={styles.bulletRow}>
                            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={18} color={Colors.success} />
                            <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                        </View>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}

            {result.improvements && result.improvements.length > 0 && (
                <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                    <Text style={[styles.sectionHeader, { color: Colors.warning }]}>Improvements</Text>
                    {result.improvements.map((s: string, i: number) => (
                        <View key={i} style={styles.bulletRow}>
                            <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={18} color={Colors.warning} />
                            <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                        </View>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}

        </View>
      ) : (
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>No score data available.</Text>
      )}

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.homeBtn} onPress={() => {
        if (result) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'ag-advocacy',
                score: result.totalScore,
                maxScore: 1000,
                details: result
            });
        }
        router.push('/');
      }}>
        <Text style={styles.btnText}>Return Home</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      
      <View style={{height: 40}} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TextInput, Alert, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { AG_ISSUES_TOPICS } from '@/lib/data/ag-issues';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function AgIssuesSetup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState('');
  const [teamSize, setTeamSize] = useState('3-7');

  const startPortfolio = () => {
    console.log("startPortfolio pressed, topic:", topic);
    if (!topic.trim()) {
        Alert.alert("Topic Required", "Please enter your issue topic.");
        return;
    }
    try {
        router.push({
            pathname: '/practice/ag-issues/portfolio',
            params: { topic: topic.trim() }
        });
        console.log("Navigating to portfolio...");
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Navigation error:", e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'} style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }}>
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} style={styles.header}>
        <Ionicons name="people-circle-outline" size={56} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
        <Text style={styles.title}>AG ISSUES FORUM</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>PRESENT PROS & CONS OF AN AG ISSUE</Text>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>YOUR ISSUE TOPIC</Text>
          <Text style={styles.text}>
            Enter the issue your team is presenting (e.g., "Water Rights", "Labor Shortages").
            The AI will generate questions for both sides.
          </Text>
          
          <TextInput
              style={styles.input}
              placeholder="ENTER ISSUE TOPIC..."
              value={topic}
              onChangeText={setTopic}
              placeholderTextColor={Theme.colors.text.muted}
          />
          
          <Text style={[styles.cardTitle, {marginTop: 24}]}>SUGGESTED TOPICS</Text>
          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={styles.topicsScroll} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 4 }}>
              {AG_ISSUES_TOPICS.map((t, i) => (
                  <TouchableOpacity key={i} style={styles.topicChip} onPress={() => setTopic(t)}>
                      <Text style={styles.topicText}>{t.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.glass]}>
          <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>CONTEST STRUCTURE</Text>
          <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
              <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <Text style={styles.ruleText}>PORTFOLIO (95 PTS) - SUBMIT SUMMARY</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
              <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <Text style={styles.ruleText}>PRESENTATION: 15 MINUTES MAX</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
              <Ionicons name="help-circle-outline" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <Text style={styles.ruleText}>Q&A: 5 MINUTES (DISTRICT/AREA)</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.ruleRow}>
              <Ionicons name="people-outline" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <Text style={styles.ruleText}>TEAM: 3-7 MEMBERS</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </motion.div>
      
      <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startBtn} onPress={startPortfolio}>
          <Text style={styles.btnText}>NEXT: PORTFOLIO CHECK</Text>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={22} color={Theme.colors.black} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </motion.div>
      
      <View style={{height: 60}} />
    </ScrollView>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

<file path="app/practice/ag-issues/portfolio.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { PORTFOLIO_TIPS } from '@/lib/data/ag-issues';
import * as DocumentPicker from 'expo-document-picker';

export default function AgIssuesPortfolio() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { topic } = useLocalSearchParams<{ topic: string }>();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<DocumentPicker.DocumentPickerAsset | null>(null);

  const pickDocument = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
        type: ['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', 'text/plain'],
        copyToCacheDirectory: true,
      });

      if (result.canceled) return;

      if (result.assets && result.assets.length > 0) {
        setFile(result.assets[0]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Document picking error:", err);
      Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to pick document.");
    }
  };
  
  const startRecording = () => {
    if (!file) {
        Alert.alert("Portfolio Required", "Please upload your portfolio document (PDF/Word/Text) before proceeding.");
        return;
    }
    
    // Pass file details to next screen
    // Note: We can't easily read PDF text in Expo Go without native modules, 
    // so we'll pass the metadata for the record screen to handle.
    router.push({
        pathname: '/practice/ag-issues/record',
        params: { 
            topic: topic,
            portfolioUri: file.uri,
            portfolioName: file.name
        }
    });
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Ionicons name="folder-open-outline" size={40} color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.title}>Portfolio Check</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Topic: {topic}</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.tipsCard}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Portfolio Tips (Research)</Text>
        {PORTFOLIO_TIPS.map((tip, i) => (
            <View key={i} style={styles.tipItem}>
                <Text style={styles.tipTitle}>• {tip.title}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.tipContent}>{tip.content}</Text>
            </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.inputCard}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Upload Portfolio Document</Text>
        <Text style={styles.text}>
           Upload your 5-page portfolio (PDF, Doc, or Text) to simulate the submission process. 
           The AI will primarily grade your presentation transcript, but checks for portfolio presence.
        </Text>
        
        {file ? (
            <View style={styles.filePreview}>
                <Ionicons name="document-text" size={32} color={Colors.navy} />
                <View style={{flex: 1}}>
                    <Text style={styles.fileName}>{file.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.fileSize}>{(file.size ? file.size / 1024 : 0).toFixed(1)} KB</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setFile(null)}>
                    <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={24} color="#D32F2F" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        ) : (
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.uploadBtn} onPress={pickDocument}>
                <Ionicons name="cloud-upload-outline" size={32} color={Colors.navy} />
                <Text style={styles.uploadText}>Select Document</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={[styles.startBtn, !file && {backgroundColor: '#ccc'}]} 
        onPress={startRecording}
        disabled={!file}
      >
        <Text style={styles.btnText}>Proceed to Presentation</Text>
        <Ionicons name="videocam" size={20} color="white" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
      
      <View style={{height: 40}} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5', padding: 20 },
  header: { alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20, marginTop: 10 },
  title: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginTop: 5 },
  subtitle: { fontSize: 16, color: '#666', marginTop: 2, fontStyle: 'italic' },
  
  tipsCard: { backgroundColor: '#FFF8E1', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 20, borderLeftWidth: 4, borderLeftColor: '#F2A900' },
  cardTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 12 },
  tipItem: { marginBottom: 12 },
  tipTitle: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 'bold', color: '#333' },
  tipContent: { fontSize: 14, color: '#555', marginLeft: 10, marginTop: 2, lineHeight: 20 },
  
  inputCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 20 },
  text: { fontSize: 14, color: '#666', marginBottom: 15, lineHeight: 20 },
  
  uploadBtn: { borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#ddd', borderStyle: 'dashed', borderRadius: 12, padding: 30, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: '#fafafa' },
  uploadText: { marginTop: 10, fontSize: 16, color: Colors.navy, fontWeight: '600' },
  
  filePreview: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: '#E3F2FD', padding: 15, borderRadius: 8, gap: 15 },

  startBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 18, borderRadius: 12, gap: 10, marginBottom: 40 },
  btnText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold' }
});

<file path="app/practice/ag-issues/record.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Platform, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions, useMicrophonePermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { generateAgIssuesQuestions, analyzeAgIssuesPresentation } from '../../../lib/scoring/ag-issues';
import { transcribeAudio } from '@/lib/ai/whisper';

type Phase = 'setup' | 'presentation' | 'questions' | 'processing';

export default function AgIssuesRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { topic, summary, portfolioUri, portfolioName } = useLocalSearchParams<{ topic: string, summary?: string, portfolioUri?: string, portfolioName?: string }>();

  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [micPermission, requestMicPermission] = useMicrophonePermissions();

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('setup');
  const phaseRef = useRef<Phase>(phase);
  
  useEffect(() => { phaseRef.current = phase; }, [phase]);

  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingQuestions, setIsLoadingQuestions] = useState(false);
  const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);

  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Generate questions in background
    const loadQuestions = async () => {
        setIsLoadingQuestions(true);
        const q = await generateAgIssuesQuestions(topic || "Ag Issue");
        setQuestions(q);
        setIsLoadingQuestions(false);
    };
    loadQuestions();
    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  }, [topic]);

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    if (recording) return;

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
            const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
            chunksRef.current = [];
            
            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data); };
            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
                const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                setVideoUri(url);
                if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') processSubmission(url);
                stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            };
            mediaRecorder.start();
            setRecording(true);
            setSeconds(0);
            timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            Alert.alert("Error", "Could not access camera/mic");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!cameraRef.current) return;
    try {
        setRecording(true);
        setSeconds(0);
        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({ maxDuration: 1200 }); // 20 mins
        if (video) {
            setVideoUri(video.uri);
            if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') processSubmission(video.uri);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        setRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') mediaRecorderRef.current?.stop();
    else cameraRef.current?.stopRecording();
    setRecording(false);
    clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  };

  const nextPhase = () => {
      if (phase === 'setup') {
          setPhase('presentation');
          startRecording();
      } else if (phase === 'presentation') {
          setPhase('questions');
          setSeconds(0); // Reset timer for Q&A (5 mins)
      } else if (phase === 'questions') {
          finishContest();
      }
  };

  const finishContest = () => {
      phaseRef.current = 'processing';
      setPhase('processing');
      stopRecording();
  };

  const processSubmission = async (uri: string) => {
      try {
          const apiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2;
          if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Missing API Key");

          let transcript = "";
          try {
             const result = await transcribeAudio(uri, apiKey);
             transcript = result.text;
          } catch (tErr) {
             console.error("Transcription failed:", tErr);
          }

          // Construct a summary string based on file presence
          let contextText = summary || "";
          if (!contextText && portfolioUri) {
             contextText = `[User uploaded portfolio document: "${portfolioName || 'Portfolio.pdf'}"]. 
             The user has provided a file instead of a text summary. 
             Please Assume the portfolio is present and follows basic formatting rules (Cover, Summary, Bibliography).
             Grade the portfolio section leniently (giving credit for submission), but focus detailed critique on the transcribed presentation content.`;
          }

          const score = await analyzeAgIssuesPresentation(transcript, contextText, questions);
          
          router.push({
              pathname: '/practice/ag-issues/result',
              params: {
                  score: JSON.stringify(score),
                  videoUri: uri
              }
          });
      } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
          Alert.alert("Error", "Scoring failed.");
          router.back();
      }
  };

  if (!permission?.granted || !micPermission?.granted) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <Text style={styles.permTitle}>Permissions Required</Text>
              <Text style={styles.permSub}>We need access to your camera and microphone to record your presentation.</Text>
              
              {!permission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="camera" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Camera Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
              
              {!micPermission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestMicPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="mic" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Microphone Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
          </View>
      );
  }

  if (phase === 'processing') {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={{ marginTop: 20, fontSize: 18, color: Colors.navy }}>Judging Presentation & Portfolio...</Text>
          </View>
      );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <CameraView style={styles.camera} ref={cameraRef}>
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
            <View style={styles.timerBadge}>
                <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: recording ? 'red' : 'gray' }]} />
                <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(seconds)}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.targetBadge}>{phase === 'presentation' ? '15 Min Max' : '5 Min Q&A'}</Text>
        </View>

        {phase === 'setup' && (
            <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Ag Issues Forum</Text>
                <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{topic}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.info}>Presentation: 15 Min | Q&A: 5 Min</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Presentation</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'presentation' && (
            <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>End Presentation & Start Q&A</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={24} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'questions' && (
             <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Question {currentQIndex + 1}/5</Text>
                {isLoadingQuestions ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                ) : (
                    <View style={styles.qCard}>
                        <Text style={styles.qText}>{questions[currentQIndex] || "Loading Question..."}</Text>
                    </View>
                )}
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={() => {
                    if (currentQIndex < 4) setCurrentQIndex(i => i + 1);
                    else nextPhase();
                }}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>{currentQIndex < 4 ? "Next Question" : "Finish Contest"}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
             </View>
        )}
      </CameraView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'black' },
  centered: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20 },
  camera: { flex: 1 },
  topBar: { paddingTop: 60, alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  timerBadge: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 10, borderRadius: 20, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', borderWidth: 2, borderColor: 'white' },
  dot: { width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 6, marginRight: 8 },
  timerText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold' },
  targetBadge: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', padding: 5, borderRadius: 4 },
  centerOverlay: { position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: 20 },
  bottomOverlay: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, left: 0, right: 0, alignItems: 'center' },
  title: { color: 'white', fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, textAlign: 'center' },
  subtitle: { color: Colors.gold, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 20 },
  info: { color: '#DDD', marginBottom: 30 },
  startBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, paddingHorizontal: 40, paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 30 },
  nextBtn: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', paddingHorizontal: 30, paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 30, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'white', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  btnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 18 },
  qCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 30, width: '100%' },
  qText: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, textAlign: 'center' },
  
  // Permissions
  permTitle: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 10 },
  permSub: { fontSize: 16, color: '#666', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 30, paddingHorizontal: 40 },

});

import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { AgIssuesScore } from '@/lib/scoring/ag-issues';
import ScoreCircle from '@/components/ScoreCircle';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function AgIssuesResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { score } = useLocalSearchParams<{ score: string }>();
  const result: AgIssuesScore = score ? JSON.parse(score) : null;

  if (!result) return <View><Text>Error loading score</Text></View>;

  const portfolioScore = 
    result.portfolioCover + result.portfolioSummary + result.portfolioBibliography + 
    result.portfolioGrammar + result.portfolioRelevance + result.portfolioForums + 
    result.portfolioCreativity;

  const presentationScore = 
    result.intro + result.proViewpoint + result.conViewpoint + 
    result.summary + result.effectiveness;

  const questionsScore = 
    result.questionsQuality + result.questionsParticipation;

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Contest Results</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Ag Issues Forum</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.scoreSection}>
        <ScoreCircle percentage={Math.round((result.totalScore / 995) * 100)} size={140} label="Total Score" color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.totalPoints}>{result.totalScore} / 995 Pts</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>1. Portfolio (95 pts)</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Cover Info</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioCover}/10</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Summary Quality</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioSummary}/20</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Bibliography</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioBibliography}/10</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Grammar</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioGrammar}/5</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Relevance</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioRelevance}/5</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Local Forums</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioForums}/20</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Creativity</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.portfolioCreativity}/25</Text></View>
        <View style={[styles.row, styles.totalRow]}><Text style={styles.bold}>Total Portfolio</Text><Text style={styles.bold}>{portfolioScore}/95</Text></View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>2. Presentation (650 pts)</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Introduction</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.intro}/100</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Pro Viewpoint</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.proViewpoint}/200</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Con Viewpoint</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.conViewpoint}/200</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Summary</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.summary}/100</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Effectiveness</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.effectiveness}/50</Text></View>
        <View style={[styles.row, styles.totalRow]}><Text style={styles.bold}>Total Presentation</Text><Text style={styles.bold}>{presentationScore}/650</Text></View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>3. Questions (250 pts)</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Quality of Answers</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.questionsQuality}/200</Text></View>
        <View style={styles.row}><Text>Participation</Text><Text style={styles.pts}>{result.questionsParticipation}/50</Text></View>
        <View style={[styles.row, styles.totalRow]}><Text style={styles.bold}>Total Questions</Text><Text style={styles.bold}>{questionsScore}/250</Text></View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>AI Feedback</Text>
        <Text style={styles.text}>{result.feedback}</Text>
        
        <Text style={[styles.cardTitle, {fontSize: 16, marginTop: 10}]}>Strengths</Text>
        {result.strengths.map((s, i) => <Text key={i} style={styles.bullet}>• {s}</Text>)}
        
        <Text style={[styles.cardTitle, {fontSize: 16, marginTop: 10}]}>Improvements</Text>
        {result.improvements.map((s, i) => <Text key={i} style={styles.bullet}>• {s}</Text>)}
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btn} onPress={() => {
        if (result) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'ag-issues',
                score: result.totalScore,
                maxScore: 995,
                details: result
            });
        }
        router.navigate('/(tabs)/lde');
      }}>
        <Text style={styles.btnText}>Return to LDE List</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      <View style={{height: 40}} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5', padding: 20 },
  header: { alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20, marginTop: 10 },
  title: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  subtitle: { fontSize: 16, color: '#666' },
  scoreSection: { alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20 },
  totalPoints: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginTop: 10 },
  card: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 15, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 15 },
  cardTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 10 },
  row: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingVertical: 6, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#f0f0f0' },
  totalRow: { borderTopWidth: 2, borderTopColor: '#eee', paddingTop: 10, marginTop: 5, borderBottomWidth: 0 },
  pts: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '600', color: '#444' },
  bold: { fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 15 },
  text: { fontSize: 14, color: '#444', lineHeight: 20 },
  bullet: { fontSize: 14, color: '#444', marginLeft: 10, marginTop: 4 },
  btn: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, padding: 15, borderRadius: 10, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 30 },
  btnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 16 }
});

<file path="app/practice/ag-skills/record.tsx">
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Alert, Platform, ActivityIndicator
} from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { analyzeAgSkillsVideo } from '@/lib/scoring/ag-skills';

type Stage = 'prep' | 'recording' | 'review';

export default function AgSkillsRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('prep');
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'front' | 'back'>('back'); // Default to back for demonstrations
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  
  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  
  // Web fallback refs
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const getTimerColor = (secs: number) => {
    if (secs < 600) return '#F2A900'; // Under 10m (Warning)
    if (secs <= 1200) return '#4CAF50'; // 10-20m (Good)
    return '#D32F2F'; // Over 20m (Penalty)
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    // Web Fallback
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
            audio: true, 
            video: { facingMode: facing === 'front' ? 'user' : 'environment' } 
        });
        
        const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
        mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
        chunksRef.current = [];

        mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
          if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        };

        mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
          const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
          console.log("Recording stopped. MIME:", mimeType);
          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          setVideoUri(url);
          setStage('review');
          stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        };

        mediaRecorder.start();
        setRecording(true);
        setElapsedSeconds(0);
        setStage('recording');

        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
          setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
        }, 1000);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Web Recording Error:", err);
        window.alert("Failed to access camera/mic.");
      }
      return;
    }

    // Native Recording
    if (!cameraRef.current) return;

    try {
      setRecording(true);
      setElapsedSeconds(0);
      setStage('recording');

      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);

      const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({
        maxDuration: 1300,
        quality: '480p',
        mute: false,
      } as any);

      console.log('Recording finished, URI:', video.uri);
      if (video && video.uri) {
        setVideoUri(video.uri);
        setStage('review');
      } else {
        throw new Error('No video URI returned');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Recording error:', err);
      Alert.alert('Recording Failed', err.message || 'Failed to populate video.');
      setStage('prep');
    } finally {
        if ((Platform.OS as string) !== 'web') setRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (mediaRecorderRef.current?.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorderRef.current?.stop();
        }
        setRecording(false);
    } else {
        cameraRef.current?.stopRecording();
    }
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!videoUri) {
        Alert.alert("Error", "No video recorded. Please retake.");
        return;
    }
    
    console.log("Submitting video for analysis:", videoUri);
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
        console.log("Calling analyzeAgSkillsVideo...");
        const results = await analyzeAgSkillsVideo(videoUri, elapsedSeconds);
        console.log("Analysis Result:", results);
        
        if (!results) throw new Error("Analysis returned null results");

        router.push({
            pathname: '/practice/ag-skills/result',
            params: { 
                results: JSON.stringify(results),
                videoUri: videoUri 
            }
        });
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Submission Error:", error);
        Alert.alert("Analysis Failed", error.message || "Could not score the demonstration. Please try again.");
    } finally {
        setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (!permission?.granted) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Camera Access Required</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.button} onPress={requestPermission}>
          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Grant Access</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {stage === 'prep' && (
        <View style={styles.prepContainer}>
            <View style={styles.cameraPreview}>
                <CameraView 
                    ref={cameraRef}
                    style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} 
                    facing={facing}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity 
                    style={styles.flipButton} 
                    onPress={() => setFacing(current => current === 'front' ? 'back' : 'front')}
                >
                    <Ionicons name="camera-reverse" size={28} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.controls}>
                <Text style={styles.instruction}>
                    Position camera to show the skill clearly.
                    Target: 10-20 minutes.
                </Text>

                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.recordButton} onPress={startRecording}>
                    <View style={styles.recordButtonInner} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {stage === 'recording' && (
        <View style={styles.recordingContainer}>
            <CameraView 
                ref={cameraRef}
                style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} 
                facing={facing}
            />
            
            <View style={styles.overlay}>
                <View style={[styles.timerBadge, { backgroundColor: getTimerColor(elapsedSeconds) }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(elapsedSeconds)}</Text>
                </View>
                
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.stopButton} onPress={stopRecording}>
                    <View style={styles.stopButtonSquare} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {stage === 'review' && (
        <View style={styles.reviewContainer}>
            <Text style={styles.reviewTitle}>Review Demonstration</Text>
            
            {/* Video Player Removed per user request */}
            <View style={[styles.videoPlaceholder, { backgroundColor: '#222', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }]}>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle-outline" size={64} color="#4CAF50" />
                <Text style={{color: 'white', marginTop: 10}}>Video Recorded Successfully</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.reviewControls}>
                <TouchableOpacity 
                    style={styles.secondaryButton} 
                    onPress={() => { setStage('prep'); setVideoUri(null); }}
                    disabled={isProcessing}
                >
                    <Text style={styles.secondaryButtonText}>Retake</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity 
                    style={[styles.primaryButton, isProcessing && styles.disabledButton]} 
                    onPress={handleSubmit}
                    disabled={isProcessing}
                >
                    {isProcessing ? (
                        <ActivityIndicator color="white" />
                    ) : (
                        <Text style={styles.primaryButtonText}>Submit for Scoring</Text>
                    )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  title: {
    color: 'white',
    fontSize: 24,
    marginBottom: 20,
    textAlign: 'center',
    marginTop: 100,
  },
  button: {
    backgroundColor: '#003366',
    padding: 16,
    borderRadius: 8,
    alignSelf: 'center',
  },
  buttonText: {
    color: 'white',
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
  },
  prepContainer: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  cameraPreview: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#333',
    borderRadius: 20,
    margin: 16,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
  flipButton: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 20,
    right: 20,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
    padding: 10,
    borderRadius: 25,
  },
  controls: {
    height: 180,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  instruction: {
    color: '#ccc',
    marginBottom: 24,
    textAlign: 'center',
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  recordButton: {
    width: 80,
    height: 80,
    borderRadius: 40,
    borderColor: 'white',
    borderWidth: 4,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
