import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { AgSkillsAnalysis } from '@/lib/scoring/ag-skills';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function AgSkillsResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const results = params.results ? JSON.parse(params.results as string) as AgSkillsAnalysis : null;
  const videoUri = params.videoUri as string;

  if (!results) return null;

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 900) return Colors.success;
    if (score >= 800) return Colors.warning;
    return Colors.error;
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Skills Analysis', headerBackVisible: false }} />
      
      {/* Video Replay Section */}
      {/* Video Replay Section */}
      {videoUri && (
        <View style={styles.videoContainer}>
            {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
                <>
                    <video 
                        src={videoUri} 
                        controls 
                        playsInline
                        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', backgroundColor: 'black' }} 
                        onError={(e) => {
                            console.error("Web Video Error:", e);
                            const target = e.target as HTMLVideoElement;
                            console.error("Video Error Code:", target.error?.code, target.error?.message);
                        }}
                    />
                    {/* Web Debug Overlay */}
                    <Text style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 5, right: 5, color: 'lime', fontSize: 10, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: 2 }}>
                        WEB PLAYBACK
                    </Text>
                </>
            ) : (
                <Video
                    source={{ uri: videoUri }}
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
                    useNativeControls
                    resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
                    shouldPlay={false}
                    onError={(e) => console.error("Native Playback Error:", e)}
                />
            )}
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.scoreCard}>
        <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>Final Score</Text>
        <Text style={[styles.scoreValue, { color: getScoreColor(results.score) }]}>
            {results.score}<Text style={styles.scoreMax}>/1000</Text>
        </Text>
        
        <View style={styles.breakdownContainer}>
            <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Part I: Explanation</Text>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownValue}>{results.rubricBreakdown.explanation}/300</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Part II: Performance</Text>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownValue}>{results.rubricBreakdown.performance}/700</Text>
            </View>
            {results.timePenalty > 0 && (
                <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
                    <Text style={[styles.breakdownLabel, { color: Colors.error }]}>Time Penalty</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.breakdownValue, { color: Colors.error }]}>-{results.timePenalty}</Text>
                </View>
            )}
        </View>
        
        <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>
            Duration: {Math.floor(results.durationSeconds / 60)}:{(Math.floor(results.durationSeconds) % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Judge's Feedback</Text>
        <View style={styles.feedbackCard}>
            <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{results.feedback}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.row}>
        <View style={[styles.column, { marginRight: 8 }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
            {results.strengths.map((item, i) => (
                <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={16} color={Colors.success} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{item}</Text>
                </View>
            ))}
        </View>
        <View style={[styles.column, { marginLeft: 8 }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.warning }]}>Improvements</Text>
            {results.improvements.map((item, i) => (
                <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-up-circle" size={16} color={Colors.warning} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{item}</Text>
                </View>
            ))}
        </View>
      </View>
      
      {/* Transcript (Hidden by default or smaller) */}
      <View style={styles.section}>
         <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Transcript</Text>
         <Text style={styles.transcriptText}>{results.transcript}</Text>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={styles.doneButton} 
        onPress={() => {
            if (results) {
                useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                    type: 'ag-skills',
                    score: results.score,
                    maxScore: 1000,
                    details: results,
                    metadata: {
                        duration: results.durationSeconds
                    }
                });
            }
            router.dismissTo('/(tabs)/lde');
        }}
      >
        <Text style={styles.doneButtonText}>Done</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

<file path="app/practice/chapter-conducting/prompt.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { MOTIONS, MAIN_MOTIONS, Motion } from '@/lib/data/chapter-conducting';

export default function ChapterConductingPrompt() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { division } = useLocalSearchParams<{ division: 'greenhand' | 'senior' }>();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [mainMotion, setMainMotion] = useState('');
  const [requiredMotions, setRequiredMotions] = useState<Motion[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    generatePrompt();
  }, []);

  const generatePrompt = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    
    // 1. Pick Random Main Motion
    const randomMain = MAIN_MOTIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * MAIN_MOTIONS.length)];
    setMainMotion(randomMain);

    // 2. Pick Random Required Motions based on Division
    // Greenhand: usually 3-4 motions from their allowed list
    // Senior: usually 4-5 motions from the full list
    // (Simplification: We will pick 4 unique motions for now)
    
    const allowedMotions = MOTIONS.filter(m => m.requiredIn.includes(division || 'senior') && m.class !== 'Main');
    
    const shuffled = [...allowedMotions].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const selected = shuffled.slice(0, 4); // Pick 4
    
    setRequiredMotions(selected);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const startMeeting = (mode: 'practice' | 'full_contest') => {
    router.push({
        pathname: '/practice/chapter-conducting/record',
        params: { 
            division,
            mode,
            problem: JSON.stringify({
                mainMotion,
                requiredMotions
            })
        }
    });
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>{division === 'greenhand' ? 'Greenhand' : 'Senior'} Problem</Text>
        <Text style={styles.headerSubtitle}>Here is your scenario for this meeting.</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <View style={styles.section}>
            <Text style={styles.label}>MAIN MOTION</Text>
            <Text style={styles.mainMotionText}>"{mainMotion}"</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.divider} />

        <View style={styles.section}>
            <Text style={styles.label}>REQUIRED MOTIONS</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtext}>Perform these in any logical order:</Text>
            
            {requiredMotions.map((m, i) => (
                <View key={i} style={styles.motionItem}>
                    <View style={styles.bullet} />
                    <Text style={styles.motionName}>{m.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.motionClass}>{m.class}</Text>
                </View>
            ))}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.actions}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.refreshButton} onPress={generatePrompt}>
            <Ionicons name="refresh" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
            <Text style={styles.refreshText}>New Problem</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={() => startMeeting('practice')}>
            <Text style={styles.startText}>Quick Timer</Text>
            <Ionicons name="timer-outline" size={24} color={Colors.white} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.fullContestButton} onPress={() => startMeeting('full_contest')}>
        <View style={styles.fullContestContent}>
            <Ionicons name="trophy" size={24} color={Colors.white} />
            <View>
                <Text style={styles.fullContestTitle}>Start Full Contest Mode</Text>
                <Text style={styles.fullContestSub}>Opening • Business • Closing • Questions • AI Grading</Text>
            </View>
            <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={Colors.white} />
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  content: { padding: 20 },
  header: { marginBottom: 20, marginTop: 10 },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  headerSubtitle: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginTop: 5 },
  card: { backgroundColor: Colors.white, borderRadius: 16, padding: 24, paddingVertical: 32, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.1, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 4 },
  section: { marginBottom: 10 },
  label: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.textLight, letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 },
  mainMotionText: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, lineHeight: 30, fontStyle: 'italic' },
  divider: { height: 1, backgroundColor: '#EEE', marginVertical: 24 },
  subtext: { fontSize: 14, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 16 },
  motionItem: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 },
  bullet: { width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: Colors.gold, marginRight: 12 },

  refreshButton: { flex: 1, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: Colors.white, padding: 18, borderRadius: 14, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#DDD' },
  refreshText: { marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600', color: Colors.navy },
  startButton: { flex: 2, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: Colors.navy, padding: 18, borderRadius: 14 },

<file path="app/practice/chapter-conducting/questions.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { PARLIAMENTARY_QUESTIONS } from '@/lib/data/chapter-conducting';

export default function ChapterConductingQuestions() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    // Pick 5 random questions
    const shuffled = [...PARLIAMENTARY_QUESTIONS].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    setQuestions(shuffled.slice(0, 5));
  }, []);

  const toggleReveal = (id: string) => {
    setRevealed(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  };

  const finish = () => {
    router.push({
        pathname: '/practice/chapter-conducting/result',
        params: { ...params } // Pass all data to result
    });
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Oral Questions</Text>
      <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Tap a card to reveal the answer.</Text>

      {questions.map((q, i) => (
        <TouchableOpacity key={i} style={styles.card} onPress={() => toggleReveal(q.id)}>
            <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
                <Text style={styles.questionNum}>Question {i + 1}</Text>
                <Ionicons name={revealed[q.id] ? "eye-off" : "eye"} size={20} color={Colors.textLight} />
            </View>
            
            <Text style={styles.questionText}>{q.question}</Text>
            
            {revealed[q.id] && (
                <View style={styles.answerBox}>
                    <Text style={styles.answerLabel}>ANSWER:</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.answerText}>{q.answer}</Text>
                </View>
            )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ))}

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.finishButton} onPress={finish}>
         <Text style={styles.finishText}>Finish & See Results</Text>
         <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color="white" />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  content: { padding: 20 },
  title: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 5 },
  subtitle: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 20 },
  card: { backgroundColor: Colors.white, padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 }, shadowOpacity: 0.1, shadowRadius: 4, elevation: 2 },
  cardHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 },
  questionNum: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.gold, textTransform: 'uppercase' },
  questionText: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600', color: Colors.text, lineHeight: 24 },
  answerBox: { marginTop: 16, paddingTop: 16, borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: '#EEE', backgroundColor: '#F9F9F9', marginHorizontal: -20, marginBottom: -20, paddingHorizontal: 20, paddingBottom: 20, borderBottomLeftRadius: 12, borderBottomRightRadius: 12 },
  answerLabel: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.success, marginBottom: 4 },
  answerText: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.text, fontStyle: 'italic', lineHeight: 24 },
  finishButton: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 18, borderRadius: 14, marginTop: 20, gap: 10 },
  finishText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold' },
});

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Platform, Alert, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions, useMicrophonePermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { RULES, Motion, PARLIAMENTARY_QUESTIONS } from '@/lib/data/chapter-conducting';
import { analyzeChapterConducting } from '@/lib/scoring/chapter-conducting';
import { transcribeAudio } from '@/lib/ai/whisper';

type Phase = 'setup' | 'opening' | 'business' | 'closing' | 'questions' | 'processing';

export default function ChapterConductingRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { division, problem, mode } = useLocalSearchParams<{ 
    division: 'greenhand' | 'senior', 
    problem: string,
    mode: 'practice' | 'full_contest' 
  }>();
  
  const parsedProblem = problem ? JSON.parse(problem) : { mainMotion: '', requiredMotions: [] };
  const rules = RULES[division || 'senior'];
  const isFullContest = mode === 'full_contest';
  
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [micPermission, requestMicPermission] = useMicrophonePermissions();
  
  // State Machine
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(isFullContest ? 'setup' : 'business');
  const phaseRef = useRef<Phase>(phase); // Ref to access current phase in async closures

  useEffect(() => {
    phaseRef.current = phase;
  }, [phase]);
  
  // Recording State
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(0); // For Business Phase
  const [totalSeconds, setTotalSeconds] = useState(0); // Total recording time
  
  // Data State
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [completedMotions, setCompletedMotions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [quizQuestions, setQuizQuestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);

  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Load Questions on mount
    const shuffled = [...PARLIAMENTARY_QUESTIONS].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    setQuizQuestions(shuffled.slice(0, 5));
    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  }, []);

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const getTimerColor = () => {
    if (elapsedSeconds > rules.timeLimit) return Colors.error;
    if (elapsedSeconds >= rules.warnTime) return Colors.warning;
    return Colors.white;
  };

  // --- ACTIONS ---

  const startRecording = async () => {
    if (recording) return;

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
            const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
            chunksRef.current = [];
            
            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data); };
            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
                const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                setVideoUri(url);
                
                // If it was a successful full contest, process it
                if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                   await processSubmission(blob, url);
                } else {
                    // Manual stop in practice mode
                    goToLegacyResults(url);
                }
                
                stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            };
            
            mediaRecorder.start();
            setRecording(true);
            startTimer();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            Alert.alert("Error", "Could not access camera/mic");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!cameraRef.current) return;
    try {
        setRecording(true);
        startTimer();
        const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({ maxDuration: isFullContest ? 1800 : rules.timeLimit + 60 } as any);
        if (video) {
            setVideoUri(video.uri);
            console.log('Recording finished. Current phase:', phaseRef.current);
            if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                await processSubmission(null, video.uri); // Native processing
            } else {
                 console.log('Not in processing phase, going to legacy results');
                 goToLegacyResults(video.uri);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Recording Error:", e);
        setRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        mediaRecorderRef.current?.stop();
    } else {
        cameraRef.current?.stopRecording();
    }
    setRecording(false);
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  };

  const startTimer = () => {
    setElapsedSeconds(0);
    setTotalSeconds(0);
    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setTotalSeconds(t => t + 1);
        // Only increment business timer in business phase
        setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1); 
    }, 1000);
  };

  const nextPhase = () => {
      switch(phase) {
          case 'setup': setPhase('opening'); break;
          case 'opening': 
            setPhase('business'); 
            setElapsedSeconds(0); // Reset business timer
            break;
          case 'business': setPhase('closing'); break;
          case 'closing': setPhase('questions'); break;
          case 'questions': finishContest(); break;
      }
  };

  const finishContest = () => {
      setPhase('processing');
      stopRecording(); // Trigger processing in onStop
  };

  const processSubmission = async (webBlob: Blob | null, uri: string) => {
    // 1. Transcribe
    // 2. Score
    // 3. Navigate
    try {
        let transcript = "";
        // Mock transcription for now or implement real one if API key exists
        // (Assuming transcribeAudio handles file URI or Blob)
        // For this demo, we'll try real transcription if it works, or fallback.
        
        // TODO: Hook up real transcription
        transcript = "[Simulated Transcript of Opening, Business, and Questions]";

        const score = await analyzeChapterConducting(transcript, parsedProblem, quizQuestions);
        
        router.push({
            pathname: '/practice/chapter-conducting/result_v2',
            params: {
                score: JSON.stringify(score),
                videoUri: uri
            }
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to process submission.");
        // Fallback to basic result
        goToLegacyResults(uri);
    }
  };

  const goToLegacyResults = (uri: string) => {
      router.push({
        pathname: '/practice/chapter-conducting/result',
        params: {
            videoUri: uri,
            duration: elapsedSeconds.toString(),
            motions: JSON.stringify(completedMotions)
        }
    });
  };

  // --- UI COMPONENTS ---

  const renderOverlay = () => {
      if (!isFullContest) {
          // Classic Practice Mode Overlay
        return (
            <>
                <View style={styles.checklistContainer}>
                    <Text style={styles.checklistTitle}>Checklist:</Text>
                    {parsedProblem.requiredMotions.map((m: Motion, i: number) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity key={i} style={styles.checkItem} onPress={() => toggleMotion(m.name)}>
                            <Ionicons 
                                name={completedMotions.includes(m.name) ? "checkbox" : "square-outline"} 
                                size={24} 
                                color={completedMotions.includes(m.name) ? Colors.success : Colors.white} 
                            />
                            <Text style={[styles.checkText, completedMotions.includes(m.name) && styles.strikeText]}>
                                {m.name}
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
                {!recording && <TouchableOpacity style={styles.recordBtn} onPress={startRecording}><View style={styles.recordInner} /></TouchableOpacity>}
                {recording && <TouchableOpacity style={styles.stopBtn} onPress={finishContest}><View style={styles.stopInner} /></TouchableOpacity>}
            </>
        );
      }

      // FULL CONTEST OVERLAY
      switch(phase) {
          case 'setup':
              return (
                  <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                      <Text style={styles.phaseTitle}>Ready to Record?</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.phaseSub}>Ensure you have 20 minutes interruption-free.</Text>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryBtn} onPress={() => { setPhase('opening'); startRecording(); }}>
                          <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Contest</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
              );
          case 'opening':
              return (
                  <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                      <Text style={styles.phaseLabel}>PHASE: OPENING CEREMONIES</Text>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                          <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Business Meeting</Text>
                          <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
              );
          case 'business':
              return (
                   <View style={styles.fullScreenOverlay}>
                        <View style={styles.checklistContainer}>
                            <Text style={styles.checklistTitle}>Required Motions:</Text>
                            {parsedProblem.requiredMotions.map((m: Motion, i: number) => (
                                <TouchableOpacity key={i} style={styles.checkItem} onPress={() => toggleMotion(m.name)}>
                                    <Ionicons name={completedMotions.includes(m.name) ? "checkbox" : "square-outline"} size={24} color={completedMotions.includes(m.name) ? Colors.success : Colors.white} />
                                    <Text style={[styles.checkText, completedMotions.includes(m.name) && styles.strikeText]}>{m.name}</Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                        <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                           <Text style={styles.phaseLabel}>PHASE: BUSINESS MEETING</Text>
                           <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                              <Text style={styles.btnText}>Close Meeting</Text>
                              <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
                           </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>
                   </View>
              );
          case 'closing':
               return (
                  <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                      <Text style={styles.phaseLabel}>PHASE: CLOSING CEREMONIES</Text>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                          <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Questions</Text>
                          <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
              );
          case 'questions':
              const q = quizQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
              return (
                  <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                      <Text style={styles.phaseTitle}>Question {currentQuestionIndex + 1}/5</Text>
                      <View style={styles.questionCard}>
                          <Text style={styles.questionText}>{q?.question}</Text>
                      </View>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryBtn} onPress={() => {
                          if (currentQuestionIndex < 4) setCurrentQuestionIndex(prev => prev + 1);
                          else nextPhase();
                      }}>
                          <Text style={styles.btnText}>{currentQuestionIndex < 4 ? 'Next Question' : 'Finish Contest'}</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
              );
      }
  };

  const toggleMotion = (name: string) => {
    if (completedMotions.includes(name)) {
        setCompletedMotions(completedMotions.filter(m => m !== name));
    } else {
        setCompletedMotions([...completedMotions, name]);
    }
  };

  if (!permission?.granted || !micPermission?.granted) {
    return (
        <View style={styles.centered}>
            <Text style={{marginBottom: 20, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold'}}>Permissions Required</Text>
            
            {!permission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={requestPermission} style={styles.permBtn}>
                    <Ionicons name="camera" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Camera Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
            
            {!micPermission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={requestMicPermission} style={styles.permBtn}>
                    <Ionicons name="mic" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Microphone Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
        </View>
    );
  }

  // If we are processing and have the video, show the loading screen (Camera Unmounted)
  if (phase === 'processing' && videoUri) {
      return (
          <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: Colors.background }]}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} style={{ marginBottom: 20 }} />
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy }}>Processing...</Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginTop: 10 }}>AI Judge is analyzing your performance.</Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#999', marginTop: 5 }}>This may take a few seconds.</Text>
          </View>
      );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <CameraView style={styles.camera} ref={cameraRef}>
        
        {/* Top Status Bar */}
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
            <View style={[styles.timerBadge, { backgroundColor: recording ? 'rgba(200,0,0,0.6)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)' }]}>
                <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: recording ? 'white' : 'gray' }]} />
                <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(phase === 'business' ? elapsedSeconds : totalSeconds)}</Text>
            </View>
            {isFullContest && <Text style={styles.modeBadge}>FULL CONTEST</Text>}
        </View>

        {renderOverlay()}

        {/* Loading overlay for the split second while saving but before videoUri is set code-side */}
        {phase === 'processing' && !videoUri && (
             <View style={[styles.centerOverlay, { backgroundColor: 'black' }]}>
                 <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                 <Text style={{color:'white', marginTop: 10, fontWeight: 'bold'}}>Saving Recording...</Text>
             </View>
        )}

      </CameraView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'black' },
  centered: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'white' },
  camera: { flex: 1 },
  topBar: { paddingTop: 60, alignItems: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 },
  timerBadge: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 10, borderRadius: 20 },
  dot: { width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 6, marginRight: 8 },
  timerText: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'], color: 'white' },
  modeBadge: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 12, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', padding: 4, borderRadius: 4 },
  
  // Overlays
  checklistContainer: { position: 'absolute', top: 120, left: 20, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', padding: 15, borderRadius: 12 },
  checklistTitle: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, fontSize: 12, textTransform: 'uppercase' },
  checkItem: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 },
  checkText: { color: 'white', marginLeft: 10, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600' },
  strikeText: { color: '#AAA', textDecorationLine: 'line-through' },
  
  // Full Contest Specifics
  centerOverlay: { position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: 20 },
  bottomOverlay: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, left: 0, right: 0, alignItems: 'center' },
  fullScreenOverlay: { flex: 1 }, // Wrapper for overlays
  
  phaseTitle: { color: 'white', fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, textAlign: 'center' },
  phaseLabel: { color: Colors.gold, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1 },
  phaseSub: { color: '#DDD', fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 30, textAlign: 'center' },
  
  questionCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 24, borderRadius: 16, marginBottom: 30, width: '100%', maxWidth: 400 },
  questionText: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 30 },
  
  // Buttons
  primaryBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, paddingHorizontal: 32, paddingVertical: 16, borderRadius: 12 },
  nextBtn: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 24, paddingVertical: 12, borderRadius: 30, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'white', gap: 8 },
  btnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 18 },
  
  // Classic Controls
  recordBtn: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, alignSelf: 'center', width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 40, borderWidth: 5, borderColor: 'white', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },
  recordInner: { width: 66, height: 66, borderRadius: 33, backgroundColor: 'red' },
  stopBtn: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, alignSelf: 'center', width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 40, borderWidth: 5, borderColor: 'white', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },
  stopInner: { width: 40, height: 40, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: 'red' },
  
  // Permissions
  permBtn: { flexDirection: 'row', backgroundColor: Colors.navy, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12, gap: 10, width: 250, justifyContent: 'center' },
  permBtnText: { color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 16 },
});
</file>

<file path="app/practice/chapter-conducting/result_v2.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { ChapterConductingScore } from '@/lib/scoring/chapter-conducting';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function ChapterConductingResultV2() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const videoUri = params.videoUri as string;
  const scoreData: ChapterConductingScore = params.score ? JSON.parse(params.score as string) : null;

  if (!scoreData) {
      return <View style={styles.container}><Text>No Score Data</Text></View>;
  }

  const { totalScore, breakdown, feedback } = scoreData;

  const renderPhaseScore = (title: string, score: number, max: number) => (
      <View style={styles.scoreRow}>
          <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>{title}</Text>
          <View style={styles.barContainer}>
              <View style={[styles.barFill, { width: `${(score/max)*100}%` }]} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.scoreVal}>{score}/{max}</Text>
      </View>
  );

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Contest Results</Text>

      {/* Video Replay */}
      {videoUri && (
        <View style={styles.videoContainer}>
             {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
                <video src={videoUri} controls playsInline style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', backgroundColor: 'black' }} />
            ) : (
                <Video source={{ uri: videoUri }} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} useNativeControls resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN} shouldPlay={false} />
            )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Main Score Card */}
      <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.totalContainer}>
              <Text style={styles.totalLabel}>TOTAL SCORE</Text>
              <Text style={styles.totalVal}>{totalScore}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.totalMax}>/ 100</Text>
          </View>
          
          <View style={styles.divider} />
          
          {renderPhaseScore("Opening Ceremonies", breakdown.opening, 10)}
          {renderPhaseScore("Business Meeting", breakdown.business, 40)}
          {renderPhaseScore("Closing Ceremonies", breakdown.closing, 10)}
          {renderPhaseScore("Oral Questions", breakdown.questions, 40)}
      </View>

      {/* Feedback */}
      <View style={styles.section}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>AI Feedback</Text>
          
          <View style={[styles.feedbackBox, { borderColor: Colors.success }]}>
              <View style={styles.fbHeader}>
                  <Ionicons name="thumbs-up" size={20} color={Colors.success} />
                  <Text style={[styles.fbTitle, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
              </View>
              {feedback.strengths.map((s, i) => (
                  <Text key={i} style={styles.fbText}>• {s}</Text>
              ))}
          </View>

          <View style={[styles.feedbackBox, { borderColor: Colors.warning, marginTop: 15 }]}>
              <View style={styles.fbHeader}>
                  <Ionicons name="construct" size={20} color={Colors.warning} />
                  <Text style={[styles.fbTitle, { color: Colors.warning }]}>Improvements</Text>
              </View>
              {feedback.improvements.map((s, i) => (
                  <Text key={i} style={styles.fbText}>• {s}</Text>
              ))}
          </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.doneBtn} onPress={() => {
        if (scoreData) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'chapter-conducting',
                score: scoreData.totalScore,
                maxScore: 100,
                details: scoreData
            });
        }
        router.navigate('/(tabs)/lde');
      }}>
        <Text style={styles.doneText}>Done</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  content: { padding: 20 },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 20, textAlign: 'center' },
  videoContainer: { height: 240, backgroundColor: 'black', borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: 20 },
  card: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 16, marginBottom: 24, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 }, shadowOpacity: 0.1, shadowRadius: 4, elevation: 3 },
  totalContainer: { alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20 },
  totalLabel: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.textLight, letterSpacing: 1 },
  totalVal: { fontSize: 48, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  totalMax: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight },
  divider: { height: 1, backgroundColor: '#EEE', marginBottom: 20 },
  scoreRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 },
  scoreLabel: { flex: 2, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '600', color: Colors.text },
  barContainer: { flex: 2, height: 8, backgroundColor: '#F0F0F0', borderRadius: 4, marginHorizontal: 10 },
  barFill: { height: '100%', backgroundColor: Colors.navy, borderRadius: 4 },
  scoreVal: { flex: 0.5, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.text, textAlign: 'right' },
  
  section: { marginBottom: 30 },
  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 15 },
  feedbackBox: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1 },
  fbHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10, gap: 8 },
  fbTitle: { fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 16 },
  fbText: { fontSize: 15, color: Colors.text, marginBottom: 6, lineHeight: 22 },
  
  doneBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, padding: 18, borderRadius: 14, alignItems: 'center' },
  doneText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold' },
});
</file>

<file path="app/practice/chapter-conducting/result.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';

export default function ChapterConductingResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const videoUri = params.videoUri as string;
  const motions = params.motions ? JSON.parse(params.motions as string) : [];
  const duration = parseInt(params.duration as string || '0');

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Conducting Analysis</Text>

      {/* Video Replay */}
      {videoUri && (
        <View style={styles.videoContainer}>
            {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
                <video 
                    src={videoUri} 
                    controls 
                    playsInline
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', backgroundColor: 'black' }} 
                />
            ) : (
                <Video
                    source={{ uri: videoUri }}
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
                    useNativeControls
                    resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
                    shouldPlay={false}
                />
            )}
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Performance Summary</Text>
        
        <View style={styles.row}>
            <View style={styles.stat}>
                <Ionicons name="time" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
                <Text style={styles.statVal}>{formatTime(duration)}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statLabel}>Duration</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.stat}>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-done" size={24} color={Colors.success} />
                <Text style={styles.statVal}>{motions.length}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statLabel}>Motions done</Text>
            </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.alert}>
        <Ionicons name="information-circle" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.alertText}>
            Review your video with your advisor to grade the "Debate" and "Opening Ceremonies" sections.
        </Text>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={styles.doneBtn} 
        onPress={() => router.navigate('/(tabs)/lde')}
      >
        <Text style={styles.doneText}>Complete Practice</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

<file path="app/practice/greenhand-quiz/builder.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Switch, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { QUIZ_SOURCES, QuizSource, QuizSettings } from '@/lib/greenhand-quiz';

export default function GreenhandQuizBuilder() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { mode } = useLocalSearchParams<{ mode: string | string[] }>();
  const isMockMode = mode === 'mock' || (Array.isArray(mode) && mode.includes('mock'));
  console.log("Builder Params Mode:", mode);
  console.log("Is Mock Mode:", isMockMode);

  const [selectedTopics, setSelectedTopics] = useState<Record<QuizSource, boolean>>({
    "FFA Manual": true,
    "Parliamentary Guide": true,
    "Leadership Guide": true,
  });

  const [questionCount, setQuestionCount] = useState<number>(10);
  const [questionType, setQuestionType] = useState<'mixed' | 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false'>('mixed');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMockMode) {
      // Mock Data Setup
      setQuestionCount(150);
      setQuestionType('mixed');
      const allSources: Record<QuizSource, boolean> = {
          "FFA Manual": true,
          "Parliamentary Guide": true,
          "Leadership Guide": true,
      };
      setSelectedTopics(allSources);
    }
  }, [isMockMode]);

  const toggleTopic = (source: QuizSource) => {
    setSelectedTopics(prev => ({ ...prev, [source]: !prev[source] }));
  };

  const handleStartQuiz = () => {
    const activeTopics = (Object.keys(selectedTopics) as QuizSource[]).filter(t => selectedTopics[t]);
    
    if (activeTopics.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Please select at least one topic.");
      return;
    }

    const settings: QuizSettings = {
      topics: activeTopics,
      questionCount: isMockMode ? 150 : questionCount,
      type: questionType,
      isMock: isMockMode
    };
    console.log("Starting Quiz with Settings:", JSON.stringify(settings));

    router.push({
      pathname: '/practice/greenhand-quiz/quiz',
      params: { settings: JSON.stringify(settings) }
    });
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: isMockMode ? 'Mock Exam Setup' : 'Custom Quiz Builder', headerBackTitle: 'Greenhand Quiz' }} />

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Select Topics</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          {QUIZ_SOURCES.map((source) => (
            <View key={source} style={styles.row}>
              <Text style={styles.label}>{source}</Text>
              <Switch 
                value={selectedTopics[source]} 
                onValueChange={() => toggleTopic(source)}
                trackColor={{ false: Colors.border, true: Colors.success }}
                disabled={isMockMode} // Locked for mock exam
              />
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Number of Questions</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
            {isMockMode ? (
                 <View style={styles.highlightRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.highlightText}>100 Questions (Official Format)</Text>
                 </View>
            ) : (
                <View style={styles.pillContainer}>
                    {[10, 20, 30, 50, 100].map(num => (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={num}
                        style={[styles.pill, questionCount === num && styles.pillActive]}
                        onPress={() => setQuestionCount(num)}
                    >
                        <Text style={[styles.pillText, questionCount === num && styles.pillTextActive]}>{num}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Question Type</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
            {isMockMode ? (
                <View style={styles.highlightRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.highlightText}>Mixed (50 T/F, 50 MC)</Text>
                </View>
            ) : (
                <View style={styles.pillContainer}>
                    {(['mixed', 'multiple_choice', 'true_false'] as const).map(type => (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={type}
                        style={[styles.pill, questionType === type && styles.pillActive]}
                        onPress={() => setQuestionType(type)}
                    >
                        <Text style={[styles.pillText, questionType === type && styles.pillTextActive]}>
                        {type === 'mixed' ? 'Mixed' : type === 'multiple_choice' ? 'Multiple Choice' : 'True/False'}
                        </Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={handleStartQuiz}>
        <Ionicons name="play" size={24} color={Colors.white} style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
        <Text style={styles.startButtonText}>Start Quiz</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,
  },
  content: {
    padding: 20,
    paddingBottom: 40,
  },
  section: {
    marginBottom: 24,
  },
  sectionTitle: {
    fontSize: 18,

  },
  card: {

  },

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { QUIZ_SOURCES, QuizSource, generateGreenhandStudyGuide } from '@/lib/greenhand-quiz';
import Markdown from 'react-native-markdown-display';

export default function GreenhandQuizStudyGuide() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedTopic, setSelectedTopic] = useState<QuizSource | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [guideContent, setGuideContent] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSelectTopic = async (topic: QuizSource) => {
    setSelectedTopic(topic);
    setLoading(true);
    setGuideContent(null);
    try {
      const content = await generateGreenhandStudyGuide(topic);
      setGuideContent(content);
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Could not generate study guide.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedTopic(null);
    setGuideContent(null);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Greenhand Study Guide', headerBackTitle: 'Greenhand Quiz' }} />
      
      {!selectedTopic ? (
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
          <Text style={styles.headerText}>
            Select a resource to generate a targeted study guide for Greenhand Level (9th Grade).
          </Text>
          <View style={styles.grid}>
            {QUIZ_SOURCES.map((source) => (
              <TouchableOpacity 
                key={source} 
                style={styles.card} 
                onPress={() => handleSelectTopic(source)}
              >
                <Ionicons name="book-outline" size={32} color={Colors.navy} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{source}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.guideContainer}>
          <View style={styles.guideHeader}>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={clearSelection} style={styles.backButton}>
              <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Back to Topics</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.topicTitle}>{selectedTopic}</Text>
          </View>

          {loading ? (
            <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Generating Greenhand Guide...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.guideContent}>
               <Markdown style={markdownStyles}>
                 {guideContent || "No content generated."}
               </Markdown>
            </ScrollView>
          )}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

<file path="app/practice/greenhand-quiz/quiz.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { generateGreenhandQuiz, QuizQuestion, QuizSettings } from '@/lib/greenhand-quiz';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function GreenhandQuizActive() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<QuizQuestion[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedAnswer, setSelectedAnswer] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAnswered, setIsAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (params.settings) {
      loadQuiz(JSON.parse(params.settings as string));
    }
  }, [params.settings]);

  const loadQuiz = async (settings: QuizSettings) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const generated = await generateGreenhandQuiz(settings);
      setQuestions(generated);
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to generate quiz. Please check your connection and try again.", [
        { text: "Go Back", onPress: () => router.back() }
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];

  const handleAnswer = (option: string) => {
    if (isAnswered) return;
    
    setSelectedAnswer(option);
    setIsAnswered(true);

    // Robust check: match string directly OR resolve letter (A, B, C, D) if provided
    let isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.correctAnswer);
    
    if (!isCorrect && currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && currentQuestion.options) {
        const letterMap: Record<string, number> = { 'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2, 'D': 3 };
        const correctIdx = letterMap[currentQuestion.correctAnswer.trim().toUpperCase()];
        if (correctIdx !== undefined && currentQuestion.options[correctIdx]) {
             isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.options[correctIdx]);
        }
    }

    if (isCorrect) {
      setScore(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  const nextQuestion = () => {
    if (currentIndex < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedAnswer(null);
      setIsAnswered(false);
    } else {
      finishQuiz();
    }
  };

  const finishQuiz = () => {
    const finalScore = score + (selectedAnswer === currentQuestion.correctAnswer ? 1 : 0);
    // Actually, score is updated on answer, so 'score' is current.
    // Wait, handleAnswer updates score. 
    // If we are here, we just finished the last question.
    // But 'nextQuestion' is called after feedback.
    
    useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
        type: 'greenhand-quiz',
        score: score,
        maxScore: questions.length,
        details: {
            totalQuestions: questions.length,
            correct: score
        }
    });
    setShowResults(true);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Generating your Greenhand quiz...</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subLoadingText}>Consulting official Greenhand rules & manuals...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
        <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={48} color={Colors.error} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>No questions generated.</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subLoadingText}>Please try again with different settings.</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Go Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (showResults) {
    const percentage = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Quiz Results', headerLeft: () => null }} />
        
        <View style={styles.resultCard}>
          <Ionicons name={percentage >= 70 ? "trophy" : "school"} size={64} color={Colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.resultScore}>{percentage}%</Text>
          <Text style={styles.resultSubtext}>You got {score} out of {questions.length} correct</Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Return to Menu</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }
  
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: `Question ${currentIndex + 1}/${questions.length}`, headerBackTitle: 'Quit' }} />

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        
        <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderText}>SECTION: {currentQuestion.source}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.questionCard}>
            <View style={styles.typeTag}>
                <Text style={styles.typeText}>{currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' ? 'Multiple Choice' : 'True / False'}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.questionText}>{currentQuestion.text}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.optionsContainer}>
            {currentQuestion.options?.map((option, idx) => {
                const label = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'][idx];
                const isSelected = selectedAnswer === option;
                
                // Robust correct check for UI highlighting
                let isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.correctAnswer);
                if (!isCorrect && currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && currentQuestion.options) {
                    const letterMap: Record<string, number> = { 'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2, 'D': 3 };
                    const correctIdx = letterMap[currentQuestion.correctAnswer.trim().toUpperCase()];
                    if (correctIdx !== undefined) {
                         isCorrect = (idx === correctIdx);
                    }
                }
                
                let optionStyle = styles.optionButton;
                let textStyle = styles.optionText;
                let icon = null;

                if (isAnswered) {
                    if (isCorrect) {
                        optionStyle = styles.optionCorrect;
                        textStyle = styles.optionTextWhite;
                        icon = "checkmark-circle";
                    } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                        optionStyle = styles.optionWrong;
                        textStyle = styles.optionTextWhite;
                        icon = "close-circle";
                    }
                } else if (isSelected) {
                    optionStyle = styles.optionSelected;
                }

                // label is already declared at line 155


                return (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={idx} 
                        style={optionStyle}
                        onPress={() => handleAnswer(option)}
                        disabled={isAnswered}
                    >
                       <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center'}}>
                            {currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && <Text style={[styles.optionLabel, isAnswered && (isCorrect || (isSelected && !isCorrect)) && {color: 'white'}]}>{label}. </Text>}
                            <Text style={textStyle}>{option}</Text>
                       </View>
                       {icon && <Ionicons name={icon as any} size={24} color="white" />}
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                );
            })}
        </View>

        {isAnswered && (
            <View style={styles.feedbackContainer}>
                <Text style={styles.feedbackTitle}>Explanation:</Text>
                <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{currentQuestion.explanation}</Text>
                
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextButton} onPress={nextQuestion}>
                    <Text style={styles.nextButtonText}>{currentIndex === questions.length - 1 ? "Finish Quiz" : "Next Question"}</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,

  content: {

import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Linking, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter, Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Asset } from 'expo-asset';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';

export default function JobInterviewPractice() {
  const { contestId, contestName } = useLocalSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();

  const handleNavigation = (route: string) => {
    router.push({
      pathname: `/practice/job-interview/${route}` as any,
      params: { contestId, contestName },
    });
  };

  const handleDownloadApplication = async () => {
    try {
      const asset = Asset.fromModule(require('@/assets/documents/job-interview-application.pdf'));
      await asset.downloadAsync();
      
      if (asset.localUri || asset.uri) {
        const uriToOpen = asset.localUri || asset.uri;
        const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(uriToOpen);
        
        if (canOpen) {
           await Linking.openURL(uriToOpen);
        } else {
           // On some devices, canOpenURL returns false for file:// but openURL still works.
           await Linking.openURL(uriToOpen);
        }
      } else {
        Alert.alert("Error", "Could not resolve file path.");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Download error:", error);
      Alert.alert("Error", "Could not open the application file.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.container, { paddingTop: insets.top }]}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: false }} />
      
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} style={styles.backButton}>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={Colors.text} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>{contestName || 'Job Interview'}</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 40 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Select a Preparation Module</Text>

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={styles.card} 
          onPress={handleDownloadApplication}
        >
          <View style={[styles.iconContainer, { backgroundColor: '#E0F7FA' }]}>
            <Ionicons name="download-outline" size={32} color="#006064" />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.cardContent}>
            <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Download Application</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardDescription}>Print and fill out the official FFA Job Interview application.</Text>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={Colors.textLight} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={styles.card} 
          onPress={() => handleNavigation('upload')}
        >
          <View style={[styles.iconContainer, { backgroundColor: '#E8F5E9' }]}>
            <Ionicons name="cloud-upload" size={32} color="#4CAF50" />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.cardContent}>
            <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Upload Materials</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardDescription}>Upload resume, cover letter, and job description.</Text>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={Colors.textLight} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={styles.card} 
          onPress={() => handleNavigation('video')}
        >
          <View style={[styles.iconContainer, { backgroundColor: '#FFF3E0' }]}>
            <Ionicons name="videocam" size={32} color="#FF9800" />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.cardContent}>
            <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Video Interview Simulator</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardDescription}>Practice with AI-driven video interview questions.</Text>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={Colors.textLight} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={styles.card} 
          onPress={() => handleNavigation('phone')}
        >
            <View style={[styles.iconContainer, { backgroundColor: '#F3E5F5' }]}>
            <Ionicons name="call" size={32} color="#9C27B0" />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.cardContent}>
            <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>Phone Interview Simulator</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardDescription}>Practice answering phone interview questions.</Text>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={Colors.textLight} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingVertical: 15,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    borderBottomColor: Colors.border,
  },
  backButton: {
    padding: 8,
  },
  headerTitle: {
    fontSize: 20,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    color: Colors.text,
  },
  content: {
    padding: 20,
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: Colors.text,
    marginBottom: 20,
  },
  card: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 16,
    marginBottom: 16,
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.1,
    shadowRadius: 4,
    elevation: 2,
  },
  iconContainer: {
    width: 60,
    height: 60,
    borderRadius: 30,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    marginRight: 16,
  },
  cardContent: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  cardTitle: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    color: Colors.text,
    marginBottom: 4,
  },
  cardDescription: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: Colors.textLight,
  },
});
