<file path="app/practice/job-interview/phone.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Alert, Dimensions, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Audio } from 'expo-av';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

const SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;

interface Question {
  id: string;
  text: string;
}

const MOCK_QUESTIONS: Question[] = [
  { id: '1', text: "Hello, could you please introduce yourself?" },
  { id: '2', text: "Why are you interested in working for our company?" },
  { id: '3', text: "Do you have any questions for us?" },
];

import { analyzeInterviewResponse, InterviewAnalysis } from '@/lib/scoring/job-interview';

export default function PhoneSimulator() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [permissionResponse, requestPermission] = Audio.usePermissions();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<'intro' | 'interview' | 'review' | 'feedback'>('intro');
  const [questionIndex, setQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordings, setRecordings] = useState<Record<string, string>>({}); 
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [analysisResults, setAnalysisResults] = useState<InterviewAnalysis | null>(null);

  const recordingRef = useRef<Audio.Recording | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (recordingRef.current) {
        recordingRef.current.stopAndUnloadAsync();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const handleStartInterview = async () => {
    if (!permissionResponse?.granted) {
      const result = await requestPermission();
      if (!result.granted) return;
    }
    setCurrentStep('interview');
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    try {
      await Audio.setAudioModeAsync({
        allowsRecordingIOS: true,
        playsInSilentModeIOS: true,
      });

      const { recording } = await Audio.Recording.createAsync(
        Audio.RecordingOptionsPresets.HIGH_QUALITY
      );
      
      recordingRef.current = recording;
      setIsRecording(true);
      setElapsed(0);
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setElapsed(p => p + 1), 1000);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to start recording', err);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to start recording');
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = async () => {
    if (!recordingRef.current) return;
    
    try {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      setIsRecording(false);
      
      await recordingRef.current.stopAndUnloadAsync();
      const uri = recordingRef.current.getURI();
      
      if (uri) {
        setRecordings(prev => ({ ...prev, [MOCK_QUESTIONS[questionIndex].id]: uri }));
        handleNext();
      }
      
      recordingRef.current = null;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to stop recording', err);
    }
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (questionIndex < MOCK_QUESTIONS.length - 1) {
      setQuestionIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setElapsed(0);
    } else {
      setCurrentStep('review');
    }
  };

  const submitInterview = async () => {
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    
    try {
        let totalScore = 0;
        let count = 0;
        const allReflections: string[] = [];
        const allStrengths: string[] = [];
        const allImprovements: string[] = [];

        // Analyze ALL questions
        for (const q of MOCK_QUESTIONS) {
            const audioUri = recordings[q.id];
            if (audioUri) {
                try {
                    const result = await analyzeInterviewResponse(audioUri, q.text, 'phone');
                    if (result) {
                        totalScore += result.score;
                        allReflections.push(`Question ${q.id}: ${result.feedback}`);
                        allStrengths.push(...result.strengths);
                        allImprovements.push(...result.improvements);
                        count++;
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error(`Failed to analyze question ${q.id}`, err);
                }
            }
        }

        const finalScore = count > 0 ? Math.round(totalScore / count) : 0;
        const uniqueStrengths = Array.from(new Set(allStrengths)).slice(0, 5);
        const uniqueImprovements = Array.from(new Set(allImprovements)).slice(0, 5);

        const finalAnalysis: InterviewAnalysis = {
            score: finalScore,
            feedback: allReflections.join('\n\n') || "No meaningful feedback could be generated.",
            strengths: uniqueStrengths,
            improvements: uniqueImprovements,
            transcription: "" 
        };

        setAnalysisResults(finalAnalysis);

        // Save to History Store
        if (count > 0) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'job-interview',
                score: finalScore,
                maxScore: 100,
                details: finalAnalysis,
                metadata: { 
                    mode: 'phone',
                    questionCount: count
                }
            });
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Submission error", e);
        Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to submit interview analysis.");
    } finally {
        setIsAnalyzing(false);
        setCurrentStep('feedback');
    }
  };
  
    const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
      const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
      const s = secs % 60;
      return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    };

  if (currentStep === 'intro') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Phone Simulator' }} />
        <View style={styles.introContent}>
          <View style={[styles.avatarContainer, { width: 100, height: 100, borderRadius: 50, marginBottom: 20 }]}>
            <Ionicons name="call" size={50} color={Colors.white} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Phone Interview</Text>
          <Text style={styles.description}>
            Practice your phone interview skills. You will hear questions and record your audio responses.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.button} onPress={handleStartInterview}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Start Call</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'interview') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.callContainer}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        
        <View style={styles.callHeader}>
            <Text style={styles.callerName}>Interviewer</Text>
            <Text style={styles.callStatus}>{formatTime(elapsed)}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.avatarLarge}>
            <Ionicons name="person" size={100} color={Colors.white} opacity={0.8} />
        </View>

        <View style={styles.questionCard}>
            <Text style={styles.questionLabel}>Question {questionIndex + 1}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.questionText}>{MOCK_QUESTIONS[questionIndex].text}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.callControls}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.controlButton} onPress={() => Alert.alert("Mute", "Mute simulated")}>
                <Ionicons name="mic-off-outline" size={32} color={Colors.white} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {!isRecording ? (
                <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.mainButton, { backgroundColor: Colors.success }]} onPress={startRecording}>
                    <Ionicons name="mic" size={40} color={Colors.white} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
                <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.mainButton, { backgroundColor: Colors.error }]} onPress={stopRecording}>
                    <Ionicons name="stop" size={40} color={Colors.white} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.controlButton, { backgroundColor: Colors.error }]} onPress={() => router.back()}>
                <Ionicons name="call" size={32} color={Colors.white} style={{ transform: [{ rotate: '135deg' }] }} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'review') {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: true, title: 'Review Audio' }} />
        <Text style={styles.headerText}>Review your audio responses.</Text>
        
        {MOCK_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => (
          <View key={q.id} style={styles.responseCard}>
             <Text style={styles.questionLabel}>Question {i+1}</Text>
             <Text style={styles.responseQuestion}>{q.text}</Text>
             {recordings[q.id] ? (
               <View style={styles.audioPlaceholder}>
                 <Ionicons name="headset" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
                 <Text style={styles.audioText}>Audio Recorded</Text>
               </View>
             ) : (
               <Text style={styles.errorText}>No audio found</Text>
             )}
          </View>
        ))}

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={[styles.button, isAnalyzing && styles.buttonDisabled]} 
          onPress={submitInterview}
          disabled={isAnalyzing}
        >
          {isAnalyzing ? <ActivityIndicator color="white" /> : <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Submit for Analysis</Text>}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'feedback') {
     return (
        <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
           <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: true, title: 'Analysis' }} />
           <View style={styles.content}>
              <View style={[styles.centerContent, { padding: 20 }]}>
                 <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={60} color={Colors.success} />
                 <Text style={styles.title}>Analysis Complete!</Text>
                 <Text style={[styles.description, { marginBottom: 10 }]}>
                    Here is the AI evaluation of your performance.
                 </Text>
                 {analysisResults && (
                    <View style={styles.scoreBadge}>
                        <Text style={styles.scoreText}>{analysisResults.score}/100</Text>
                    </View>
                 )}
              </View>

              {analysisResults ? (
                <>
                  <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                     <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>General Feedback</Text>
                     <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{analysisResults.feedback}</Text>
                  </View>

                   <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                     <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
                     {analysisResults.strengths.map((s, i) => (
                        <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                           <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color={Colors.success} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                           <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                        </View>
                     ))}
                  </View>

                  <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                     <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.warning }]}>Areas for Improvement</Text>
                     {analysisResults.improvements.map((s, i) => (
                        <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                           <Ionicons name="arrow-up" size={16} color={Colors.warning} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                           <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                        </View>
                     ))}
                  </View>
                </>
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.errorText}>Could not generate analysis. Please check your connection.</Text>
              )}

              <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.button, { marginTop: 30, marginBottom: 50 }]} onPress={() => router.back()}>
                 <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Return to Practice</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
           </View>
        </ScrollView>
     );
  }

  return <View />;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  centerContainer: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 20 },
  callContainer: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#2c3e50', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingVertical: 50 },
  content: { padding: 20 },
  introContent: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 40 },
  centerContent: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 40 },
  
  title: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.text, marginTop: 20, marginBottom: 10 },
  description: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 30 },
  headerText: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 20 },
  
  button: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, paddingVertical: 15, paddingHorizontal: 30, borderRadius: 25 },
  buttonDisabled: { opacity: 0.7 },
  buttonText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 'bold' },

  avatarContainer: { backgroundColor: Colors.info, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  
  // Call UI
  callHeader: { alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 20 },

<file path="app/practice/job-interview/upload.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as DocumentPicker from 'expo-document-picker';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';

import { analyzeDocument, InterviewAnalysis } from '@/lib/scoring/job-interview';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

interface UploadedFile {
  uri: string;
  name: string;
  mimeType?: string;
  size?: number;
}

const UploadCard = React.memo(({
  title,
  description,
  file,
  type,
  icon,
  canAnalyze,
  isAnalyzing,
  result,
  onPick,
  onRemove,
  onAnalyze
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  file: UploadedFile | null;
  type: 'job_description' | 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter';
  icon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  canAnalyze: boolean;
  isAnalyzing: boolean;
  result: InterviewAnalysis | null;
  onPick: (type: 'job_description' | 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter') => void;
  onRemove: (type: 'job_description' | 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter') => void;
  onAnalyze: (type: 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter', file: UploadedFile) => void;
}) => (
  <View style={styles.card}>
    <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
      <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
        <Ionicons name={icon} size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
      </View>
      <View style={styles.cardTexts}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{title}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.cardDescription}>{description}</Text>
      </View>
    </View>
    
    {file ? (
      <View>
        <View style={styles.fileContainer}>
          <View style={styles.fileInfo}>
            <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={20} color={Colors.text} />
            <Text style={styles.fileName} numberOfLines={1}>{file.name}</Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemove(type as any)} style={styles.removeButton}>
            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={20} color={Colors.error} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {canAnalyze && (
          <View style={styles.actionContainer}>
            {!result && (
                <TouchableOpacity 
                    style={[styles.analyzeButton, isAnalyzing && styles.disabledButton]} 
                    onPress={() => onAnalyze(type as any, file)}
                    disabled={isAnalyzing}
                >
                    {isAnalyzing ? (
                        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={Colors.white} />
                    ) : (
                        <>
                            <Ionicons name="scan-outline" size={16} color={Colors.white} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                            <Text style={styles.analyzeButtonText}>Grade with AI</Text>
                        </>
                    )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
            
            {result && (
                <View style={styles.resultContainer}>
                    <View style={styles.scoreBadge}>
                        <Text style={styles.scoreText}>{result.score}/{result.maxScore || 100}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{result.feedback}</Text>
                    
                    {result.improvements.length > 0 && (
                        <View style={styles.improvementList}>
                            <Text style={styles.improvementTitle}>Improvements:</Text>
                            {result.improvements.map((imp: string, idx: number) => (
                                <Text key={idx} style={styles.improvementItem}>• {imp}</Text>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    ) : (
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.uploadButton} onPress={() => onPick(type as any)}>
        <Ionicons name="add" size={20} color={Colors.white} />
        <Text style={styles.uploadButtonText}>Select File</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    )}
  </View>
));

export default function UploadMaterials() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [jobDescription, setJobDescription] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);
  const [coverLetter, setCoverLetter] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);
  const [resume, setResume] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);
  const [application, setApplication] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);
  const [followUpLetter, setFollowUpLetter] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);
  
  // Analysis States
  const [analyzingMap, setAnalyzingMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [resultsMap, setResultsMap] = useState<Record<string, InterviewAnalysis | null>>({});

  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const pickDocument = async (type: 'job_description' | 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter') => {
    try {
      const result = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
        type: ['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', 'text/plain', 'image/*'],
        copyToCacheDirectory: true,
      });

      if (result.canceled) return;

      const file = result.assets[0];
      const uploadedFile: UploadedFile = {
        uri: file.uri,
        name: file.name,
        mimeType: file.mimeType,
        size: file.size,
      };

      if (type === 'job_description') setJobDescription(uploadedFile);
      else if (type === 'cover_letter') setCoverLetter(uploadedFile);
      else if (type === 'resume') setResume(uploadedFile);
      else if (type === 'application') setApplication(uploadedFile);
      else if (type === 'follow_up_letter') setFollowUpLetter(uploadedFile);

      // Reset analysis for this type
      setResultsMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [type]: null }));

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error picking document:', err);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to pick document');
    }
  };

  const handleAnalyze = async (type: 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter', file: UploadedFile) => {
    if (!file) return;

    setAnalyzingMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [type]: true }));
    
    try {
      const result = await analyzeDocument(file.uri, type);
      setResultsMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [type]: result }));
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Analysis Failed", "Could not analyze the document.");
    } finally {
      setAnalyzingMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [type]: false }));
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!jobDescription && !coverLetter && !resume) {
      Alert.alert('No Files', 'Please upload at least one document to save.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    
    // Save results to history
    let savedCount = 0;
    Object.entries(resultsMap).forEach(([type, result]) => {
        if (result) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'job-interview',
                score: result.score,
                maxScore: result.maxScore || 100,
                details: result,
                metadata: {
                    mode: 'document',
                    documentType: type
                }
            });
            savedCount++;
        }
    });

    // Simulate API call/processing delay
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsSaving(false);
      Alert.alert('Success', `Materials and ${savedCount} analysis results saved successfully!`, [
        { text: 'OK', onPress: () => router.back() }
      ]);
    }, 1000);
  };

  const removeFile = (type: 'job_description' | 'cover_letter' | 'resume' | 'application' | 'follow_up_letter') => {
    if (type === 'job_description') setJobDescription(null);
    else if (type === 'cover_letter') setCoverLetter(null);
    else if (type === 'resume') setResume(null);
    else if (type === 'application') setApplication(null);
    else if (type === 'follow_up_letter') setFollowUpLetter(null);
    
    setResultsMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [type]: null }));
  };

  // renderUploadCard removed and extracted

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Upload Materials', headerBackTitle: 'Back' }} />
      
      <Text style={styles.headerText}>
        Upload your application materials. Use the AI to grade your Resume, Cover Letter, Application, and Follow Up Letter against the official rubric.
      </Text>

      <UploadCard
        title="Job Description"
        description="Upload the job description context."
        file={jobDescription}
        type="job_description"
        icon="briefcase-outline"
        canAnalyze={false}
        isAnalyzing={analyzingMap['job_description']}
        result={resultsMap['job_description']}
        onPick={pickDocument}
        onRemove={removeFile}
        onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
      />

      <UploadCard
        title="Resume"
        description="Upload your current resume."
        file={resume}
        type="resume"
        icon="person-outline"
        canAnalyze={true}
        isAnalyzing={analyzingMap['resume']}
        result={resultsMap['resume']}
        onPick={pickDocument}
        onRemove={removeFile}
        onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
      />

      <UploadCard
        title="Cover Letter"
        description="Upload your tailored cover letter."
        file={coverLetter}
        type="cover_letter"
        icon="mail-outline"
        canAnalyze={true}
        isAnalyzing={analyzingMap['cover_letter']}
        result={resultsMap['cover_letter']}
        onPick={pickDocument}
        onRemove={removeFile}
        onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
      />

      <UploadCard
        title="Completed Application"
        description="Upload your completed job application form."
        file={application}
        type="application"
        icon="clipboard-outline"
        canAnalyze={true}
        isAnalyzing={analyzingMap['application']}
        result={resultsMap['application']}
        onPick={pickDocument}
        onRemove={removeFile}
        onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
      />

      <UploadCard
        title="Follow Up Letter"
        description="Upload your post-interview correspondence."
        file={followUpLetter}
        type="follow_up_letter"
        icon="mail-open-outline"
        canAnalyze={true}
        isAnalyzing={analyzingMap['follow_up_letter']}
        result={resultsMap['follow_up_letter']}
        onPick={pickDocument}
        onRemove={removeFile}
        onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
      />

      <TouchableOpacity 
        style={[styles.saveButton, isSaving && styles.saveButtonDisabled]} 
        onPress={handleSave}
        disabled={isSaving}
      >
        {isSaving ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color={Colors.white} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <Ionicons name="save-outline" size={20} color={Colors.white} style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
            <Text style={styles.saveButtonText}>Save Materials</Text>
          </>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,
  },
  content: {
    padding: 20,
    paddingBottom: 40,
  },
  headerText: {
    fontSize: 16,
    color: Colors.textLight,
    marginBottom: 24,

  },

<file path="app/practice/job-interview/video.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Alert, Dimensions, ActivityIndicator, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { analyzeInterviewResponse, InterviewAnalysis } from '@/lib/scoring/job-interview';

const SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;

interface Question {
  id: string;
  text: string;
}

const MOCK_QUESTIONS: Question[] = [
  { id: '1', text: "Tell us about yourself and why you're interested in this position." },
  { id: '2', text: "What do you consider to be your greatest strength and weakness?" },
  { id: '3', text: "Describe a situation where you had to work as part of a team to achieve a goal." },
];

export default function VideoSimulator() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<'intro' | 'interview' | 'review' | 'feedback'>('intro');
  const [questionIndex, setQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordings, setRecordings] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [analysisResults, setAnalysisResults] = useState<InterviewAnalysis | null>(null);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      stopCamera();
    };
  }, []);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setCameraError(null);
      console.log("� Requesting camera access...");
      
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } },
        audio: true,
      });
      
      streamRef.current = stream;
      
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.muted = true; // Prevent echo
        await videoRef.current.play();
      }
      
      setCameraReady(true);
      console.log("✅ Camera started successfully");
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("❌ Camera error:", err);
      setCameraError(err.message || "Could not access camera.");
      Alert.alert("Camera Error", err.message || "Could not access camera. Please check permissions.");
    }
  }, []);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    }
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const handleStartInterview = async () => {
    console.log("🚀 Starting interview...");
    setCurrentStep('interview');
    // Camera will be started by the useEffect below
  };

  // Start camera when entering interview mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentStep === 'interview') {
      startCamera();
    } else {
      stopCamera();
    }
  }, [currentStep, startCamera, stopCamera]);

  const startRecording = () => {
    if (!streamRef.current) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Camera is not ready. Please wait.");
      return;
    }

    console.log("🔴 Starting recording...");
    chunksRef.current = [];
    
    try {
      // Try different MIME types for browser compatibility
      const mimeTypes = ['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus', 'video/webm', 'video/mp4'];
      let selectedMime = '';
      
      for (const mime of mimeTypes) {
        if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mime)) {
          selectedMime = mime;
          break;
        }
      }

      console.log(`📹 Using MIME type: ${selectedMime || 'default'}`);

      const options: MediaRecorderOptions = selectedMime ? { mimeType: selectedMime } : {};
      const recorder = new MediaRecorder(streamRef.current, options);
      
      recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
        if (event.data.size > 0) {
          chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        }
      };
      
      recorder.onstop = () => {
        console.log("✅ Recording stopped, creating blob...");
        const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: selectedMime || 'video/webm' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        
        console.log(`📁 Recorded blob: ${blob.size} bytes`);
        setRecordings(prev => ({ ...prev, [MOCK_QUESTIONS[questionIndex].id]: url }));
        handleNext();
      };
      
      recorder.onerror = (event: any) => {
        console.error("❌ MediaRecorder error:", event);
        Alert.alert("Recording Error", "An error occurred during recording.");
        setIsRecording(false);
        if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      };

      recorder.start(1000); // Collect data every second
      mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;
      setIsRecording(true);
      setElapsed(0);
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setElapsed(p => p + 1), 1000);
      
      console.log("✅ Recording started");
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("❌ Failed to start recording:", err);
      Alert.alert("Error", err.message || "Could not start recording.");
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    console.log("⏹️ Stopping recording...");
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state !== 'inactive') {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
    }
    setIsRecording(false);
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (questionIndex < MOCK_QUESTIONS.length - 1) {
      setQuestionIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setIsRecording(false);
      setElapsed(0);
    } else {
      stopCamera();
      setCurrentStep('review');
    }
  };

  const submitInterview = async () => {
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    
    // Analyze the first question as a sample
    const firstQ = MOCK_QUESTIONS[0];
    const videoUri = recordings[firstQ.id];
    
    if (videoUri) {
      try {
        const result = await analyzeInterviewResponse(videoUri, firstQ.text, 'video');
        setAnalysisResults(result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error("Analysis failed:", err);
        setAnalysisResults({
          score: 0,
          feedback: `Analysis failed: ${err.message}`,
          strengths: [],
          improvements: [],
        });
      }
    }

    setIsAnalyzing(false);
    setCurrentStep('feedback');
  };

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  // --- RENDER STEPS ---

  if (currentStep === 'intro') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Video Simulator' }} />
        <View style={styles.introContent}>
          <Ionicons name="videocam" size={80} color={Colors.navy} />
          <Text style={styles.title}>Virtual Interview</Text>
          <Text style={styles.description}>
            You will be asked 3 questions. For each question, record a video response.
            Focus on eye contact, clarity, and relevance to the rubric.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.button} onPress={handleStartInterview}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Start Interview</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'interview') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.fullScreenContainer}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        
        {/* Camera Preview */}
        <View style={styles.cameraContainer}>
          {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
            <video
              ref={videoRef as any}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', transform: 'scaleX(-1)' } as any}
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              muted
            />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.nativeFallback}>
              <Text style={styles.nativeFallbackText}>Camera preview (native)</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          
          {/* Overlay */}
          <View style={styles.overlay}>
            {/* Header */}
            <View style={styles.topBar}>
              <Text style={styles.questionCounter}>Question {questionIndex + 1} of {MOCK_QUESTIONS.length}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { stopCamera(); router.back(); }} style={styles.closeButton}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="white" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {/* Question Card */}
            <View style={styles.questionCard}>
              <Text style={styles.questionText}>{MOCK_QUESTIONS[questionIndex].text}</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{flex: 1}} />

            {/* Camera Status */}
            {!cameraReady && !cameraError && (
              <View style={styles.statusBar}>
                <ActivityIndicator color="white" />
                <Text style={styles.statusText}>Starting camera...</Text>
              </View>
            )}
            
            {cameraError && (
              <View style={styles.statusBar}>
                <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={20} color={Colors.error} />
                <Text style={[styles.statusText, { color: Colors.error }]}>{cameraError}</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={startCamera} style={styles.retryButton}>
                  <Text style={styles.retryText}>Retry</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            )}

            {/* Controls */}
            <View style={styles.controls}>
              {isRecording ? (
                <View style={styles.recordingState}>
                  <View style={styles.liveIndicator}>
                    <View style={styles.liveDot} />
                    <Text style={styles.liveText}>REC</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Text style={styles.timer}>{formatTime(elapsed)}</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={styles.stopButton} onPress={stopRecording}>
                    <View style={styles.stopIcon} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              ) : (
                <TouchableOpacity 
                  style={[styles.recordButton, !cameraReady && styles.recordButtonDisabled]} 
                  onPress={startRecording}
                  disabled={!cameraReady}
                >
                  <View style={[styles.recordIconInner, !cameraReady && { opacity: 0.5 }]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'review') {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: true, title: 'Review Responses' }} />
        <Text style={styles.headerText}>Review your recordings before submitting.</Text>
        
        {MOCK_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => (
          <View key={q.id} style={styles.responseCard}>
            <Text style={styles.questionLabel}>Question {i+1}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.responseQuestion}>{q.text}</Text>
            {recordings[q.id] ? (
              <View style={styles.videoPlaceholder}>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color={Colors.success} />
                <Text style={styles.videoText}>Video Recorded ✓</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.errorText}>No recording found</Text>
            )}
          </View>
        ))}

        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={[styles.button, isAnalyzing && styles.buttonDisabled]} 
          onPress={submitInterview}
          disabled={isAnalyzing}
        >
          {isAnalyzing ? <ActivityIndicator color="white" /> : <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Submit for Grading</Text>}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  if (currentStep === 'feedback') {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown: true, title: 'Analysis' }} />
        <View style={styles.content}>
          <View style={[styles.centerContent, { padding: 20 }]}>
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={60} color={Colors.success} />
            <Text style={styles.title}>Analysis Complete!</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.description, { marginBottom: 10 }]}>
              Here is the AI evaluation of your performance.
            </Text>
            {analysisResults && (
              <View style={styles.scoreBadge}>
                <Text style={styles.scoreText}>{analysisResults.score}/{analysisResults.maxScore || 100}</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {analysisResults ? (
            <>
              <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>General Feedback</Text>
                <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{analysisResults.feedback}</Text>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
                {analysisResults.strengths.map((s, i) => (
                  <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color={Colors.success} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>

              <View style={styles.feedbackSection}>
                <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.warning }]}>Areas for Improvement</Text>
                {analysisResults.improvements.map((s, i) => (
                  <View key={i} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-up" size={16} color={Colors.warning} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{s}</Text>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Text style={styles.errorText}>Could not generate analysis. Please check your connection.</Text>
          )}

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.button, { marginTop: 30, marginBottom: 50 }]} onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Return to Practice</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  return <View />;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  centerContainer: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 20 },
  fullScreenContainer: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'black' },
  cameraContainer: { flex: 1, position: 'relative' as any },
  content: { padding: 20 },
  introContent: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 40 },
  centerContent: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 40 },
  
  title: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.text, marginTop: 20, marginBottom: 10, textAlign: 'center' },
  description: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 30 },
  text: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.text, marginBottom: 20 },
  headerText: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 20 },
  
  button: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, paddingVertical: 15, paddingHorizontal: 30, borderRadius: 25, alignItems: 'center' },
  buttonDisabled: { opacity: 0.7 },
  buttonText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 'bold' },

  nativeFallback: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#333', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  nativeFallbackText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 16 },

  overlay: { 
    position: 'absolute' as any, 
    top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)', 
    padding: 20, 
    paddingTop: 60,
  },
  topBar: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20 },
  questionCounter: { color: 'white', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '600', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 4, borderRadius: 12 },
  closeButton: { padding: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', borderRadius: 20 },
  
  questionCard: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12 },
  questionText: { fontSize: 18, color: Colors.text, fontWeight: '600', textAlign: 'center' },
  
  statusBar: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', padding: 10, borderRadius: 10 },
  statusText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 14 },
  retryButton: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 6, borderRadius: 8, marginLeft: 8 },
  retryText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold' },

  controls: { alignItems: 'center', paddingBottom: 40 },
  recordButton: { width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 40, borderWidth: 4, borderColor: 'white', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  recordButtonDisabled: { opacity: 0.5 },
  recordIconInner: { width: 70, height: 70, borderRadius: 35, backgroundColor: Colors.error },
  recordingState: { alignItems: 'center' },
  liveIndicator: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 4, borderRadius: 10 },
  liveDot: { width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: 5, backgroundColor: Colors.error },
  liveText: { color: Colors.error, fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 12 },
  timer: { color: 'white', fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 20 },
  stopButton: { width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 40, borderWidth: 4, borderColor: 'white', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  stopIcon: { width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: Colors.error },

  responseCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 15, borderRadius: 10, marginBottom: 15 },
  questionLabel: { fontSize: 12, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 4 },
  responseQuestion: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600', color: Colors.text, marginBottom: 10 },
  videoPlaceholder: { height: 100, backgroundColor: Colors.background, borderRadius: 8, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10 },
  videoText: { color: Colors.text, fontWeight: '500' },
  errorText: { color: Colors.error },

  // Feedback Styles
  scoreBadge: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, paddingVertical: 10, paddingHorizontal: 20, borderRadius: 20, marginTop: 10 },
  scoreText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 'bold' },

});

<file path="app/practice/public-relations/index.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, SafeAreaView } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { TARGET_AUDIENCES } from '@/lib/data/public-relations';

export default function PublicRelationsSetup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedAudience, setSelectedAudience] = useState(TARGET_AUDIENCES[0]);

  const startPractice = () => {
    router.push({
        pathname: '/practice/public-relations/record',
        params: { audienceId: selectedAudience.id }
    });
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} style={styles.backButton}>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
          <Text style={styles.backText}>Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text style={styles.title}>Public Relations Team</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          Develop and present a 6-9 minute presentation regarding the Texas FFA to a specific target audience.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.sectionHeader}>Select Target Audience</Text>
        <View style={styles.list}>
            {TARGET_AUDIENCES.map((audience) => (
                <TouchableOpacity 
                    key={audience.id} 
                    style={[styles.card, selectedAudience.id === audience.id && styles.selectedCard]}
                    onPress={() => setSelectedAudience(audience)}
                >
                    <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
                        <Text style={[styles.cardTitle, selectedAudience.id === audience.id && styles.selectedText]}>{audience.name}</Text>
                        {selectedAudience.id === audience.id && <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color="white" />}
                    </View>
                    <Text style={[styles.cardDesc, selectedAudience.id === audience.id && styles.selectedText]}>{audience.description}</Text>
                    {typeof audience.year === 'number' && (
                        <View style={styles.badge}>
                            <Text style={styles.badgeText}>{audience.year} Topic</Text>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.infoBox}>
            <Ionicons name="information-circle" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
            <Text style={styles.infoText}>
                {selectedAudience.context}
            </Text>
        </View>

      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={startPractice}>
              <Text style={styles.startText}>Start Presentation</Text>
              <Ionicons name="videocam" size={24} color="white" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  content: { padding: 20, paddingBottom: 100 },
  backButton: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20 },
  backText: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.navy, marginLeft: 5 },
  title: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 10 },
  subtitle: { fontSize: 16, color: Colors.textLight, marginBottom: 30, lineHeight: 22 },
  sectionHeader: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 15 },
  list: { gap: 15 },
  card: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#E0E0E0' },
  selectedCard: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy, borderColor: Colors.navy },
  cardHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 5 },
  cardTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  cardDesc: { fontSize: 14, color: Colors.textLight },
  selectedText: { color: 'white' },
  badge: { alignSelf: 'flex-start', backgroundColor: Colors.gold, paddingHorizontal: 8, paddingVertical: 4, borderRadius: 4, marginTop: 10 },
  badgeText: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  infoBox: { flexDirection: 'row', backgroundColor: '#E3F2FD', padding: 15, borderRadius: 12, marginTop: 30, alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  infoText: { flex: 1, fontSize: 14, color: Colors.navy, lineHeight: 20 },
  footer: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, padding: 20, backgroundColor: 'white', borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: '#EEE' },
  startButton: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 18, borderRadius: 12, gap: 10 },
  startText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold' }
});
</file>

<file path="app/practice/public-relations/record.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Platform, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions, useMicrophonePermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { PR_QUESTIONS, TARGET_AUDIENCES } from '@/lib/data/public-relations';
import { analyzePublicRelations } from '../../../lib/scoring/public-relations';

type Phase = 'setup' | 'presentation' | 'questions' | 'processing';

export default function PublicRelationsRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { audienceId } = useLocalSearchParams<{ audienceId: string }>();
  const audience = TARGET_AUDIENCES.find(a => a.id === audienceId) || TARGET_AUDIENCES[0];

  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [micPermission, requestMicPermission] = useMicrophonePermissions();

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('setup');
  const phaseRef = useRef<Phase>(phase);
  
  useEffect(() => { phaseRef.current = phase; }, [phase]);

  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);

  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Select 3 random questions
    const shuffled = [...PR_QUESTIONS].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    setQuestions(shuffled.slice(0, 3));
    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  }, []);

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const getTimerColor = () => {
    // 6-9 minutes target
    if (seconds > 540) return Colors.error; // > 9 mins
    if (seconds >= 480) return Colors.warning; // > 8 mins (Warning)
    if (seconds >= 360) return Colors.success; // > 6 mins (Good)
    return Colors.white; // Under time
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    if (recording) return;

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
            const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
            chunksRef.current = [];
            
            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data); };
            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
                const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                setVideoUri(url);
                
                if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                    processSubmission(url);
                }
                stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            };
            
            mediaRecorder.start();
            setRecording(true);
            setSeconds(0);
            timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            Alert.alert("Error", "Could not access camera/mic");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!cameraRef.current) return;
    try {
        setRecording(true);
        setSeconds(0);
        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(t => t + 1), 1000);
        
        const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({ maxDuration: 1200 }); // 20 mins max
        if (video) {
            setVideoUri(video.uri);
            if (phaseRef.current === 'processing') {
                processSubmission(video.uri);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        setRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        mediaRecorderRef.current?.stop();
    } else {
        cameraRef.current?.stopRecording();
    }
    setRecording(false);
    clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
  };

  const nextPhase = () => {
      if (phase === 'setup') {
          setPhase('presentation');
          startRecording();
      } else if (phase === 'presentation') {
          setPhase('questions');
      } else if (phase === 'questions') {
          finishContest();
      }
  };

  const finishContest = () => {
      phaseRef.current = 'processing'; // Force immediate update for callback
      setPhase('processing'); // UI update
      stopRecording();
  };

  const processSubmission = async (uri: string) => {
      try {
          // Mock Transcription for now
          const transcript = "[Simulated Public Relations Presentation Transcript]";
          const score = await analyzePublicRelations(transcript, audience.name, questions);
          
          router.push({
              pathname: '/practice/public-relations/result',
              params: {
                  score: JSON.stringify(score),
                  videoUri: uri
              }
          });
      } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
          Alert.alert("Error", "Scoring failed.");
          router.back();
      }
  };

  if (!permission?.granted || !micPermission?.granted) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <Text style={styles.permTitle}>Permissions Required</Text>
              <Text style={styles.permSub}>We need access to your camera and microphone to record your practice.</Text>
              
              {!permission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="camera" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Camera Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
              
              {!micPermission?.granted && (
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permBtn} onPress={requestMicPermission}>
                    <Ionicons name="mic" size={24} color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.permBtnText}>Grant Microphone Access</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
          </View>
      );
  }

  if (phase === 'processing' && videoUri) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={{ marginTop: 20, fontSize: 18, color: Colors.navy }}>Judging Presentation...</Text>
          </View>
      );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <CameraView style={styles.camera} ref={cameraRef}>
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
            <View style={[styles.timerBadge, { borderColor: getTimerColor() }]}>
                <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: recording ? 'red' : 'gray' }]} />
                <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(seconds)}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.targetBadge}>Target: {audience.name}</Text>
        </View>

        {phase === 'setup' && (
            <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Ready to Present?</Text>
                <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Target: {audience.name}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.info}>Time Limit: 6-9 Minutes</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>Start Recording</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'presentation' && (
            <View style={styles.bottomOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.phaseLabel}>PHASE: PRESENTATION</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={nextPhase}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>End Presentation</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={24} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

        {phase === 'questions' && (
             <View style={styles.centerOverlay}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Question {currentQIndex + 1}/3</Text>
                <View style={styles.qCard}>
                    <Text style={styles.qText}>{questions[currentQIndex]}</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={() => {
                    if (currentQIndex < 2) setCurrentQIndex(i => i + 1);
                    else nextPhase();
                }}>
                    <Text style={styles.btnText}>{currentQIndex < 2 ? "Next Question" : "Finish"}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
             </View>
        )}
      </CameraView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'black' },
  centered: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'white' },
  camera: { flex: 1 },
  topBar: { paddingTop: 60, alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  timerBadge: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 10, borderRadius: 20, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', borderWidth: 2 },
  dot: { width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 6, marginRight: 8 },
  timerText: { color: 'white', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] },
  targetBadge: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', padding: 5, borderRadius: 4 },
  
  centerOverlay: { position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: 20 },
  bottomOverlay: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 50, left: 0, right: 0, alignItems: 'center' },
  
  title: { color: 'white', fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, textAlign: 'center' },
  subtitle: { color: Colors.gold, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 20 },
  info: { color: '#DDD', marginBottom: 30 },
  phaseLabel: { color: Colors.gold, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, letterSpacing: 1 },
  
  startBtn: { backgroundColor: Colors.success, paddingHorizontal: 40, paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 30 },

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, SafeAreaView } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { PRScore } from '@/lib/scoring/public-relations';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function PublicRelationsResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { score, videoUri } = useLocalSearchParams<{ score: string, videoUri: string }>();
  const parsedScore: PRScore = score ? JSON.parse(score) : null;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'video' | 'score'>('score');

  if (!parsedScore) return <View style={styles.centered}><Text>No Score Data</Text></View>;

  const getScoreColor = (s: number) => {
      if (s >= 900) return Colors.success;
      if (s >= 750) return Colors.gold;
      return Colors.error;
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => {
            if (parsedScore) {
                useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                    type: 'public-relations',
                    score: parsedScore.totalScore,
                    maxScore: 1000,
                    details: parsedScore
                });
            }
            router.replace('/practice/public-relations');
        }} style={styles.backBtn}>
            <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Presentation Results</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.tabs}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.tab, activeTab === 'video' && styles.activeTab]} onPress={() => setActiveTab('video')}>
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, activeTab === 'video' && styles.activeTabText]}>Video Playback</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.tab, activeTab === 'score' && styles.activeTab]} onPress={() => setActiveTab('score')}>
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, activeTab === 'score' && styles.activeTabText]}>AI Scorecard</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        {activeTab === 'video' && videoUri && (
            <View style={styles.videoParams}>
                <Video
                    source={{ uri: videoUri }}
                    style={styles.video}
                    useNativeControls
                    resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
                    isLooping
                />
            </View>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'score' && (
            <View style={styles.scoreContainer}>
                <View style={[styles.totalScoreCard, { borderColor: getScoreColor(parsedScore.totalScore) }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.totalLabel}>TOTAL SCORE</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.totalValue, { color: getScoreColor(parsedScore.totalScore) }]}>
                        {parsedScore.totalScore}<Text style={styles.totalMax}>/1000</Text>
                    </Text>
                </View>

                <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Detailed Breakdown</Text>
                <View style={styles.breakdownGrid}>
                    <ScoreItem label="Content" score={parsedScore.breakdown.content} max={275} />
                    <ScoreItem label="Effectiveness" score={parsedScore.breakdown.effectiveness} max={275} />
                    <ScoreItem label="Communication" score={parsedScore.breakdown.communication} max={275} />
                    <ScoreItem label="Questions" score={parsedScore.breakdown.questions} max={175} />
                </View>

                <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Audience Relevance</Text>
                <View style={styles.feedbackCard}>
                    <Ionicons name="people" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
                    <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{parsedScore.feedback.audienceRelevance}</Text>
                </View>

                <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Strengths</Text>
                {parsedScore.feedback.strengths.map((s, i) => (
                    <View key={i} style={styles.feedbackItem}>
                        <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color={Colors.success} />
                        <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{s}</Text>
                    </View>
                ))}

                <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Improvements</Text>
                {parsedScore.feedback.improvements.map((s, i) => (
                    <View key={i} style={styles.feedbackItem}>
                        <Ionicons name="construct" size={20} color={Colors.warning} />
                        <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{s}</Text>
                    </View>
                ))}
            </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const ScoreItem = ({ label, score, max }: { label: string, score: number, max: number }) => (
    <View style={styles.scoreRow}>
        <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>{label}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.scoreValue}>{score} <Text style={{fontSize: 12, color: '#999'}}>/ {max}</Text></Text>
        <View style={styles.progressBar}>
            <View style={[styles.progressFill, { width: `${(score / max) * 100}%` }]} />
        </View>
    </View>
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.background },
  centered: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },
  header: { padding: 20, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#EEE', backgroundColor: 'white' },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold', marginLeft: 10, color: Colors.navy },
  backBtn: { padding: 5 },
  
  tabs: { flexDirection: 'row', padding: 10, backgroundColor: 'white' },
  tab: { flex: 1, padding: 10, alignItems: 'center', borderRadius: 8 },
  activeTab: { backgroundColor: Colors.navy },
  tabText: { color: Colors.textLight, fontWeight: 'bold' },
  activeTabText: { color: 'white' },

  content: { padding: 20 },
  videoParams: { height: 300, backgroundColor: 'black', borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' },
  video: { flex: 1 },

  scoreContainer: { gap: 20 },
  totalScoreCard: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 30, borderRadius: 20, alignItems: 'center', borderWidth: 3 },
  totalLabel: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 'bold', color: '#999', letterSpacing: 2 },
  totalValue: { fontSize: 64, fontWeight: 'bold' },
  totalMax: { fontSize: 24, color: '#CCC' },

  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy, marginTop: 10 },
  breakdownGrid: { backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12 },
  scoreRow: { marginBottom: 15 },
  scoreLabel: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600', color: Colors.navy, marginBottom: 5 },
  scoreValue: { position: 'absolute', right: 0, top: 0, fontWeight: 'bold', color: Colors.navy },
  progressBar: { height: 8, backgroundColor: '#EEE', borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' },
  progressFill: { height: '100%', backgroundColor: Colors.success },

  feedbackCard: { backgroundColor: '#E3F2FD', padding: 15, borderRadius: 12, flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' },
  feedbackItem: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10, alignItems: 'flex-start', backgroundColor: 'white', padding: 12, borderRadius: 8 },
  feedbackText: { flex: 1, color: Colors.navy, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 20 }
});

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, Alert, ActivityIndicator, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { Audio } from 'expo-av';
import { analyzeRadioBroadcast } from '@/lib/scoring/radio-broadcast';

export default function RadioRecord() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [permissionResponse, requestPermission] = Audio.usePermissions();
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState<Audio.Recording | undefined>(undefined);
  const [sound, setSound] = useState<Audio.Sound | undefined>(undefined);
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [uri, setUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (sound) sound.unloadAsync();
    };
  }, [sound]);

  async function startRecording() {
    try {
      if (permissionResponse?.status !== 'granted') {
        console.log('Requesting permission..');
        const permission = await requestPermission();
        if (permission.status !== 'granted') {
            Alert.alert("Permission Required", "Please grant microphone access to record.");
            return;
        }
      }

      await Audio.setAudioModeAsync({
        allowsRecordingIOS: true,
        playsInSilentModeIOS: true,
      });

      console.log('Starting recording..');
      const { recording } = await Audio.Recording.createAsync(
        Audio.RecordingOptionsPresets.HIGH_QUALITY
      );
      setRecording(recording);
      setIsRecording(true);
      setDuration(0);
      setUri(null);
      setSound(undefined);

      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setDuration(prev => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to start recording', err);
      Alert.alert("Error", "Could not start recording.");
    }
  }

  async function stopRecording() {
    console.log('Stopping recording..');
    if (!recording) return;
    
    setIsRecording(false);
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    
    await recording.stopAndUnloadAsync();
    const uri = recording.getURI(); 
    setRecording(undefined);
    setUri(uri);
    
    // Create sound for playback
    if (uri) {
        const { sound } = await Audio.Sound.createAsync({ uri });
        setSound(sound);
    }
    
    console.log('Recording stopped and stored at', uri);
  }

  async function playSound() {
    if (!sound) return;
    if (isPlaying) {
        await sound.pauseAsync();
        setIsPlaying(false);
    } else {
        await sound.playAsync();
        setIsPlaying(true);
        sound.setOnPlaybackStatusUpdate((status) => {
            if (status.isLoaded && status.didJustFinish) {
                setIsPlaying(false);
                sound.setPositionAsync(0);
            }
        });
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmit() {
    if (!uri) return;
    
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    try {
        const results = await analyzeRadioBroadcast(uri);
        router.push({
            pathname: '/practice/radio-broadcasting/result',
            params: { 
              results: JSON.stringify(results),
              audioUri: uri 
            }
        });
    } catch (error) {
        Alert.alert("Analysis Failed", "Could not score the broadcast. Please try again.");
    } finally {
        setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  }

  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = seconds % 60;
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const timerColor = duration < 360 ? Colors.text : (duration > 480 ? Colors.error : Colors.success); // Red if > 8 min, Green if 6-8

  if (isAnalyzing) {
      return (
          <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#D81B60" />
              <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Analyzing Broadcast...</Text>
              <Text style={styles.subLoadingText}>Checking 1000-point rubric...</Text>
          </View>
      );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Recording Section', headerBackTitle: 'Radio' }} />
      
      <View style={styles.timerContainer}>
        <Text style={[styles.timerText, { color: timerColor }]}>{formatTime(duration)}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.timerLabel}>Target: 6:00 - 8:00</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.controls}>
        {!uri && (
            <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[styles.recordButton, isRecording && styles.recordingActive]} 
                onPress={isRecording ? stopRecording : startRecording}
            >
                <Ionicons name={isRecording ? "stop" : "mic"} size={48} color={Colors.white} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
        
        {uri && (
             <View style={styles.reviewContainer}>
                <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Recording Complete!</Text>
                
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.playButton} onPress={playSound}>
                    <Ionicons name={isPlaying ? "pause" : "play"} size={32} color={Colors.white} />
                    <Text style={styles.playButtonText}>{isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Listen"}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.retryButton} onPress={() => {
                    setUri(null);
                    setDuration(0);
                    setSound(undefined);
                }}>
                    <Text style={styles.retryText}>Record Again</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.submitButton} onPress={handleSubmit}>
                    <Text style={styles.submitText}>Submit for Scoring</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={24} color={Colors.white} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
             </View>
        )}
      </View>
      
      {isRecording && (
          <Text style={styles.recordingHint}>Recording in progress... Tap stop when finished.</Text>
      )}

    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: 20,
  },
  loadingContainer: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Colors.background,
  },
  loadingText: {
    marginTop: 20,
    fontSize: 20,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    color: '#D81B60',
  },
  subLoadingText: {
    marginTop: 8,
    color: Colors.textLight,
  },
  timerContainer: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    marginBottom: 60,
  },
  timerText: {
    fontSize: 72,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'],
  },
  timerLabel: {
    fontSize: 16,
    color: Colors.textLight,
    marginTop: 8,
  },
  controls: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    width: '100%',
  },
  recordButton: {
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    borderRadius: 50,
    backgroundColor: '#D81B60',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    shadowColor: '#D81B60',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.4,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 6,
  },
  recordingActive: {
    backgroundColor: Colors.error,
    transform: [{ scale: 1.1 }],
    padding: 2, // visual tweak
    borderWidth: 4,
    borderColor: '#ff8a80',
  },
  recordingHint: {
    marginTop: 32,
    color: Colors.textLight,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
  },
  reviewContainer: {
    width: '100%',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 16,
  },
  reviewText: {
    fontSize: 20,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    color: Colors.success,
    marginBottom: 8,
  },
  playButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Colors.navy,
    paddingHorizontal: 32,
    paddingVertical: 16,
    borderRadius: 30,
    marginBottom: 24,
  },
  playButtonText: {
    color: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    marginLeft: 12,
  },
  submitButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Colors.success,
    paddingHorizontal: 32,
    paddingVertical: 16,
    borderRadius: 16,
    width: '100%',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  submitText: {
    color: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: 'bold',
    marginRight: 12,
  },
  retryButton: {
