import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { RadioAnalysis } from '@/lib/scoring/radio-broadcast';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';
import { Audio } from 'expo-av';

export default function RadioResult() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const results = params.results ? JSON.parse(params.results as string) as RadioAnalysis : null;
  const audioUri = params.audioUri as string;

  const [sound, setSound] = useState<Audio.Sound | null>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (sound) {
        sound.unloadAsync();
      }
    };
  }, [sound]);

  const togglePlayback = async () => {
    if (!audioUri) return;

    try {
        if (sound) {
            if (isPlaying) {
                await sound.pauseAsync();
                setIsPlaying(false);
            } else {
                await sound.playAsync();
                setIsPlaying(true);
            }
        } else {
            console.log('Loading Sound:', audioUri);
            const { sound: newSound } = await Audio.Sound.createAsync({ uri: audioUri });
            setSound(newSound);
            
            newSound.setOnPlaybackStatusUpdate((status) => {
                if (status.isLoaded && status.didJustFinish) {
                    setIsPlaying(false);
                    newSound.setPositionAsync(0);
                }
            });

            await newSound.playAsync();
            setIsPlaying(true);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Playback failed', error);
    }
  };

  if (!results) return null;

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 900) return Colors.success;
    if (score >= 700) return Colors.warning;
    return Colors.error;
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Broadcast Score', headerLeft: () => null }} />
      
      <View style={styles.scoreCard}>
        <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>Final Score</Text>
        <Text style={[styles.scoreValue, { color: getScoreColor(results.score) }]}>
            {results.score}<Text style={styles.scoreMax}>/1000</Text>
        </Text>
        
        <View style={styles.breakdownContainer}>
            <View style={styles.breakdownItem}>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Base Score</Text>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownValue}>{results.baseScore}</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.verticalDivider} />
            <View style={styles.breakdownItem}>
                 <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Time Penalty</Text>
                 <Text style={[styles.breakdownValue, { color: Colors.error }]}>
                    -{results.timePenalty}
                 </Text>
            </View>
        </View>
        
        <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>
            Duration: {Math.floor(results.durationSeconds / 60)}:{(Math.floor(results.durationSeconds) % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}
        </Text>

        {audioUri && (
             <TouchableOpacity style={styles.playButton} onPress={togglePlayback}>
                <Ionicons name={isPlaying ? "pause-circle" : "play-circle"} size={48} color={Colors.navy} />
                <Text style={styles.playButtonText}>{isPlaying ? "Pause Broadcast" : "Listen to Broadcast"}</Text>
             </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Judge's Feedback</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{results.feedback}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.row}>
        <View style={[styles.halfSection, { marginRight: 8 }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.success }]}>Strengths</Text>
            {results.strengths.map((str, idx) => (
                <View key={idx} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={16} color={Colors.success} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{str}</Text>
                </View>
            ))}
        </View>
        
        <View style={[styles.halfSection, { marginLeft: 8 }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: Colors.error }]}>Improvements</Text>
            {results.improvements.map((imp, idx) => (
                <View key={idx} style={styles.bulletItem}>
                    <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={16} color={Colors.error} style={{marginTop: 2}} />
                    <Text style={styles.bulletText}>{imp}</Text>
                </View>
            ))}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Transcript</Text>
        <View style={[styles.card, styles.transcriptCard]}>
            <Text style={styles.transcriptText}>{results.transcription}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.doneButton} onPress={() => {
        if (results) {
            useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
                type: 'radio-broadcasting',
                score: results.score,
                maxScore: 1000,
                details: results,
                metadata: {
                   duration: results.durationSeconds
                }
            });
        }
        router.dismissTo('/(tabs)/lde');
      }}>
        <Text style={styles.doneButtonText}>Done</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Switch, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { QUIZ_SOURCES, QuizSource, QuizSettings } from '@/lib/senior-quiz';

export default function SeniorQuizBuilder() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { mode } = useLocalSearchParams<{ mode: string | string[] }>();
  const isMockMode = mode === 'mock' || (Array.isArray(mode) && mode.includes('mock'));
  console.log("Builder Params Mode:", mode);
  console.log("Is Mock Mode:", isMockMode);

  const [selectedTopics, setSelectedTopics] = useState<Record<QuizSource, boolean>>({
    "FFA Manual": true,
    "Parliamentary Guide": true,
    "Leadership Guide": true,
    "Farm Facts": true,
    "Current Events": true,
  });

  const [questionCount, setQuestionCount] = useState<number>(10);
  const [questionType, setQuestionType] = useState<'mixed' | 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false'>('mixed');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMockMode) {
      // Mock Data Setup
      setQuestionCount(150);
      setQuestionType('mixed');
      const allSources: Record<QuizSource, boolean> = {
          "FFA Manual": true,
          "Parliamentary Guide": true,
          "Leadership Guide": true,
          "Farm Facts": true,
          "Current Events": true,
      };
      setSelectedTopics(allSources);
    }
  }, [isMockMode]);

  const toggleTopic = (source: QuizSource) => {
    setSelectedTopics(prev => ({ ...prev, [source]: !prev[source] }));
  };

  const handleStartQuiz = () => {
    const activeTopics = (Object.keys(selectedTopics) as QuizSource[]).filter(t => selectedTopics[t]);
    
    if (activeTopics.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Please select at least one topic.");
      return;
    }

    const settings: QuizSettings = {
      topics: activeTopics,
      questionCount: isMockMode ? 150 : questionCount,
      type: questionType,
      isMock: isMockMode
    };
    console.log("Starting Quiz with Settings:", JSON.stringify(settings));

    router.push({
      pathname: '/practice/senior-quiz/quiz',
      params: { settings: JSON.stringify(settings) }
    });
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: isMockMode ? 'Mock Exam Setup' : 'Custom Quiz Builder', headerBackTitle: 'Senior Quiz' }} />

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Select Topics</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          {QUIZ_SOURCES.map((source) => (
            <View key={source} style={styles.row}>
              <Text style={styles.label}>{source}</Text>
              <Switch 
                value={selectedTopics[source]} 
                onValueChange={() => toggleTopic(source)}
                trackColor={{ false: Colors.border, true: Colors.success }}
                disabled={isMockMode} // Locked for mock exam
              />
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Number of Questions</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
            {isMockMode ? (
                 <View style={styles.highlightRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.highlightText}>150 Questions (Official Format)</Text>
                 </View>
            ) : (
                <View style={styles.pillContainer}>
                    {[10, 20, 30, 50, 100].map(num => (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={num}
                        style={[styles.pill, questionCount === num && styles.pillActive]}
                        onPress={() => setQuestionCount(num)}
                    >
                        <Text style={[styles.pillText, questionCount === num && styles.pillTextActive]}>{num}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.section}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Question Type</Text>
        <View style={styles.card}>
            {isMockMode ? (
                <View style={styles.highlightRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.highlightText}>Mixed (75 T/F, 75 MC)</Text>
                </View>
            ) : (
                <View style={styles.pillContainer}>
                    {(['mixed', 'multiple_choice', 'true_false'] as const).map(type => (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={type}
                        style={[styles.pill, questionType === type && styles.pillActive]}
                        onPress={() => setQuestionType(type)}
                    >
                        <Text style={[styles.pillText, questionType === type && styles.pillTextActive]}>
                        {type === 'mixed' ? 'Mixed' : type === 'multiple_choice' ? 'Multiple Choice' : 'True/False'}
                        </Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
            )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={handleStartQuiz}>
        <Ionicons name="play" size={24} color={Colors.white} style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
        <Text style={styles.startButtonText}>Start Quiz</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {/* Debug Info */}
      <View style={{ padding: 20, opacity: 0.5 }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#666' }}>Mode Param: {JSON.stringify(mode)}</Text>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#666' }}>Is Mock: {isMockMode ? 'YES' : 'NO'}</Text>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#666' }}>Settings Count: {questionCount}</Text>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { QUIZ_SOURCES, QuizSource, generateStudyGuide } from '@/lib/senior-quiz';
import Markdown from 'react-native-markdown-display';

export default function SeniorQuizStudyGuide() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedTopic, setSelectedTopic] = useState<QuizSource | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [guideContent, setGuideContent] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSelectTopic = async (topic: QuizSource) => {
    setSelectedTopic(topic);
    setLoading(true);
    setGuideContent(null);
    try {
      const content = await generateStudyGuide(topic);
      setGuideContent(content);
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Could not generate study guide.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedTopic(null);
    setGuideContent(null);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Study Guide', headerBackTitle: 'Senior Quiz' }} />
      
      {!selectedTopic ? (
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
          <Text style={styles.headerText}>
            Select a resource to generate a targeted study guide using the official Texas FFA rules and materials.
          </Text>
          <View style={styles.grid}>
            {QUIZ_SOURCES.map((source) => (
              <TouchableOpacity 
                key={source} 
                style={styles.card} 
                onPress={() => handleSelectTopic(source)}
              >
                <Ionicons name="book-outline" size={32} color={Colors.navy} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
                <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{source}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.guideContainer}>
          <View style={styles.guideHeader}>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={clearSelection} style={styles.backButton}>
              <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Back to Topics</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.topicTitle}>{selectedTopic}</Text>
          </View>

          {loading ? (
            <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
              <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Generating Guide...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.guideContent}>
               <Markdown style={markdownStyles}>
                 {guideContent || "No content generated."}
               </Markdown>
            </ScrollView>
          )}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

<file path="app/practice/senior-quiz/quiz.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Alert, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Colors } from '@/constants/colors';
import { generateQuizQuestions, QuizQuestion, QuizSettings } from '@/lib/senior-quiz';
import { useHistoryStore } from '@/lib/store/history';

export default function SeniorQuizActive() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<QuizQuestion[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedAnswer, setSelectedAnswer] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAnswered, setIsAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (params.settings) {
      loadQuiz(JSON.parse(params.settings as string));
    }
  }, [params.settings]);

  const loadQuiz = async (settings: QuizSettings) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const generated = await generateQuizQuestions(settings);
      setQuestions(generated);
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to generate quiz. Please check your connection and try again.", [
        { text: "Go Back", onPress: () => router.back() }
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];

  const handleAnswer = (option: string) => {
    if (isAnswered) return;
    
    setSelectedAnswer(option);
    setIsAnswered(true);

    // Robust check: match string directly OR resolve letter (A, B, C, D) if provided
    let isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.correctAnswer);
    
    if (!isCorrect && currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && currentQuestion.options) {
        const letterMap: Record<string, number> = { 'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2, 'D': 3 };
        const correctIdx = letterMap[currentQuestion.correctAnswer.trim().toUpperCase()];
        if (correctIdx !== undefined && currentQuestion.options[correctIdx]) {
             isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.options[correctIdx]);
        }
    }

    if (isCorrect) {
      setScore(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  const nextQuestion = () => {
    if (currentIndex < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedAnswer(null);
      setIsAnswered(false);
    } else {
      finishQuiz();
    }
  };

  const finishQuiz = () => {
    useHistoryStore.getState().addResult({
        type: 'senior-chapter-quiz',
        score: score,
        maxScore: questions.length,
        details: {
            totalQuestions: questions.length,
            correct: score
        }
    });
    setShowResults(true);
  };

  // Calculate if this question starts a new section (or just show the source always)
  // Rule says "Section headers will be used to divide section questions by resource."
  // Since we might shuffle or not, let's just clearly header it.

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Colors.navy} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Generating your custom quiz...</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subLoadingText}>Consulting official FFA rules & manuals...</Text>
        
        <TouchableOpacity 
            style={[styles.primaryButton, { marginTop: 40, backgroundColor: 'transparent', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#ccc' }]} 
            onPress={() => router.back()}
        >
            <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: '#666', fontSize: 14 }]}>CANCEL & GO BACK</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
        <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={48} color={Colors.error} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>No questions generated.</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subLoadingText}>Please try again with different settings.</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Go Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (showResults) {
    const percentage = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Quiz Results', headerLeft: () => null }} />
        
        <View style={styles.resultCard}>
          <Ionicons name={percentage >= 70 ? "trophy" : "school"} size={64} color={Colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.resultScore}>{percentage}%</Text>
          <Text style={styles.resultSubtext}>You got {score} out of {questions.length} correct</Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Return to Menu</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }
  
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: `Question ${currentIndex + 1}/${questions.length}`, headerBackTitle: 'Quit' }} />

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        
        <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderText}>SECTION: {currentQuestion.source}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.questionCard}>
            <View style={styles.typeTag}>
                <Text style={styles.typeText}>{currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' ? 'Multiple Choice' : 'True / False'}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.questionText}>{currentQuestion.text}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.optionsContainer}>
            {currentQuestion.options?.map((option, idx) => {
                const label = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'][idx];
                const isSelected = selectedAnswer === option;
                
                // Robust correct check for UI highlighting
                let isCorrect = (option === currentQuestion.correctAnswer);
                if (!isCorrect && currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && currentQuestion.options) {
                    const letterMap: Record<string, number> = { 'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2, 'D': 3 };
                    const correctIdx = letterMap[currentQuestion.correctAnswer.trim().toUpperCase()];
                    if (correctIdx !== undefined) {
                         isCorrect = (idx === correctIdx);
                    }
                }
                
                let optionStyle = styles.optionButton;
                let textStyle = styles.optionText;
                let icon = null;

                if (isAnswered) {
                    if (isCorrect) {
                        optionStyle = styles.optionCorrect;
                        textStyle = styles.optionTextWhite;
                        icon = "checkmark-circle";
                    } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                        optionStyle = styles.optionWrong;
                        textStyle = styles.optionTextWhite;
                        icon = "close-circle";
                    }
                } else if (isSelected) {
                    optionStyle = styles.optionSelected;
                }

                // If type is MC, we typically want letters for standard display, but the generator returns full strings mostly. 
                // If the generator returns "A", "B"... we can match. 
                // Assuming options are full text strings for now or letters if provided.
                // label is already declared at line 153


                return (
                    <TouchableOpacity 
                        key={idx} 
                        style={optionStyle}
                        onPress={() => handleAnswer(option)}
                        disabled={isAnswered}
                    >
                       <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center'}}>
                            {currentQuestion.type === 'multiple_choice' && <Text style={[styles.optionLabel, isAnswered && (isCorrect || (isSelected && !isCorrect)) && {color: 'white'}]}>{label}. </Text>}
                            <Text style={textStyle}>{option}</Text>
                       </View>
                       {icon && <Ionicons name={icon as any} size={24} color="white" />}
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                );
            })}
        </View>

        {isAnswered && (
            <View style={styles.feedbackContainer}>
                <Text style={styles.feedbackTitle}>Explanation:</Text>
                <Text style={styles.feedbackText}>{currentQuestion.explanation}</Text>
                
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextButton} onPress={nextQuestion}>
                    <Text style={styles.nextButtonText}>{currentIndex === questions.length - 1 ? "Finish Quiz" : "Next Question"}</Text>
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        )}

      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useQuizStore } from '@/lib/store/quiz';
import { getQuestions } from '@/lib/data';
import { Question } from '@/types';
import CategorySelector from '@/components/CategorySelector';
import ProgressBar from '@/components/ProgressBar';
import FlashCard from '@/components/FlashCard';

export default function FlashcardScreen() {
  const { contestId, contestName } = useLocalSearchParams<{ contestId: string; contestName: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showSummary, setShowSummary] = useState(false);

  const [isSetup, setIsSetup] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [availableCategories, setAvailableCategories] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [allQuestions, setAllQuestions] = useState<Question[]>([]);

  const {
    questions, currentIndex, knownCards, studyMoreCards, isFlipped,
    initQuiz, markCard, flipCard, nextQuestion, prevQuestion, reset,
  } = useQuizStore();

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];
  const isLastCard = currentIndex === questions.length - 1;
  const totalReviewed = knownCards.length + studyMoreCards.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuestions();
  }, []);

  const loadQuestions = async () => {
    if (!contestId) return;
    const qs = await getQuestions(contestId);
    if (qs.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert('No Questions', 'No flashcards available for this contest yet.');
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    
    setAllQuestions(qs);
    const categories = Array.from(new Set(qs.map(q => q.subcategory).filter(Boolean))) as string[];
    setAvailableCategories(categories.sort());
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleStart = () => {
    const filtered = selectedCategory
      ? allQuestions.filter(q => q.subcategory === selectedCategory)
      : allQuestions;
    
    // Shuffle for variety
    const shuffled = [...filtered].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

    initQuiz({ 
      questions: shuffled, 
      mode: 'flashcard', 
      contestId, 
      contestName: contestName || '' 
    });
    setIsSetup(true);
  };

  const handleMark = (known: boolean) => {
    if (!currentQuestion) return;
    markCard(currentQuestion.id, known);

    if (isLastCard) {
      setShowSummary(true);
    } else {
      nextQuestion();
    }
  };

  const handleRestartStudyMore = () => {
    const studyQuestions = questions.filter(q => studyMoreCards.includes(q.id));
    if (studyQuestions.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert('All Done!', 'You know all the cards! Great job!');
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    initQuiz({
      questions: studyQuestions,
      mode: 'flashcard',
      contestId: contestId || '',
      contestName: contestName || '',
    });
    setShowSummary(false);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading flashcards...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!isSetup) {
    return (
      <CategorySelector
        categories={availableCategories}
        selectedCategory={selectedCategory}
        onSelect={setSelectedCategory}
        onStart={handleStart}
        totalQuestions={allQuestions.length}
      />
    );
  }

  if (showSummary) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.summaryContainer}>
        <View style={styles.summaryCard}>
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-done-circle" size={64} color="#F2A900" />
          <Text style={styles.summaryTitle}>Flashcards Complete!</Text>

          <View style={styles.summaryStats}>
            <View style={styles.summaryStatItem}>
              <Text style={styles.summaryStatNumber}>{knownCards.length}</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.summaryStatLabel, { color: '#4CAF50' }]}>Got It</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.summaryDivider} />
            <View style={styles.summaryStatItem}>
              <Text style={styles.summaryStatNumber}>{studyMoreCards.length}</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.summaryStatLabel, { color: '#FF9800' }]}>Study More</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.summaryDivider} />
            <View style={styles.summaryStatItem}>
              <Text style={styles.summaryStatNumber}>{questions.length}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryStatLabel}>Total</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {studyMoreCards.length > 0 && (
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.restartButton} onPress={handleRestartStudyMore}>
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={20} color="#fff" />
              <Text style={styles.restartText}>Review {studyMoreCards.length} Cards Again</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.doneButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Text style={styles.doneText}>Back to Contest</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!currentQuestion) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <Text>No cards available</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Progress */}
      <ProgressBar current={currentIndex + 1} total={questions.length} color="#9C27B0" />

      {/* Stats row */}
      <View style={styles.statsRow}>
        <View style={styles.stat}>
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={16} color="#4CAF50" />
          <Text style={styles.statText}>{knownCards.length} Got It</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.stat}>
          <Ionicons name="refresh-circle" size={16} color="#FF9800" />
          <Text style={styles.statText}>{studyMoreCards.length} Study More</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Flashcard */}
      <View style={styles.cardContainer}>
        <FlashCard
          front={currentQuestion.question_text}
          back={currentQuestion.correct_answer}
          backDetail={currentQuestion.explanation || undefined}
          isFlipped={isFlipped}
          onFlip={flipCard}
          subcategory={currentQuestion.subcategory || undefined}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Action buttons */}
      <View style={styles.actions}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.studyMoreBtn} onPress={() => handleMark(false)}>
          <Ionicons name="refresh" size={24} color="#FF9800" />
          <Text style={styles.studyMoreText}>Study More</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.gotItBtn} onPress={() => handleMark(true)}>
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color="#4CAF50" />
          <Text style={styles.gotItText}>Got It!</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  loadingText: {
    marginTop: 12,
    fontSize: 15,
    color: '#666',
  },
  statsRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 24,
    paddingVertical: 4,
  },
  stat: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 4,
  },
  statText: {
    fontSize: 13,
    color: '#666',
    fontWeight: '600',
  },
  cardContainer: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 24,
  },
  actions: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    paddingHorizontal: 24,
    paddingVertical: 20,
    gap: 16,
  },
  studyMoreBtn: {
    flex: 1,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#FFF3E0',
    borderWidth: 2,
    borderColor: '#FF9800',
    borderRadius: 14,
    padding: 16,
    gap: 8,
  },
  studyMoreText: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#FF9800',
  },
  gotItBtn: {
    flex: 1,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#E8F5E9',
    borderWidth: 2,
    borderColor: '#4CAF50',
    borderRadius: 14,
    padding: 16,
    gap: 8,
  },
  gotItText: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#4CAF50',
  },
  // Summary styles
  summaryContainer: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: 24,
  },
  summaryCard: {
    backgroundColor: '#fff',
    borderRadius: 20,
    padding: 32,
    alignItems: 'center',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.1,
    shadowRadius: 12,
    elevation: 4,
  },
  summaryTitle: {
    fontSize: 24,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: '#003366',
    marginTop: 16,
    marginBottom: 24,
  },
  summaryStats: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    marginBottom: 24,
  },
  summaryStatItem: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
  },
  summaryStatNumber: {
    fontSize: 28,

    color: '#333',
  },

    fontSize: 13,
    color: '#888',

    marginTop: 2,
  },

    width: 1,
    height: 40,
    backgroundColor: '#e0e0e0',
  },

<file path="app/practice/results.tsx">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, FlatList, ScrollView,
} from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useQuizStore, getQuizScore, getTimeElapsed } from '@/lib/store/quiz';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/lib/store/auth';
import { saveSession, updateProgress } from '@/lib/data';
import ScoreCircle from '@/components/ScoreCircle';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function ResultsScreen() {
  const { contestId, contestName } = useLocalSearchParams<{ contestId: string; contestName: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const quizState = useQuizStore();
  const { questions, answers, mode, reset } = quizState;

  const score = getQuizScore(quizState);
  const timeElapsed = getTimeElapsed(quizState);
  const minutes = Math.floor(timeElapsed / 60);
  const seconds = timeElapsed % 60;

  useEffect(() => {
    savePracticeData();
  }, []);

  const savePracticeData = async () => {
    if (!user || !contestId) return;

    // Save practice session
    await saveSession({
      user_id: user.id,
      contest_id: contestId,
      session_type: mode === 'study' ? 'practice' : mode,
      score: score.percentage,
      total_questions: score.total,
      correct_answers: score.correct,
      time_spent_seconds: timeElapsed,
      completed: true,
      started_at: new Date(quizState.startTime || Date.now()).toISOString(),
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // Update progress
    await updateProgress(user.id, contestId, score.percentage, timeElapsed);
  };

  const handleTryAgain = () => {
    reset();
    router.replace({
      pathname: mode === 'test' ? '/practice/test' : '/practice/study',
      params: {
        contestId,
        contestName,
        timeLimit: mode === 'test' ? String(quizState.timeLimit || 3600) : undefined,
      },
    });
  };

  const handleBackToContest = () => {
    reset();
    router.replace(`/contest/${contestId}`);
  };

  const getResultIcon = (questionId: string): { name: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap; color: string } => {
    if (!(questionId in answers)) {
      return { name: 'remove-circle-outline', color: '#999' };
    }
    const question = questions.find(q => q.id === questionId);
    if (!question) return { name: 'remove-circle-outline', color: '#999' };

    // For scenario questions, just mark as reviewed
    if (question.question_type === 'scenario') {
      return { name: 'eye', color: '#2196F3' };
    }

    return answers[questionId] === question.correct_answer
      ? { name: 'checkmark-circle', color: '#4CAF50' }
      : { name: 'close-circle', color: '#F44336' };
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
      {/* Score Circle */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}>
        <View style={styles.scoreSection}>
          <ScoreCircle percentage={score.percentage} />
        </View>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Stats Row */}
      <View style={styles.statsRow}>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }} style={styles.statCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={22} color="#4CAF50" />
            <Text style={styles.statNumber}>{score.correct}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>CORRECT</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }} style={styles.statCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={22} color="#F44336" />
            <Text style={styles.statNumber}>{score.total - score.correct}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>INCORRECT</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }} style={styles.statCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.statCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="time" size={22} color="#00f2ff" />
            <Text style={styles.statNumber}>{minutes}:{String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>TIME</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
      </View>

      {/* Contest name */}
      <Text style={styles.contestName}>{contestName.toUpperCase()}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.modeLabel}>
        {mode === 'study' ? 'STUDY MODE' : mode === 'test' ? 'TEST MODE' : 'PRACTICE'}
      </Text>

      {/* Question Review */}
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>QUESTION REVIEW</Text>
      {questions.map((q, index) => {
        const icon = getResultIcon(q.id);
        const userAnswer = answers[q.id];
        const isCorrect = userAnswer === q.correct_answer;
        const isScenario = q.question_type === 'scenario';

        return (
          <motion.div 
            key={q.id} 
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} 
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} 
            transition={{ delay: 0.05 * index }}
          >
            <View style={[styles.reviewCard, styles.glass]}>
              <View style={styles.reviewHeader}>
                <Ionicons name={icon.name} size={20} color={icon.color} />
                <Text style={styles.reviewNumber}>Q{index + 1}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.reviewQuestion} numberOfLines={2}>
                  {q.question_text}
                </Text>
              </View>
              {!isScenario && userAnswer && !isCorrect && (
                <View style={styles.reviewDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.reviewYourAnswer}>YOUR ANSWER: {userAnswer}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.reviewCorrectAnswer}>CORRECT: {q.correct_answer}</Text>
                </View>
              )}
              {!isScenario && !userAnswer && (
                <Text style={styles.reviewSkipped}>NOT ANSWERED</Text>
              )}
            </View>
          </motion.div>
        );
      })}

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      <View style={styles.actions}>
        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.tryAgainButton} onPress={handleTryAgain}>
            <Ionicons name="refresh" size={20} color={Theme.colors.black} />
            <Text style={styles.tryAgainText}>TRY AGAIN</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.backButton, styles.glass]} onPress={handleBackToContest}>
            <Text style={styles.backText}>BACK TO CONTEST</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </motion.div>
      </View>

      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  content: {
    padding: 20,
  },
  scoreSection: {

  },

  },

  },

  },
  sectionTitle: {

  },
  reviewCard: {

  },

  },

<file path="app/practice/study.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useQuizStore } from '@/lib/store/quiz';
import { getQuestions } from '@/lib/data';
import { Question } from '@/types';
import CategorySelector from '@/components/CategorySelector';
import ProgressBar from '@/components/ProgressBar';
import QuestionCard from '@/components/QuestionCard';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function StudyModeScreen() {
  const { contestId, contestName } = useLocalSearchParams<{ contestId: string; contestName: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSetup, setIsSetup] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [availableCategories, setAvailableCategories] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [allQuestions, setAllQuestions] = useState<Question[]>([]);

  const {
    questions, currentIndex, answers, showExplanation,
    initQuiz, answerQuestion, nextQuestion, prevQuestion, completeQuiz,
  } = useQuizStore();

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];
  const isLastQuestion = currentIndex === questions.length - 1;
  const isAnswered = currentQuestion ? currentQuestion.id in answers : false;

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuestions();
  }, []);

  const loadQuestions = async () => {
    if (!contestId) return;
    const qs = await getQuestions(contestId);
    if (qs.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert('No Questions', 'No practice questions available for this contest yet.');
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    
    setAllQuestions(qs);
    const categories = Array.from(new Set(qs.map(q => q.subcategory).filter(Boolean))) as string[];
    setAvailableCategories(categories.sort());
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleStart = () => {
    const filtered = selectedCategory
      ? allQuestions.filter(q => q.subcategory === selectedCategory)
      : allQuestions;
    
    // Shuffle for variety
    const shuffled = [...filtered].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

    initQuiz({ 
      questions: shuffled, 
      mode: 'study', 
      contestId, 
      contestName: contestName || '' 
    });
    setIsSetup(true);
  };

  const handleAnswer = (answer: string) => {
    if (currentQuestion) {
      answerQuestion(currentQuestion.id, answer);
    }
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (isLastQuestion) {
      completeQuiz();
      router.replace({
        pathname: '/practice/results',
        params: { contestId, contestName },
      });
    } else {
      nextQuestion();
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.center, { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Theme.colors.accent} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>LOADING QUESTIONS...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!isSetup) {
    return (
      <CategorySelector
        categories={availableCategories}
        selectedCategory={selectedCategory}
        onSelect={setSelectedCategory}
        onStart={handleStart}
        totalQuestions={allQuestions.length}
      />
    );
  }

  if (!currentQuestion) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <Text>No questions available</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Progress */}
      <ProgressBar current={currentIndex + 1} total={questions.length} />

      {/* Question */}
      <QuestionCard
        question={currentQuestion}
        questionNumber={currentIndex + 1}
        selectedAnswer={answers[currentQuestion.id] || null}
        showResult={isAnswered && showExplanation}
        onSelectAnswer={handleAnswer}
      />

      {/* Navigation */}
      <View style={[styles.nav, styles.glass]}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.navButton, currentIndex === 0 && styles.navButtonDisabled]}
          onPress={prevQuestion}
          disabled={currentIndex === 0}
        >
          <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={20} color={currentIndex === 0 ? '#444' : Theme.colors.accent} />
          <Text style={[styles.navText, currentIndex === 0 && styles.navTextDisabled]}>PREVIOUS</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {isAnswered ? (
          <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextButton} onPress={handleNext}>
              <Text style={styles.nextButtonText}>{isLastQuestion ? 'SEE RESULTS' : 'NEXT'}</Text>
              <Ionicons name={isLastQuestion ? 'trophy' : 'chevron-forward'} size={20} color={Theme.colors.black} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.answerPrompt}>
            <Text style={styles.answerPromptText}>Select an answer</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  loadingText: {
    marginTop: 16,
    fontSize: 13,
    color: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
    fontWeight: '800',
    letterSpacing: 1.5,
  },
  nav: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingVertical: 16,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    borderTopColor: Theme.colors.glass.border,
  },
  glass: GlassEffect,
  navButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    padding: 8,
    gap: 4,
  },
  navButtonDisabled: {
    opacity: 0.3,
  },
  navText: {
    fontSize: 13,
    color: Theme.colors.accent,
    fontWeight: '800',
    letterSpacing: 1,
  },
  navTextDisabled: {
    color: '#444',
  },
  nextButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.accent,
    paddingHorizontal: 24,
    paddingVertical: 12,
    borderRadius: 12,
    gap: 8,
  },
  nextButtonText: {
    fontSize: 15,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: Theme.colors.black,
    letterSpacing: 1,
  },
  answerPrompt: {
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingVertical: 12,
  },
  answerPromptText: {
    fontSize: 13,
    color: Theme.colors.text.muted,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    fontWeight: '500',
  },
});
</file>

<file path="app/practice/test.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert, ScrollView, Platform, Pressable, Modal,
} from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useQuizStore } from '@/lib/store/quiz';
import { getQuestions } from '@/lib/data';
import ProgressBar from '@/components/ProgressBar';
import QuestionCard from '@/components/QuestionCard';
import TimerDisplay from '@/components/TimerDisplay';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function TestModeScreen() {
  const { contestId, contestName, timeLimit } = useLocalSearchParams<{
    contestId: string;
    contestName: string;
    timeLimit: string;
  }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [timerRunning, setTimerRunning] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmSubmit, setShowConfirmSubmit] = useState(false);

  const {
    questions, currentIndex, answers,
    initQuiz, answerQuestion, nextQuestion, prevQuestion, goToQuestion, completeQuiz,
  } = useQuizStore();

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];
  const totalSeconds = timeLimit ? parseInt(timeLimit, 10) : 3600;
  const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length;
  const unanswered = questions.length - answeredCount;

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuestions();
  }, []);

  const loadQuestions = async () => {
    if (!contestId) return;
    const qs = await getQuestions(contestId);
    if (qs.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert('No Questions', 'No practice questions available for this contest yet.');
      router.back();
      return;
    }

    // Shuffle and limit to 25 questions for test mode
    const shuffled = [...qs].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const selectedQuestions = shuffled.slice(0, 25);

    initQuiz({
      questions: selectedQuestions,
      mode: 'test',
      contestId,
      contestName: contestName || '',
      timeLimit: totalSeconds,
    });
    setLoading(false);
    setTimerRunning(true);
  };

  const handleAnswer = (answer: string) => {
    if (currentQuestion) {
      answerQuestion(currentQuestion.id, answer);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setShowConfirmSubmit(true);
  };

  const confirmSubmit = () => {
    setShowConfirmSubmit(false);
    setTimerRunning(false);
    completeQuiz();
    router.replace({
      pathname: '/practice/results',
      params: { contestId, contestName },
    });
  };

  const cancelSubmit = () => {
    setShowConfirmSubmit(false);
  };

  const handleTimeUp = () => {
    setTimerRunning(false);
    completeQuiz();
    
    // For web compatibility, we'll use a simple alert then redirect
    // or just redirect if alert is blocked.
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      window.alert('Time is Up! Your test has been automatically submitted.');
      router.replace({
        pathname: '/practice/results',
        params: { contestId, contestName },
      });
    } else {
      Alert.alert('Time is Up!', 'Your test has been automatically submitted.', [
        {
          text: 'See Results',
          onPress: () => {
            router.replace({
              pathname: '/practice/results',
              params: { contestId, contestName },
            });
          },
        },
      ]);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.center, { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Theme.colors.accent} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>PREPARING YOUR TEST...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!currentQuestion) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <Text>No questions available</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timer and Progress */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <TimerDisplay
          totalSeconds={totalSeconds}
          onTimeUp={handleTimeUp}
          isRunning={timerRunning}
        />
        <Text style={styles.answeredText}>
          {answeredCount}/{questions.length} ANSWERED
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView style={styles.scrollContent}>
        <ProgressBar current={currentIndex + 1} total={questions.length} color="#2196F3" />

        {/* Question (no feedback in test mode) */}
        <QuestionCard
          question={currentQuestion}
          questionNumber={currentIndex + 1}
          selectedAnswer={answers[currentQuestion.id] || null}
          showResult={false}
          onSelectAnswer={handleAnswer}
        />
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Question dots navigator */}
      <View style={[styles.dotsWrapper, styles.glass]}>
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          style={styles.dotsContainer}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.dotsContent}
        >
          {questions.map((q, i) => (
            <motion.div key={q.id} whileHover={{ scale: 1.1 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[
                  styles.dot,
                  q.id in answers && styles.dotAnswered,
                  i === currentIndex && styles.dotCurrent,
                ]}
                onPress={() => goToQuestion(i)}
              >
                <Text style={[
                  styles.dotText,
                  q.id in answers && styles.dotTextAnswered,
                  i === currentIndex && styles.dotTextCurrent,
                ]}>
                  {i + 1}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <View style={[styles.nav, styles.glass]}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.navButton, currentIndex === 0 && styles.navButtonDisabled]}
          onPress={prevQuestion}
          disabled={currentIndex === 0}
        >
          <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={20} color={currentIndex === 0 ? '#444' : Theme.colors.accent} />
          <Text style={[styles.navText, currentIndex === 0 && styles.navTextDisabled]}>PREV</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}>
          <Pressable 
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.submitButton,
              pressed && { opacity: 0.8 }
            ]} 
            onPress={handleSubmit}
          >
            <Text style={styles.submitText}>SUBMIT TEST</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </motion.div>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.navButton, currentIndex === questions.length - 1 && styles.navButtonDisabled]}
          onPress={nextQuestion}
          disabled={currentIndex === questions.length - 1}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.navText, currentIndex === questions.length - 1 && styles.navTextDisabled]}>NEXT</Text>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={20} color={currentIndex === questions.length - 1 ? '#444' : Theme.colors.accent} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Confirmation Overlay */}
      {showConfirmSubmit && (
        <View style={styles.overlay}>
          <View style={[styles.modalContainer, styles.glass]}>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>SUBMIT TEST?</Text>
            <Text style={styles.modalText}>
              {unanswered > 0
                ? `You answered ${answeredCount} of ${questions.length} questions. ${unanswered} unanswered question${unanswered > 1 ? 's' : ''} will be marked incorrect.`
                : `You answered all ${questions.length} questions. Ready to submit?`}
            </Text>
            <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.modalButton, styles.cancelButton]} onPress={cancelSubmit}>
                <Text style={styles.cancelButtonText}>KEEP WORKING</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.modalButton, styles.confirmButton]} onPress={confirmSubmit}>
                <Text style={styles.confirmButtonText}>SUBMIT</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  scrollContent: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  loadingText: {
    marginTop: 16,
    fontSize: 13,
    color: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
    fontWeight: '800',
    letterSpacing: 1.5,
  },
  topBar: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingTop: 12,
    paddingBottom: 8,
  },
  answeredText: {
    fontSize: 11,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: Theme.colors.text.muted,
    letterSpacing: 1,
  },
  dotsWrapper: {
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    borderTopColor: Theme.colors.glass.border,
  },
  glass: GlassEffect,
  dotsContainer: {
    maxHeight: 52,
  },
  dotsContent: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    gap: 8,
  },
  dot: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
  },
  dotAnswered: {
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,242,255,0.1)',
    borderColor: 'rgba(0,242,255,0.3)',
  },
  dotCurrent: {
    borderColor: Theme.colors.accent,
    borderWidth: 2,
  },
  dotText: {
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: Theme.colors.text.muted,
  },
  dotTextAnswered: {
    color: '#00f2ff',
  },
  dotTextCurrent: {
    color: Theme.colors.accent,
    fontWeight: '900',
  },
  nav: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingVertical: 16,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    borderTopColor: Theme.colors.glass.border,
  },
  navButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 8,
  },
  navButtonDisabled: {
    opacity: 0.3,
  },
  navText: {
