<file path="app/practice/video.tsx">
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Alert, Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Video, ResizeMode } from 'expo-av';
import { FFA_CREED_PARAGRAPHS, CREED_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS, CREED_SCORING } from '@/constants/creed';
import { FFA_CREED_SPANISH_PARAGRAPHS, CREED_SPANISH_SCORING, CREED_SPANISH_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS, FFA_CREED_SPANISH_AUTHOR } from '@/constants/spanish-creed';
import ScoreCircle from '@/components/ScoreCircle';
import { transcribeAudio } from '@/lib/ai/whisper';
import { calculateAccuracy, AccuracyResult } from '@/lib/scoring/creed';
import { calculateSpanishAccuracy } from '@/lib/scoring/spanish-creed';
import { ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';

type Stage = 'prep' | 'recording' | 'review';

export default function VideoPracticeScreen() {
  const { contestId, contestName } = useLocalSearchParams<{ contestId: string; contestName: string }>();
  
  // Normalize params (handle array case)
  const idStr = Array.isArray(contestId) ? contestId[0] : contestId;
  const nameStr = Array.isArray(contestName) ? contestName[0] : contestName;
  
  const router = useRouter();
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('prep');
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'front' | 'back'>('front');
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [videoUri, setVideoUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [showReference, setShowReference] = useState(false);
  const [referenceCount, setReferenceCount] = useState(0);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [transcription, setTranscription] = useState<string>('');
  const [accuracyResult, setAccuracyResult] = useState<AccuracyResult | null>(null);
  const [activeParagraph, setActiveParagraph] = useState<number | null>(null); // null = full creed
  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const [processingError, setProcessingError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const isCreed = nameStr?.toLowerCase().includes('creed') || idStr.includes('creed');
  const isSpanishCreed = idStr === 'lde-spanish-creed';

  const paragraphs = isSpanishCreed ? FFA_CREED_SPANISH_PARAGRAPHS : FFA_CREED_PARAGRAPHS;
  const author = isSpanishCreed ? FFA_CREED_SPANISH_AUTHOR : 'E.M. Tiffany';
  const scoringConfig = isSpanishCreed ? CREED_SPANISH_SCORING : CREED_SCORING;
  const timeLimit = isSpanishCreed ? CREED_SPANISH_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS : CREED_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS;
  const creedTitle = isSpanishCreed ? 'El Credo de FFA' : 'The FFA Creed';
  const byAuthorPrefix = isSpanishCreed ? 'por' : 'by';

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const processRecording = async (uri: string) => {
    if (!isCreed) return; // Only process for Creed

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setProcessingError(null);
    try {
      const apiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2;
      if (!apiKey) {
        throw new Error('OpenAI API key missing in .env');
      }
      // DEBUG: Verify key update
      console.log('Using API Key:', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');
      if (apiKey.startsWith('sk-user')) {
          Alert.alert('Old Key Detected!', 'The app is still using the old sk-user key. Please hard-refresh your browser.');
          throw new Error('Old API Key Detected - Please Refresh');
      }

      console.log('Transcribing audio with Whisper...');
      // Pass language hint 'es' if Spanish Creed
      const result = await transcribeAudio(uri, apiKey, isSpanishCreed ? 'es' : 'en');
      setTranscription(result.text);

      console.log('Calculating accuracy...');
      const accuracy = isSpanishCreed 
        ? calculateSpanishAccuracy(result.text, activeParagraph ?? undefined) 
        : calculateAccuracy(result.text, activeParagraph ?? undefined);
      
      setAccuracyResult(accuracy);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Processing error:', error);
      const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
      setProcessingError(msg);
      Alert.alert('Transcription Failed', msg);
      setStage('prep'); // Reset to prep so they aren't stuck
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    // Web Fallback (since Expo Camera recordAsync is flaky on web)
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        console.log("Starting web recording...");
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
            audio: true, 
            video: { facingMode: facing === 'front' ? 'user' : 'environment' } 
        });
        
        const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
        mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
        chunksRef.current = [];

        mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
          if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
            chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
          }
        };

        mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
          const mimeType = mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm';
          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: mimeType });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          setVideoUri(url);
          setStage('review');
          
          // Stop stream tracks
          stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());

          // Trigger processing
          if (isCreed) {
            processRecording(url);
          }
        };

        mediaRecorder.start();
        setRecording(true);
        setElapsedSeconds(0);
        setStage('recording');

        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
          setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
        }, 1000);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Web Recording Error:", err);
        window.alert("Failed to access camera/mic. Please check permissions.");
      }
      return;
    }

    // Native Recording
    if (!cameraRef.current) return;

    try {
      setRecording(true);
      setElapsedSeconds(0);
      setStage('recording');

      // Start timer
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);

      const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({
        maxDuration: timeLimit + 60, // Give extra time
        quality: '480p', // Lower quality to keep file size under OpenAI 25MB limit
        mute: false,
      } as any);

      if (video) {
        setVideoUri(video.uri);
        setStage('review');
        if (isCreed) {
           processRecording(video.uri);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Recording error:', err);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to start recording. Please try again.');
      setStage('prep');
    } finally {
      if ((Platform.OS as string) !== 'web') {
         setRecording(false);
         if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      }
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if ((Platform.OS as string) === 'web') {
        if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
        }
        setRecording(false); // Update state immediately
    } else {
        if (cameraRef.current && recording) {
          cameraRef.current.stopRecording();
        }
    }
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  };

  const toggleReference = () => {
    if (!showReference) {
      setReferenceCount(prev => prev + 1);
    }
    setShowReference(!showReference);
  };

  const calculateScore = (): number => {
    let score = 100;
    
    // Time deductions (target: 4:00)
    if (elapsedSeconds < 180) score -= 10;
    else if (elapsedSeconds > 240) score -= 10;

    // Reference deductions (-20 per peek)
    score -= (referenceCount * 20);

    // Accuracy deductions (-20 per error)
    if (accuracyResult) {
       const errorCount = accuracyResult.missedWords.length;
       score -= (errorCount * scoringConfig.errorPenalty);
    }

    return Math.max(0, score);
  };

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  // Permission screen
  if (!permission?.granted) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.permissionContainer}>
        <Ionicons name="videocam-off" size={64} color="#ccc" />
        <Text style={styles.permissionTitle}>Camera Access Required</Text>
        <Text style={styles.permissionText}>
          To record your practice video, we need access to your camera and microphone.
        </Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permissionButton} onPress={requestPermission}>
          <Text style={styles.permissionButtonText}>Grant Camera Access</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backLink} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.backLinkText}>Go Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // PREP stage
  if (stage === 'prep') {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.prepContent}>
        <View style={styles.prepHeader}>
          <Ionicons name="videocam" size={40} color="#F2A900" />
          <Text style={styles.prepTitle}>{contestName || 'Video Practice'}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.prepSubtext}>
            {isCreed
              ? 'Practice reciting the FFA Creed from memory. You will have 4 minutes.'
              : 'Record yourself practicing. Review your performance after.'}
          </Text>
        </View>


        {isCreed && (
          <View style={styles.creedSection}>
            <Text style={styles.creedSectionTitle}>{creedTitle}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.creedAuthor}>{byAuthorPrefix} {author}</Text>
            
            <View style={styles.paragraphPicker}>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[styles.pickerBtn, activeParagraph === null && styles.pickerBtnActive]}
                onPress={() => setActiveParagraph(null)}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.pickerText, activeParagraph === null && styles.pickerTextActive]}>
                  Full
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(idx => (
                <TouchableOpacity 
                  key={idx}
                  style={[styles.pickerBtn, activeParagraph === idx && styles.pickerBtnActive]}
                  onPress={() => setActiveParagraph(idx)}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.pickerText, activeParagraph === idx && styles.pickerTextActive]}>
                    P{idx + 1}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
            </View>

            {paragraphs.map((para, i) => (
              <Text 
                key={i} 
                style={[
                  styles.creedParagraph, 
                  activeParagraph !== null && activeParagraph !== i && { opacity: 0.3 }
                ]}
              >
                {para}
              </Text>
            ))}
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={styles.tips}>
          <Text style={styles.tipsTitle}>Tips for a Great Recording</Text>
          <View style={styles.tip}>
            <Ionicons name="sunny-outline" size={18} color="#F2A900" />
            <Text style={styles.tipText}>Find good lighting - face a window if possible</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.tip}>
            <Ionicons name="mic-outline" size={18} color="#F2A900" />
            <Text style={styles.tipText}>Speak clearly and project your voice</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.tip}>
            <Ionicons name="body-outline" size={18} color="#F2A900" />
            <Text style={styles.tipText}>Stand tall with good posture</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.tip}>
            <Ionicons name="eye-outline" size={18} color="#F2A900" />
            <Text style={styles.tipText}>Look at the camera as if speaking to judges</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.readyButton} onPress={() => setStage('recording')}>
          <Ionicons name="videocam" size={22} color="#003366" />
          <Text style={styles.readyButtonText}>I'm Ready to Record</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  // RECORDING stage
  if (stage === 'recording') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.recordingContainer}>
        <CameraView
          ref={cameraRef}
          style={[styles.camera, { width: '100%' }]}
          facing={facing}
          mode="video"
        >
          {/* Top bar */}
          <View style={styles.recordingTopBar}>
            <View style={styles.recordingIndicator}>
              <View style={styles.redDot} />
              <Text style={styles.recordingTime}>{formatTime(elapsedSeconds)}</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.flipButton}
              onPress={() => setFacing(f => f === 'front' ? 'back' : 'front')}
            >
              <Ionicons name="camera-reverse" size={24} color="#fff" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {/* Reference text toggle */}
          {isCreed && showReference && (
            <ScrollView style={styles.referenceOverlay}>
              <Text style={styles.referenceText}>
                {activeParagraph !== null ? paragraphs[activeParagraph] : paragraphs.join('\n\n')}
              </Text>
            </ScrollView>
          )}

          {/* Bottom controls */}
          <View style={styles.recordingBottomBar}>
            {isCreed && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.refToggle} onPress={toggleReference}>
                <Ionicons name={showReference ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} size={20} color="#fff" />
                <Text style={styles.refToggleText}>
                  {showReference ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} Reference
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            {recording ? (
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.stopButton} onPress={stopRecording}>
                <View style={styles.stopIcon} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={startRecording}>
                <View style={styles.startIcon} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            <View style={{ width: isCreed ? 100 : 0 }} />
          </View>
        </CameraView>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // REVIEW stage
  const reviewScore = calculateScore();

  if (isCreed && isProcessing) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.recordingContainer}> 
        <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 20 }}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#F2A900" />
          <Text style={{ marginTop: 20, fontSize: 18, color: '#fff', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
            Analyzing Recitation...
          </Text>
          <Text style={{ marginTop: 10, color: '#ccc', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            Transcribing audio and calculating score
          </Text>
          <Text style={{ marginTop: 5, color: '#666', fontSize: 12 }}>
            (Usually takes 10-20 seconds)
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.cancelProcBtn}
            onPress={() => {
                setIsProcessing(false);
                setStage('prep');
            }}
          >
            <Text style={styles.cancelProcText}>CANCEL & TRY AGAIN</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={styles.reviewContent}>
      {/* Video playback */}
      {videoUri && (
        <View style={styles.videoContainer}>
           {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
              <video 
                  src={videoUri} 
                  controls 
                  playsInline
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', backgroundColor: 'black' }} 
              />
           ) : (
              <Video
                  source={{ uri: videoUri }}
                  style={styles.videoPlayer}
                  useNativeControls
                  resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
                  isLooping={false}
                  shouldPlay
                  onError={(e) => console.error("Video Error:", e)}
              />
           )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Score - Only for Creed */}
      {isCreed ? (
        <>
          <View style={styles.scoreSection}>
            <ScoreCircle percentage={reviewScore} size={140} label="Practice Score" />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.breakdownCard}>
            <Text style={styles.breakdownTitle}>Score Breakdown</Text>
            
            <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
              <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Base Score</Text>
              <Text style={styles.breakdownPoints}>100 pts</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
              <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Time Penalty ({formatTime(elapsedSeconds)})</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.breakdownPoints, { color: '#D32F2F' }]}>
                {elapsedSeconds < 180 || elapsedSeconds > 240 ? '-10 pts' : '0 pts'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
              <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Reference used {referenceCount}x</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.breakdownPoints, { color: referenceCount > 0 ? '#D32F2F' : '#388E3C' }]}>
                {referenceCount > 0 ? `-${referenceCount * 20} pts` : '0 pts'}
              </Text>
            </View>

            {accuracyResult ? (
              <>
                <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Missed Words ({accuracyResult.missedWords.length})</Text>
                  <Text style={accuracyResult.missedWords.length > 0 ? styles.breakdownValueNeg : styles.breakdownValue}>
                    -{accuracyResult.missedWords.length * scoringConfig.errorPenalty} pts
                  </Text>
                </View>
                
                 <View style={{marginTop: 15, padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#f9f9f9', borderRadius: 8}}>
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 5}}>DEBUG INFO:</Text>
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 12}}>Matched: {accuracyResult.matchedWords} / {accuracyResult.totalWords}</Text>
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 12, marginTop: 5}}>Transcription:</Text>
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 11, fontStyle: 'italic', color: '#555'}}>
                      "{transcription.substring(0, 100)}..."
                    </Text>
                 </View>
              </>
            ) : (
              <View style={{ padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#ffebee', borderRadius: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
                <Text style={{ color: '#c62828', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>Scoring Failed</Text>
                <Text style={{ color: '#c62828', fontSize: 12 }}>
                  {processingError || 'Could not analyze audio. Please check your microphone permissions and try again.'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}

            {accuracyResult && (
              <View style={{marginTop: 20, padding: 15, backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: 8, elevation: 2}}>
                 <Text style={{fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: 10, color: '#003366'}}>Recitation Analysis</Text>
                <Text style={{lineHeight: 24, fontSize: 16}}>
                  {accuracyResult.diff.map((item, index) => (
                    <Text key={index} style={{
                      color: item.status === 'missed' ? '#D32F2F' : item.status === 'extra' ? '#F57C00' : '#333',
                      fontWeight: item.status !== 'matched' ? 'bold' : 'normal',
                      textDecorationLine: item.status === 'extra' ? 'line-through' : 'none',
                      backgroundColor: item.status === 'missed' ? '#ffebee' : item.status === 'extra' ? '#fff3e0' : 'transparent'
                    }}>
                      {item.word}{' '}
                    </Text>
                  ))}
                </Text>
                 <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', marginTop: 15, gap: 15}}>
                  <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center'}}>
                    <View style={{width: 12, height: 12, backgroundColor: '#ffebee', marginRight: 5, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#D32F2F'}} />
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 12}}>Missed (-20)</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center'}}>
                    <View style={{width: 12, height: 12, backgroundColor: '#fff3e0', marginRight: 5, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#F57C00'}} />
                    <Text style={{fontSize: 12}}>Extra (Ignored)</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </>
      ) : (
          <View style={styles.breakdownCard}>
              <Text style={styles.breakdownTitle}>Practice Complete</Text>
              <Text style={{fontSize: 16, color: '#333', marginBottom: 10}}>
                  Review your recording above to self-evaluate your performance.
              </Text>
              <View style={styles.breakdownRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.breakdownLabel}>Duration</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.breakdownValue}>{formatTime(elapsedSeconds)}</Text>
              </View>
          </View>
      )}

      {/* Actions */}
      <View style={styles.reviewActions}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.recordAgainButton}
          onPress={() => {
            setVideoUri(null);
            setElapsedSeconds(0);
            setReferenceCount(0);
            setShowReference(false);
            setStage('prep');
          }}
        >
          <Ionicons name="refresh" size={20} color="#fff" />
          <Text style={styles.recordAgainText}>Record Again</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.exitButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.exitText}>Back to Contest</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5' },
  prepContent: { padding: 20 },
  prepHeader: { alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 24 },
  prepTitle: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: '800', color: '#003366', marginTop: 12 },
  prepSubtext: { fontSize: 15, color: '#666', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 },
  creedSection: { backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, marginBottom: 20, borderLeftWidth: 4, borderLeftColor: '#F2A900' },
  creedSectionTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#003366', marginBottom: 2 },
  creedAuthor: { fontSize: 13, color: '#888', fontStyle: 'italic', marginBottom: 16 },
  paragraphPicker: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: 20 },
  pickerBtn: { flex: 1, paddingVertical: 8, alignItems: 'center', borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: '#f0f0f0', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#ddd' },
  pickerBtnActive: { backgroundColor: '#003366', borderColor: '#003366' },
  pickerText: { fontSize: 13, color: '#666', fontWeight: '600' },
  pickerTextActive: { color: '#fff' },
  creedParagraph: { fontSize: 15, color: '#333', lineHeight: 24, marginBottom: 12 },
  tips: { backgroundColor: '#FFF8E1', borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, marginBottom: 24 },
  tipsTitle: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '700', color: '#333', marginBottom: 12 },
  tip: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 10 },
  tipText: { fontSize: 14, color: '#555', flex: 1 },

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
} from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { askBrain } from '../../lib/ai/gemini';
import { TEXAS_LDE_KNOWLEDGE } from '@/lib/data/notebooks/sr-quiz';
import { SENIOR_QUIZ_SOURCE } from '@/lib/data/notebooks/senior-quiz-source';

// Mock Knowledge Sources (In production, these would be loaded from PDFs/Supabase)
const KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES = [
  { 
    id: 'senior_quiz_notebook', 
    name: "FFA Study Guide (NotebookLM)", 
    icon: 'book',
    context: SENIOR_QUIZ_SOURCE
  },
];

interface Message {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  sender: 'user' | 'ai';
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface AIBrainProps {
  mode?: 'full' | 'bubble';
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export default function AIBrainScreen({ mode = 'full', onClose }: AIBrainProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedSource, setSelectedSource] = useState(KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES[0]);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      text: "Howdy! I'm your Ag Coach Pro, how can I help you today?",
      sender: 'ai',
      timestamp: new Date(),
    },
  ]);
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const scrollViewRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (inputText.trim() === '' || loading) return;

    const userMsg: Message = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      text: inputText,
      sender: 'user',
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInputText('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await askBrain(inputText, selectedSource.context);
      
      const aiMsg: Message = {
        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
        text: response.answer,
        sender: 'ai',
        timestamp: new Date(),
      };
      
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiMsg]);
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMsg: Message = {
        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
        text: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble connecting to my brain right now.",
        sender: 'ai',
        timestamp: new Date(),
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, errorMsg]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView
      behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}
      style={styles.container}
      keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 100 : 0}
    >
      {mode === 'full' && (
        <Stack.Screen 
          options={{ 
            title: 'Ag Coach Pro',
            headerTintColor: '#fff',
            headerStyle: { backgroundColor: '#003366' },
          }} 
        />
      )}

      {/* source Selector - Only show if multiple sources exist */}
      {KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.length > 1 && (
        <View style={styles.sourceSelector}>
          <View style={styles.sourceHeader}>
            {mode === 'bubble' ? (
               <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={{ padding: 8 }}>
                  <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="#003366" />
               </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
               <Text style={styles.sourceLabel}>Current Study Material:</Text>
            )}

            {mode === 'full' && (
              <TouchableOpacity 
                  style={styles.quizButton}
                  onPress={() => router.push({
                  pathname: '/study/ai-quiz',
                  params: { context: selectedSource.context, title: selectedSource.name }
                  })}
              >
                  <Ionicons name="help-circle" size={16} color="#F2A900" />
                  <Text style={styles.quizButtonText}>Generate Quiz</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>
          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={styles.sourceScroll}>
            {KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.map((source) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={source.id}
                style={[
                  styles.sourceChip,
                  selectedSource.id === source.id && styles.sourceChipActive
                ]}
                onPress={() => setSelectedSource(source)}
              >
                <Ionicons 
                  name={source.icon as any} 
                  size={16} 
                  color={selectedSource.id === source.id ? '#fff' : '#003366'} 
                />
                <Text style={[
                  styles.sourceText,
                  selectedSource.id === source.id && styles.sourceTextActive
                ]}>
                  {source.name}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Show Quiz Button anyway if in full mode even if selector is hidden */}
      {KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.length === 1 && mode === 'full' && (
        <View style={[styles.sourceSelector, { paddingVertical: 8 }]}>
           <View style={[styles.sourceHeader, { marginBottom: 0 }]}>
             <Text style={styles.sourceLabel}>Source: {selectedSource.name}</Text>
             <TouchableOpacity 
                  style={styles.quizButton}
                  onPress={() => router.push({
                  pathname: '/study/ai-quiz',
                  params: { context: selectedSource.context, title: selectedSource.name }
                  })}
              >
                  <Ionicons name="help-circle" size={16} color="#F2A900" />
                  <Text style={styles.quizButtonText}>Generate Quiz</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
           </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Chat Messages */}
      <ScrollView
        ref={scrollViewRef}
        style={styles.chatArea}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.chatContent}
        onContentSizeChange={() => scrollViewRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true })}
      >
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <View
            key={msg.id}
            style={[
              styles.messageBubble,
              msg.sender === 'user' ? styles.userBubble : styles.aiBubble
            ]}
          >
            <Text style={[
              styles.messageText,
              msg.sender === 'user' ? styles.userText : styles.aiText
            ]}>
              {msg.text}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ))}
        {loading && (
          <View style={[styles.messageBubble, styles.aiBubble]}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#003366" />
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Input Area */}
      <View style={styles.inputContainer}>
        <TextInput
          style={styles.input}
          placeholder="Ask Coach a question..."
          value={inputText}
          onChangeText={setInputText}
          multiline
        />
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.sendButton} onPress={handleSend}>
          <Ionicons name="send" size={24} color="#fff" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
  },
  sourceSelector: {
    backgroundColor: '#fff',
    paddingVertical: 12,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    borderBottomColor: '#eee',
  },
  sourceHeader: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingRight: 16,
    marginBottom: 8,
  },
  sourceLabel: {
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#666',
    marginLeft: 16,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
  },
  quizButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#002244',
    paddingHorizontal: 10,
    paddingVertical: 4,
    borderRadius: 12,
  },
  quizButtonText: {
    color: '#F2A900',
    fontSize: 11,
    fontWeight: '700',
    marginLeft: 4,
  },
  sourceScroll: {
    paddingLeft: 16,
  },
  sourceChip: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#f0f4f8',
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 8,
    borderRadius: 20,
    marginRight: 10,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: '#d0e0f0',
  },
  sourceChipActive: {
    backgroundColor: '#003366',
    borderColor: '#003366',
  },
  sourceText: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: '#003366',
    marginLeft: 6,
    fontWeight: '500',
  },
  sourceTextActive: {
    color: '#fff',
  },
  chatArea: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  chatContent: {
    padding: 16,
    paddingBottom: 32,
  },
  messageBubble: {
    maxWidth: '85%',
    padding: 12,
    borderRadius: 16,
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
  userBubble: {
    alignSelf: 'flex-end',
    backgroundColor: '#003366',
    borderBottomRightRadius: 4,
  },
  aiBubble: {
    alignSelf: 'flex-start',
    backgroundColor: '#fff',
    borderBottomLeftRadius: 4,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: '#eee',
  },
  messageText: {
    fontSize: 16,
    lineHeight: 22,
  },

    color: '#fff',
  },

<file path="app/study/ai-quiz.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
} from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { generateDynamicQuiz, GeneratedQuestion } from '../../lib/ai/gemini';

export default function AIQuizScreen() {
  const { context, title } = useLocalSearchParams<{ context: string, title: string }>();
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<GeneratedQuestion[]>([]);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAnswered, setIsAnswered] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuiz();
  }, []);

  const loadQuiz = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await generateDynamicQuiz(context || "");
      setQuestions(data);
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("Error", "Failed to generate quiz from this material.");
      router.back();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOptionSelect = (option: string) => {
    if (isAnswered) return;
    setSelectedOption(option);
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!selectedOption) return;
    
    const correct = selectedOption === questions[currentIndex].correctAnswer;
    if (correct) setScore(score + 1);
    setIsAnswered(true);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentIndex < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsAnswered(false);
    } else {
      setShowResults(true);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#003366" />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>The Brain is generating your quiz...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (showResults) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Quiz Results' }} />
        <View style={styles.resultsCard}>
          <Ionicons name="trophy" size={80} color="#F2A900" />
          <Text style={styles.resultsTitle}>Quiz Complete!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.resultsScore}>{score} / {questions.length}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.resultsPercent}>{Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100)}%</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.finishButton} onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Text style={styles.finishButtonText}>Back to Library</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const currentQ = questions[currentIndex];

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: title || 'AI Brain Quiz' }} />
      
      {/* Progress Bar */}
      <View style={styles.progressBar}>
        <View style={[styles.progressFill, { width: `${((currentIndex + 1) / questions.length) * 100}%` }]} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Text style={styles.questionNumber}>Question {currentIndex + 1} of {questions.length}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.questionText}>{currentQ.question}</Text>

        {currentQ.options.map((option, index) => {
          const isSelected = selectedOption === option;
          const isCorrect = option === currentQ.correctAnswer;
          const showFeedback = isAnswered;

          let optionStyle = styles.option;
          if (isSelected) optionStyle = { ...optionStyle, ...styles.selectedOption };
          if (showFeedback && isCorrect) optionStyle = { ...optionStyle, ...styles.correctOption };
          if (showFeedback && isSelected && !isCorrect) optionStyle = { ...optionStyle, ...styles.incorrectOption };

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={index}
              style={optionStyle}
              onPress={() => handleOptionSelect(option)}
              disabled={isAnswered}
            >
              <Text style={[
                styles.optionText,
                (isSelected || (showFeedback && isCorrect)) && styles.whiteText
              ]}>
                {option}
              </Text>
              {showFeedback && isCorrect && <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color="#fff" />}
              {showFeedback && isSelected && !isCorrect && <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={20} color="#fff" />}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}

        {isAnswered && (
          <View style={styles.explanationCard}>
            <Text style={styles.explanationHeader}>Explanation:</Text>
            <Text style={styles.explanationText}>{currentQ.explanation}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {!isAnswered ? (
          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={[styles.button, !selectedOption && styles.buttonDisabled]} 
            onPress={handleSubmit}
            disabled={!selectedOption}
          >
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Submit Answer</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.button} onPress={handleNext}>
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>
              {currentIndex === questions.length - 1 ? 'Finish Quiz' : 'Next Question'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    padding: 20,
  },
  loadingText: {
    marginTop: 16,

  },

  },

  },

  },
  option: {

    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    borderWidth: 1,

  },
  selectedOption: {

  },

  },

  },

  },

  },

  },
  resultsCard: {
    flex: 1,

  },

<file path="app/_layout.tsx">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Stack, useRouter, useSegments } from 'expo-router';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { ActivityIndicator, View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/lib/store/auth';
import { Theme } from '@/constants/theme';

import AgCoachBubble from '@/components/AgCoachBubble';

function AuthGate({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { session, initialized } = useAuthStore();
  const segments = useSegments();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialized) return;

    const inAuthGroup = segments[0] === '(auth)';
    const inAdminGroup = segments[0] === '(admin)';
    const inTabsGroup = segments[0] === '(tabs)';
    
    // Root is exactly / (no segments) or /index
    const isRoot = segments.length === 0 || (segments.length === 1 && segments[0] === 'index');

    if (!session) {
      // GUEST LOGIC
      if (!inAuthGroup && !isRoot) {
        // Redirect to landing page instead of login on refresh/error
        router.replace('/');
      }
    } else {
      // AUTHENTICATED LOGIC
      const role = session.user?.user_metadata?.role || 'student';
      
      if (role === 'teacher') {
        // TEACHER: Redirect away from student-only or auth areas
        if (inAuthGroup || isRoot || inTabsGroup) {
          router.replace('/(admin)');
        }
      } else {
        // STUDENT: Redirect away from teacher-only or auth areas
        if (inAuthGroup || isRoot || inAdminGroup) {
          router.replace('/(tabs)');
        }
      }
    }
  }, [session, initialized, segments]);

  if (!initialized) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Theme.colors.accent} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {children}
      {session && <AgCoachBubble />}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  const { initialize } = useAuthStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    initialize();
  }, []);

  return (
    <AuthGate>
      <StatusBar style="light" />
      <Stack 
        screenOptions={{ 
          headerShown: false,
          contentStyle: { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }
        }}
      >
        <Stack.Screen name="(auth)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <Stack.Screen name="(admin)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <Stack.Screen 
          name="contest/[id]" 
          options={{ 
            headerShown: true, 
            headerStyle: { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.dark }, 
            headerTintColor: Theme.colors.accent,
            headerTitleStyle: { fontWeight: '800' }
          }} 
        />
        <Stack.Screen name="practice" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <Stack.Screen 
          name="progress" 
          options={{ 
            headerShown: true, 
            headerTitle: 'MY PROGRESS', 
            headerStyle: { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.dark }, 
            headerTintColor: Theme.colors.accent, 
            headerTitleStyle: { fontWeight: '800' } 
          }} 
        />
      </Stack>
    </AuthGate>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  loadingContainer: {
    flex: 1, 
    justifyContent: 'center', 
    alignItems: 'center', 
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black
  }
});
</file>

<file path="app/progress.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
  TouchableOpacity,
} from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/lib/store/auth';
import { getUserProgress, getUserStats } from '@/lib/data';
import { UserProgress } from '@/types';
import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function ProgressScreen() {
  const { user, demoMode } = useAuthStore();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<UserProgress[]>([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    totalSessions: 0,
    totalTime: 0,
    contestsPracticed: 0,
    averageScore: 0,
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [user]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const [progressData, statsData] = await Promise.all([
        getUserProgress(user.id),
        getUserStats(user.id),
      ]);
      setProgress(progressData);
      setStats(statsData);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading progress:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 80) return '#4CAF50';
    if (score >= 60) return '#F2A900';
    return '#F44336';
  };

  const formatTime = (minutes: number) => {
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    const hrs = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    const mins = minutes % 60;
    return mins > 0 ? `${hrs}h ${mins}m` : `${hrs}h`;
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (diffDays === 0) return 'Today';
    if (diffDays === 1) return 'Yesterday';
    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays} days ago`;
    if (diffDays < 30) return `${Math.floor(diffDays / 7)} weeks ago`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.center, { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={Theme.colors.accent} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (demoMode && progress.length === 0) {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
        {/* Summary Stats */}
        <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
            <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
              <Ionicons name="trophy-outline" size={28} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>0</Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>BEST SCORES</Text>
            </View>
          </motion.div>
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
            <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
              <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={28} color="#00f2ff" />
              <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>0m</Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>TOTAL TIME</Text>
            </View>
          </motion.div>
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
            <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
              <Ionicons name="flame-outline" size={28} color="#bf5af2" />
              <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>0</Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>SESSIONS</Text>
            </View>
          </motion.div>
        </View>

        <EmptyState
          icon="bar-chart-outline"
          title="No Progress Yet"
          message="Complete some practice sessions to start tracking your progress! Try Study Mode, Test Mode, or Flashcards in any contest."
        />

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.startButton}
          onPress={() => router.push('/(tabs)/cde')}
        >
          <Ionicons name="rocket-outline" size={20} color="#fff" />
          <Text style={styles.startButtonText}>Start Practicing</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container}>
      {/* Summary Stats */}
      <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="trophy-outline" size={28} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
            <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>{stats.averageScore}%</Text>
            <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>AVG SCORE</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={28} color="#00f2ff" />
            <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>{formatTime(stats.totalTime)}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>TOTAL TIME</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }} style={styles.summaryCardWrapper}>
          <View style={[styles.summaryCard, styles.glass]}>
            <Ionicons name="flame-outline" size={28} color="#bf5af2" />
            <Text style={styles.summaryNumber}>{stats.totalSessions}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>SESSIONS</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
      </View>

      {/* Contest Progress */}
      {progress.length > 0 ? (
        <>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>CONTEST PROGRESS</Text>
          {progress.map((item, index) => (
            <motion.div 
              key={index} 
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} 
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} 
              transition={{ delay: 0.05 * index }}
              whileHover={{ scale: 1.01, x: 5 }}
            >
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.progressCard, styles.glass]}
                onPress={() => router.push(`/contest/${item.contest_id}` as any)}
              >
                <View style={styles.progressLeft}>
                  <Text style={styles.contestName}>
                    {(item as any).contest_name || 'Contest'}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.progressMeta}>
                    {item.total_attempts} {item.total_attempts === 1 ? 'ATTEMPT' : 'ATTEMPTS'}
                    {item.last_practiced_at ? ` \u00B7 ${formatDate(item.last_practiced_at).toUpperCase()}` : ''}
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.progressRight}>
                  <View style={styles.scoreRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>BEST</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.scoreValue, { color: getScoreColor(item.best_score) }]}>
                      {Math.round(item.best_score)}%
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.scoreRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.scoreLabel}>AVG</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.avgScore}>{Math.round(item.average_score)}%</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
                <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color="#444" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          icon="bar-chart-outline"
          title="No Progress Yet"
          message="Complete some practice sessions to start tracking your progress!"
        />
      )}

      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.black,
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  summaryRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingTop: 16,
  },
  summaryCardWrapper: {
    flex: 1,
    marginHorizontal: 4,
  },
  summaryCard: {
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 16,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  glass: GlassEffect,
  summaryNumber: {
    fontSize: 22,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: '#fff',
    marginTop: 8,
  },
  summaryLabel: {
    fontSize: 10,
    color: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
    fontWeight: '700',
    marginTop: 2,
    letterSpacing: 1,
  },
  sectionTitle: {
    fontSize: 14,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: Theme.colors.accent,
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    marginTop: 24,
    marginBottom: 12,
    letterSpacing: 1.5,
  },
  progressCard: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card,
    marginHorizontal: 16,
    marginBottom: 8,
    padding: 16,
    borderRadius: 12,
  },
  progressLeft: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  contestName: {
    fontSize: 15,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#fff',
    marginBottom: 4,
  },
  progressMeta: {
    fontSize: 11,
    color: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
    fontWeight: '600',
  },
  progressRight: {
    alignItems: 'flex-end',
    marginRight: 8,
  },
  scoreRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 6,
  },
  scoreLabel: {
    fontSize: 10,
    color: Theme.colors.text.muted,
    fontWeight: '800',
  },
  scoreValue: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '800',
  },
  avgScore: {
    fontSize: 14,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
  },
  startButton: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.accent,
    marginHorizontal: 40,
    marginTop: 8,
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    gap: 8,
  },
  startButtonText: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: Theme.colors.black,
    letterSpacing: 1,
  },
});

<file path="components/contest/VideoRecorder.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Platform, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

export default function VideoRecorder({ onRecordingComplete }: { onRecordingComplete: (uri: string) => void }) {
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'front' | 'back'>('front');
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(0);
  
  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      stopStream();
    };
  }, []);

  const stopStream = () => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      console.log("Stopping all stream tracks...");
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(track => {
        track.stop();
        console.log(`Stopped track: ${track.kind}`);
      });
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    // Web Fallback
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        console.log("Starting web recording...");
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
            audio: true, 
            video: { facingMode: facing === 'front' ? 'user' : 'environment' } 
        });
        
        const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
        mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
        streamRef.current = stream;
        chunksRef.current = [];

        mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
          if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
            chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
          }
        };

        mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: 'video/webm' });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          
          stopStream();
          onRecordingComplete(url);
        };

        mediaRecorder.start();
        setRecording(true);
        setElapsedSeconds(0);

        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
          setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
        }, 1000);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Web Recording Error:", err);
        window.alert("Failed to access camera/mic. Please check permissions.");
      }
      return;
    }

    // Native Recording
    if (!cameraRef.current) return;

    try {
      setRecording(true);
      setElapsedSeconds(0);

      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setElapsedSeconds(prev => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);

      const video = await cameraRef.current.recordAsync({
        maxDuration: 240 + 60, // 4 mins + buffer
      });

      if (video) {
        onRecordingComplete(video.uri);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Recording error:', err);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to start recording. Please try again.');
      setRecording(false);
    } finally {
        if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
        }
        setRecording(false);
    } else {
        if (cameraRef.current && recording) {
          cameraRef.current.stopRecording();
          setRecording(false);
        }
    }
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  };

  if (!permission) {
    // Camera permissions are still loading.
    return <View />;
  }

  if (!permission.granted) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Text style={{ color: 'white', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 20 }}>
            Camera permission required for contest mode.
        </Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.button} onPress={requestPermission}>
          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Grant Permission</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <CameraView
        ref={cameraRef}
        style={styles.camera}
        facing={facing}
        mode="video"
      >
        <View style={styles.controls}>
            <View style={styles.topBar}>
                <View style={styles.timerBadge}>
                    <View style={[styles.dot, recording && styles.recordingDot]} />
                    <Text style={styles.timerText}>{formatTime(elapsedSeconds)}</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setFacing(f => f === 'front' ? 'back' : 'front')}>
                     <Ionicons name="camera-reverse" size={28} color="white" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.bottomBar}>
                {recording ? (
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.stopButton} onPress={stopRecording}>
                        <View style={styles.stopIcon} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                ) : (
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={startRecording}>
                        <View style={styles.startIcon} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                )}
            </View>
        </View>
      </CameraView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: 'black',
    borderRadius: 12,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    width: '100%',
    height: 400, // Fixed height for embedded recorder
  },
  camera: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  controls: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    padding: 20,
  },
  topBar: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  timerBadge: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 6,
    borderRadius: 20,
    gap: 8,
  },
  dot: {
    width: 8,
    height: 8,
    borderRadius: 4,
    backgroundColor: '#ccc',
  },
  recordingDot: {
    backgroundColor: '#F44336',
  },
  timerText: {
    color: 'white',
    fontWeight: 'bold',
  },
  bottomBar: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    marginBottom: 10,
  },
  startButton: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,
    borderRadius: 36,
    borderWidth: 4,
    borderColor: 'white',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
  },
  startIcon: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    backgroundColor: '#F44336',
  },
  stopButton: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,
    borderRadius: 36,
    borderWidth: 4,
    borderColor: 'white',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
  },
  stopIcon: {
    width: 28,
    height: 28,
    borderRadius: 4,
    backgroundColor: '#F44336',
  },
  button: {
    backgroundColor: '#003366',
    padding: 15,
    borderRadius: 8,
  },
  buttonText: {
    color: 'white',
    fontWeight: 'bold',
  },
});
</file>

<file path="components/grading/CreedGradingScreen.tsx">
/**
 * Creed Grading Screen
 * Step-by-step wizard for manual judging of Creed Speaking contest
 * Uses Dark Obsidian glassmorphism theme
 */

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
} from 'react-native';
import { Stack, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import {
  CreedScoreSheet,
  createEmptyScoreSheet,
  calculateCreedScore,
  CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS,
  ORAL_MAX,
  NONVERBAL_MAX,
  QA_MAX,
} from '@/utils/grading/creed-rubric';

type GradingStep = 'oral' | 'nonverbal' | 'qa' | 'review';

interface RubricSliderProps {
  label: string;
  weight: number;
  value: number;
  onChange: (value: number) => void;
}

function RubricSlider({ label, weight, value, onChange }: RubricSliderProps) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.sliderContainer}>
      <View style={styles.sliderHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.sliderLabel}>{label}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.sliderWeight}>Max potential: {weight * 5} pts</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.sliderRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.sliderButton}
          onPress={() => onChange(Math.max(1, value - 1))}
        >
          <Ionicons name="remove" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <View style={styles.sliderValueContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.sliderValue}>{value}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.sliderMax}>/ 5</Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.sliderButton}
          onPress={() => onChange(Math.min(5, value + 1))}
        >
          <Ionicons name="add" size={20} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.progressBar}>
        <View style={[styles.progressFill, { width: `${(value / 5) * 100}%` }]} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function StepIndicator({ currentStep }: { currentStep: GradingStep }) {
  const steps: { key: GradingStep; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'oral', label: 'Oral' },
    { key: 'nonverbal', label: 'Non-Verbal' },
    { key: 'qa', label: 'Q&A' },
    { key: 'review', label: 'Review' },
  ];
  const currentIndex = steps.findIndex(s => s.key === currentStep);

  return (
    <View style={styles.stepIndicatorContainer}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => (
        <React.Fragment key={step.key}>
          <View style={styles.stepItem}>
            <View style={[styles.stepCircle, index <= currentIndex && styles.stepCircleActive]}>
              {index < currentIndex ? (
                <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color="#000" />
              ) : (
                <Text style={[styles.stepNumber, index <= currentIndex && styles.stepNumberActive]}>
                  {index + 1}
                </Text>
              )}
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.stepLabel, index <= currentIndex && styles.stepLabelActive]}>
              {step.label}
            </Text>
          </View>
          {index < steps.length - 1 && (
            <View style={[styles.stepLine, index < currentIndex && styles.stepLineActive]} />
          )}
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ScoreDisplay({ score }: { score: { oral: number; nonVerbal: number; qa: number; deductions: number; total: number } }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.scoreDisplayContainer}>
      <View style={styles.scoreMain}>
        <Text style={styles.scoreMainLabel}>NET TOTAL</Text>
        <Text style={styles.scoreMainValue}>{score.total}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.scoreMainMax}>/ 1000</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.scoreBreakdown}>
        <View style={styles.scoreItem}>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemLabel}>Oral</Text>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemValue}>{score.oral}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.scoreDivider} />
        <View style={styles.scoreItem}>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemLabel}>Non-Verbal</Text>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemValue}>{score.nonVerbal}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.scoreDivider} />
        <View style={styles.scoreItem}>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemLabel}>Q&A</Text>
          <Text style={styles.scoreItemValue}>{score.qa}</Text>
        </View>
        {score.deductions > 0 && (
          <>
            <View style={styles.scoreDivider} />
            <View style={[styles.scoreItem, styles.scoreItemDeduction]}>
              <Text style={styles.scoreItemLabel}>Deductions</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.scoreItemValue, styles.scoreItemValueNegative]}>-{score.deductions}</Text>
            </View>
          </>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function CreedGradingScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<GradingStep>('oral');
  const [scoreSheet, setScoreSheet] = useState<CreedScoreSheet>(createEmptyScoreSheet());
  const currentScore = useMemo(() => calculateCreedScore(scoreSheet), [scoreSheet]);

  const updateOral = (key: keyof typeof scoreSheet.oral, value: number) => {
    setScoreSheet(prev => ({ ...prev, oral: { ...prev.oral, [key]: value } }));
  };

  const updateNonVerbal = (key: keyof typeof scoreSheet.nonVerbal, value: number) => {
    setScoreSheet(prev => ({ ...prev, nonVerbal: { ...prev.nonVerbal, [key]: value } }));
  };

  const updateQA = (key: keyof typeof scoreSheet.qa, value: number) => {
    setScoreSheet(prev => ({ ...prev, qa: { ...prev.qa, [key]: value } }));
  };

  const updateDeductions = (key: keyof typeof scoreSheet.deductions, value: number) => {
    setScoreSheet(prev => ({ ...prev, deductions: { ...prev.deductions, [key]: value } }));
  };

  const nextStep = () => {
    if (step === 'oral') setStep('nonverbal');
    else if (step === 'nonverbal') setStep('qa');
    else if (step === 'qa') setStep('review');
  };

  const prevStep = () => {
    if (step === 'nonverbal') setStep('oral');
    else if (step === 'qa') setStep('nonverbal');
    else if (step === 'review') setStep('qa');
  };

  const renderOralStep = () => (
    <View style={styles.stepContent}>
      <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Oral Communication</Text>
      <Text style={styles.stepSubtitle}>400 points</Text>
      <RubricSlider label="Hesitation" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.hesitation} value={scoreSheet.oral.hesitation} onChange={v => updateOral('hesitation', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Pace" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.pace} value={scoreSheet.oral.pace} onChange={v => updateOral('pace', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Tone" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.tone} value={scoreSheet.oral.tone} onChange={v => updateOral('tone', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Pronunciation" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.pronunciation} value={scoreSheet.oral.pronunciation} onChange={v => updateOral('pronunciation', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Volume" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.volume} value={scoreSheet.oral.volume} onChange={v => updateOral('volume', v)} />
    </View>
  );

  const renderNonVerbalStep = () => (
    <View style={styles.stepContent}>
      <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Non-Verbal Communication</Text>
      <Text style={styles.stepSubtitle}>300 points</Text>
      <RubricSlider label="Eye Contact" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.eye_contact} value={scoreSheet.nonVerbal.eye_contact} onChange={v => updateNonVerbal('eye_contact', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Mannerisms" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.mannerisms} value={scoreSheet.nonVerbal.mannerisms} onChange={v => updateNonVerbal('mannerisms', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Gestures" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.gestures} value={scoreSheet.nonVerbal.gestures} onChange={v => updateNonVerbal('gestures', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Poise" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.poise} value={scoreSheet.nonVerbal.poise} onChange={v => updateNonVerbal('poise', v)} />
    </View>
  );

  const renderQAStep = () => (
    <View style={styles.stepContent}>
      <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Question and Answer</Text>
      <Text style={styles.stepSubtitle}>300 points</Text>
      <RubricSlider label="Details" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.details} value={scoreSheet.qa.details} onChange={v => updateQA('details', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Unrehearsed Response" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.unrehearsed} value={scoreSheet.qa.unrehearsed} onChange={v => updateQA('unrehearsed', v)} />
      <RubricSlider label="Examples" weight={CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.examples} value={scoreSheet.qa.examples} onChange={v => updateQA('examples', v)} />
      <View style={styles.deductionSection}>
        <Text style={styles.deductionTitle}>Deductions</Text>
        <View style={styles.deductionRow}>
          <Text style={styles.deductionLabel}>Time Over (seconds x 1)</Text>
          <View style={styles.deductionInputRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.smallButton} onPress={() => updateDeductions('time_seconds_over', Math.max(0, scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over - 1))}>
              <Ionicons name="remove" size={16} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.deductionValue}>{scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.smallButton} onPress={() => updateDeductions('time_seconds_over', scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over + 1)}>
              <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.deductionRow}>
          <Text style={styles.deductionLabel}>Missed Words (count x 20)</Text>
          <View style={styles.deductionInputRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.smallButton} onPress={() => updateDeductions('missed_word_count', Math.max(0, scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count - 1))}>
              <Ionicons name="remove" size={16} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.deductionValue}>{scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.smallButton} onPress={() => updateDeductions('missed_word_count', scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count + 1)}>
              <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  const renderReviewStep = () => (
    <View style={styles.stepContent}>
      <Text style={styles.stepTitle}>Score Review</Text>
      <Text style={styles.stepSubtitle}>Confirm final scores</Text>
      <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
        <Text style={styles.reviewSectionTitle}>Oral: {currentScore.oral}/{ORAL_MAX}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Hesitation: Score {scoreSheet.oral.hesitation} x 25 = {scoreSheet.oral.hesitation * 25}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Pace: Score {scoreSheet.oral.pace} x 10 = {scoreSheet.oral.pace * 10}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Tone: Score {scoreSheet.oral.tone} x 15 = {scoreSheet.oral.tone * 15}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Pronunciation: Score {scoreSheet.oral.pronunciation} x 15 = {scoreSheet.oral.pronunciation * 15}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Volume: Score {scoreSheet.oral.volume} x 15 = {scoreSheet.oral.volume * 15}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
        <Text style={styles.reviewSectionTitle}>Non-Verbal: {currentScore.nonVerbal}/{NONVERBAL_MAX}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Eye Contact: Score {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.eye_contact} x 15 = {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.eye_contact * 15}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Mannerisms: Score {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.mannerisms} x 15 = {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.mannerisms * 15}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Gestures: Score {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.gestures} x 15 = {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.gestures * 15}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Poise: Score {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.poise} x 15 = {scoreSheet.nonVerbal.poise * 15}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect]}>
        <Text style={styles.reviewSectionTitle}>Q and A: {currentScore.qa}/{QA_MAX}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Details: Score {scoreSheet.qa.details} x 20 = {scoreSheet.qa.details * 20}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Unrehearsed: Score {scoreSheet.qa.unrehearsed} x 20 = {scoreSheet.qa.unrehearsed * 20}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Examples: Score {scoreSheet.qa.examples} x 20 = {scoreSheet.qa.examples * 20}</Text>
      </View>
      {(scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over > 0 || scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count > 0) && (
        <View style={[styles.glassCard, GlassEffect, styles.deductionCard]}>
          <Text style={styles.reviewSectionTitle}>Deductions: -{currentScore.deductions}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Time Over: {scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over}s x 1 = {scoreSheet.deductions.time_seconds_over}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.reviewText}>Missed Words: {scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count} x 20 = {scoreSheet.deductions.missed_word_count * 20}</Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Stack.Screen options={{ title: 'Creed Grading', headerTintColor: Theme.colors.accent, headerStyle: { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.dark } }} />
      <StepIndicator currentStep={step} />
      <ScrollView style={styles.scrollView} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {step === 'oral' && renderOralStep()}
        {step === 'nonverbal' && renderNonVerbalStep()}
        {step === 'qa' && renderQAStep()}
        {step === 'review' && renderReviewStep()}
      </ScrollView>
      <View style={[styles.footer, GlassEffect]}>
        <ScoreDisplay score={currentScore} />
        <View style={styles.buttonRow}>
          {step !== 'oral' && (
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backButton} onPress={prevStep}>
              <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={Theme.colors.text.secondary} />
              <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Back</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextButton} onPress={step === 'review' ? () => router.back() : nextStep}>
            <Text style={styles.nextButtonText}>{step === 'review' ? 'Done' : 'Next'}</Text>
            <Ionicons name={step === 'review' ? 'checkmark' : 'arrow-forward'} size={20} color="#000" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Theme.colors.dark },
  scrollView: { flex: 1 },
  scrollContent: { padding: 20, paddingBottom: 40 },
  stepIndicatorContainer: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', paddingVertical: 16, paddingHorizontal: 10, backgroundColor: Theme.colors.card },
  stepItem: { alignItems: 'center' },
  stepCircle: { width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: Theme.colors.glass.background, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: Theme.colors.glass.border, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  stepCircleActive: { backgroundColor: Theme.colors.accent, borderColor: Theme.colors.accent },
  stepNumber: { color: Theme.colors.text.secondary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700' },
  stepNumberActive: { color: '#000' },
  stepLabel: { fontSize: 11, color: Theme.colors.text.muted, marginTop: 4 },
