<file path="components/landing/Hero.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { View, StyleSheet, Dimensions, Image, Animated, Easing, ImageSourcePropType, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber/native';
import { Float, PerspectiveCamera } from '@react-three/drei/native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Theme } from '@/constants/theme';

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window');

// THE "SUCCESS MOMENT" FINAL ULTRA-PREMIUM ASSET
const HERO_IMAGE: ImageSourcePropType = require('../../assets/images/hero_sales_v4.png');

/**
 * FINAL HERO PRECISION SPECS:
 * 1. Image Scale: 25% bigger (dominating the landing experience).
 * 2. Aspect Ratio: Strict 16:9 (Cinematic).
 * 3. Space Above: Exactly 80px (approx 1").
 * 4. Space Below: Exactly 240px (approx 3").
 * 5. Instant-On: Local require + standard Image.
 */

const HERO_WIDTH = width * 0.95; 
const ASPECT_RATIO = 16 / 9;
const HERO_HEIGHT = HERO_WIDTH / ASPECT_RATIO;

function FloatingJewelry() {
  const items = [
    { pos: [-6, 3, 2], color: Theme.colors.accent, size: 0.18 },
    { pos: [7, 2, 3], color: Theme.colors.neonBlue, size: 0.14 },
    { pos: [-5, -2, 4], color: Theme.colors.neonBlue, size: 0.12 },
    { pos: [6, -3, 3], color: Theme.colors.accent, size: 0.2 },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      {items.map((item, i) => (
        <Float key={i} speed={2.5} rotationIntensity={0.8} floatIntensity={1.2}>
          <mesh position={item.pos as any}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[item.size, 32, 32]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial 
              color={item.color} 
              emissive={item.color} 
              emissiveIntensity={15} 
              toneMapped={false}
              metalness={0.8}
              roughness={0.2}
            />
          </mesh>
        </Float>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

const Hero = () => {
  const [imageLoaded, setImageLoaded] = useState(false);
  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0.95)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (imageLoaded) {
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 800,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.spring(scaleAnim, {
          toValue: 1,
          friction: 8,
          tension: 40,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]).start();
    }
  }, [imageLoaded]);

  return (
    <View style={styles.outerContainer}>
      <View style={styles.heroContainer}>
        {/* 
          Image Wrapper: Now strictly sized and centered 
        */}
        <Animated.View 
          style={[
            styles.imageWrapper, 
            { 
              opacity: fadeAnim,
              transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }] 
            }
          ]}
        >
          <Image 
            source={HERO_IMAGE}
            style={styles.heroImage}
            resizeMode="cover" // Crisp, full-frame cinematic look
            onLoad={() => setImageLoaded(true)}
            fadeDuration={0}
          />
        </Animated.View>

        {!imageLoaded && (
          <View style={styles.loaderContainer}>
            <ActivityIndicator color={Theme.colors.accent} size="large" />
          </View>
        )}

        {/* 3D Visual Depth Layer */}
        {imageLoaded && (
          <View style={styles.canvasContainer} pointerEvents="none">
            <Canvas flat>
              <PerspectiveCamera makeDefault position={[0, 0, 12]} fov={40} />
              <ambientLight intensity={1} />
              <pointLight position={[10, 10, 10]} intensity={2.5} color={Theme.colors.accent} />
              <pointLight position={[-10, -10, 10]} intensity={1.5} color={Theme.colors.neonBlue} />
              <FloatingJewelry />
            </Canvas>
          </View>
        )}

        <LinearGradient
          colors={['rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', 'transparent', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)']}
          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
          pointerEvents="none"
        />
      </View>

      {/* 
        PRECISION GAP: 3 Inches of empty black space 
      */}
      <View style={styles.bottomSpacer} />
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  outerContainer: {
    width: width,
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  heroContainer: {
    width: width,
    height: HERO_HEIGHT,
    marginTop: 80, // Requirement: approx 1" headroom
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    overflow: 'visible',
  },
  imageWrapper: {
    width: HERO_WIDTH,
    height: HERO_HEIGHT,
    borderRadius: 24,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    borderWidth: 1.5,
    borderColor: 'rgba(242, 169, 0, 0.3)',
    backgroundColor: '#050505',
    shadowColor: Theme.colors.accent,
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 0 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.4,
    shadowRadius: 30,
  },
  heroImage: {
    width: '100%',
    height: '100%',
  },
  canvasContainer: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    zIndex: 10,
    marginTop: -20,
  },
  loaderContainer: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#000',
  },
  bottomSpacer: {
    width: width,
    height: 240, // REQUIREMENT: 3 inches of empty space (~240px)
  },
});

export default Hero;
</file>

import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, Dimensions } from 'react-native';
import { Theme, GlassEffect } from '@/constants/theme';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window');

const tiers = [
  {
    name: 'The Greenhand',
    price: '$495',
    subtext: 'Year',
    description: 'Best For: Small chapters or specific team focus (Creed, Radio, etc.).',
    capacity: '1 login for every LDE Team + individual logins for Quiz students',
    credits: '5 Million',
    features: ['24/7 AI feedback', 'LDE-specific modules', 'Teacher progress tracking'],
    accent: Theme.colors.text.secondary,
  },
  {
    name: 'The Blue & Gold',
    price: '$895',
    subtext: 'Year',
    description: 'Best For: Active chapters with multiple LDE and CDE teams.',
    capacity: 'Same as Tier 1 + 40 CDE Logins',
    credits: '15 Million',
    features: ['Full access to all Ag Coach modules', 'Priority AI processing', 'Enhanced teacher dashboard'],
    accent: Theme.colors.accent,
    popular: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'The Lone Star Elite',
    price: '$1,495',
    subtext: 'Year',

    capacity: 'Capacity: Unlimited Students',
    credits: '40 Million',
    features: ['Unlimited student seats', 'Custom chapter branding', 'White-glove technical support'],
    accent: Theme.colors.neonBlue,
  },
];

function PricingCard({ tier, index }: { tier: any, index: number }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: index * 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
      whileHover={{ 
        y: -10, 
        scale: 1.02,
        transition: { duration: 0.3 } 
      }}
      className="pricing-card-motion"
      style={{
        width: Math.min(width - 40, 380),
        margin: 12,
      }}
    >
      <View style={[styles.card, GlassEffect, tier.popular && styles.popularCard]}>
        {tier.popular && (
          <View style={styles.badge}>
            <Text style={styles.badgeText}>ELITE CHAPTER CHOICE</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        <Text style={styles.tierName}>{tier.name}</Text>
        <View style={styles.priceContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.price}>{tier.price}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.perYear}>/ {tier.subtext}</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.capacity}>{tier.capacity}</Text>
        <View style={styles.creditBadge}>
          <Text style={styles.creditText}>Included Credits: {tier.credits}</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.description}>{tier.description}</Text>
        
        <View style={styles.featuresList}>
          {tier.features.map((feature: string, i: number) => (
            <View key={i} style={styles.featureItem}>
              <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={16} color={tier.accent} style={{ marginRight: 10 }} />
              <Text style={styles.featureText}>{feature}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>

        <motion.div
          whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          style={{ width: '100%' }}
        >
          <View style={[styles.button, { backgroundColor: tier.popular ? tier.accent : 'transparent', borderColor: tier.accent }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: tier.popular ? '#000' : tier.accent }]}>Secure Your Spot</Text>
          </View>
        </motion.div>
      </View>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function Packages() {
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}

import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

interface CategorySelectorProps {
  categories: string[];
  selectedCategory: string | null;
  onSelect: (category: string | null) => void;
  onStart: () => void;
  totalQuestions: number;
}

export default function CategorySelector({
  categories,
  selectedCategory,
  onSelect,
  onStart,
  totalQuestions,
}: CategorySelectorProps) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Customize Practice</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Select a topic to focus on or mix everything.</Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView style={styles.scroll} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.option, selectedCategory === null && styles.optionSelected]}
          onPress={() => onSelect(null)}
        >
          <View style={styles.optionIcon}>
            <Ionicons
              name="layers"
              size={24}
              color={selectedCategory === null ? '#fff' : '#003366'}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.optionTextContainer}>
            <Text style={[styles.optionTitle, selectedCategory === null && styles.textSelected]}>
              Mix Everything
            </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.optionSubtitle, selectedCategory === null && styles.textSelectedOpacity]}>
              All {totalQuestions} questions available
            </Text>
          </View>
          {selectedCategory === null && (
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color="#fff" />
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {categories.map((cat) => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={cat}
            style={[styles.option, selectedCategory === cat && styles.optionSelected]}
            onPress={() => onSelect(cat)}
          >
            <View style={styles.optionIcon}>
              <Ionicons
                name="pricetag"
                size={24}
                color={selectedCategory === cat ? '#fff' : '#003366'}
              />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.optionTextContainer}>
              <Text style={[styles.optionTitle, selectedCategory === cat && styles.textSelected]}>
                {cat}
              </Text>
            </View>
            {selectedCategory === cat && (
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={24} color="#fff" />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.startButton} onPress={onStart}>
          <Text style={styles.startButtonText}>Start Practice</Text>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="#fff" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

<file path="components/FlashCard.tsx">
import { TouchableOpacity, Text, StyleSheet, View, Dimensions } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useSharedValue,
  useAnimatedStyle,
  withTiming,
  interpolate,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

const { width: SCREEN_WIDTH } = Dimensions.get('window');
const CARD_WIDTH = SCREEN_WIDTH - 48;

interface FlashCardProps {
  front: string;
  back: string;
  backDetail?: string;
  isFlipped: boolean;
  onFlip: () => void;
  subcategory?: string;
}

export default function FlashCard({ front, back, backDetail, isFlipped, onFlip, subcategory }: FlashCardProps) {
  const rotation = useSharedValue(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    rotation.value = withTiming(isFlipped ? 180 : 0, { duration: 400 });
  }, [isFlipped]);

  const frontStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {
    const rotateY = interpolate(rotation.value, [0, 180], [0, 180]);
    return {
      transform: [{ rotateY: `${rotateY}deg` }],
      backfaceVisibility: 'hidden' as const,
    };
  });

  const backStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {
    const rotateY = interpolate(rotation.value, [0, 180], [180, 360]);
    return {
      transform: [{ rotateY: `${rotateY}deg` }],
      backfaceVisibility: 'hidden' as const,
    };
  });

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity onPress={onFlip} activeOpacity={0.9} style={styles.wrapper}>
      {/* Front of card */}
      <Animated.View style={[styles.card, styles.cardFront, frontStyle]}>
        {subcategory && (
          <View style={styles.subcategoryBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.subcategoryText}>{subcategory}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        <Ionicons name="help-circle-outline" size={32} color="#003366" style={styles.cardIcon} />
        <Text style={styles.cardText}>{front}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.tapHint}>Tap to reveal answer</Text>
      </Animated.View>

      {/* Back of card */}
      <Animated.View style={[styles.card, styles.cardBack, backStyle]}>
        <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle-outline" size={32} color="#4CAF50" style={styles.cardIcon} />
        <Text style={styles.answerText}>{back}</Text>
        {backDetail && (
          <View style={styles.detailSection}>
            <Text style={styles.detailLabel}>Explanation:</Text>
            <Text style={styles.detailText}>{backDetail}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        <Text style={styles.tapHint}>Tap to see question</Text>
      </Animated.View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    width: CARD_WIDTH,
    minHeight: 300,
    alignSelf: 'center',
  },
  card: {
    width: CARD_WIDTH,
    minHeight: 300,
    borderRadius: 20,
    padding: 24,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.12,
    shadowRadius: 12,
    elevation: 5,
  },
  cardFront: {
    backgroundColor: '#fff',
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
  },
  cardBack: {
    backgroundColor: '#F0FFF0',
    borderWidth: 2,
    borderColor: '#4CAF50',
  },
  subcategoryBadge: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 16,
    left: 16,
    backgroundColor: '#E3F2FD',
    paddingHorizontal: 10,
    paddingVertical: 4,
    borderRadius: 6,
  },

    fontSize: 12,

  },

<file path="components/QuestionCard.tsx">
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Question } from '@/types';

interface QuestionCardProps {
  question: Question;
  questionNumber: number;
  selectedAnswer: string | null;
  showResult: boolean;
  onSelectAnswer: (answer: string) => void;
}

export default function QuestionCard({
  question,
  questionNumber,
  selectedAnswer,
  showResult,
  onSelectAnswer,
}: QuestionCardProps) {
  const isScenario = question.question_type === 'scenario';
  const optionLabels = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'];

  const getOptionStyle = (option: string) => {
    if (!showResult) {
      return option === selectedAnswer ? styles.optionSelected : styles.option;
    }

    if (option === question.correct_answer) {
      return [styles.option, styles.optionCorrect];
    }
    if (option === selectedAnswer && option !== question.correct_answer) {
      return [styles.option, styles.optionIncorrect];
    }
    return styles.option;
  };

  const getOptionTextStyle = (option: string) => {
    if (!showResult) {
      return option === selectedAnswer ? styles.optionTextSelected : styles.optionText;
    }

    if (option === question.correct_answer) {
      return [styles.optionText, styles.optionTextCorrect];
    }
    if (option === selectedAnswer && option !== question.correct_answer) {
      return [styles.optionText, styles.optionTextIncorrect];
    }
    return styles.optionText;
  };

  const getOptionIcon = (option: string): { name: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap; color: string } | null => {
    if (!showResult) return null;
    if (option === question.correct_answer) {
      return { name: 'checkmark-circle', color: '#4CAF50' };
    }
    if (option === selectedAnswer && option !== question.correct_answer) {
      return { name: 'close-circle', color: '#F44336' };
    }
    return null;
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
      {/* Question number badge */}
      <View style={styles.badge}>
        <Text style={styles.badgeText}>Question {questionNumber}</Text>
        {question.subcategory && (
          <Text style={styles.subcategory}>{question.subcategory}</Text>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Question text */}
      <Text style={styles.questionText}>{question.question_text}</Text>

      {/* Options for multiple choice / true-false */}
      {!isScenario && question.options && (
        <View style={styles.optionsContainer}>
          {question.options.map((option, index) => {
            const icon = getOptionIcon(option);
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={index}
                style={getOptionStyle(option)}
                onPress={() => !showResult && onSelectAnswer(option)}
                disabled={showResult}
                activeOpacity={0.7}
              >
                <View style={styles.optionLabelCircle}>
                  <Text style={styles.optionLabel}>{optionLabels[index]}</Text>
                </View>
                <Text style={getOptionTextStyle(option)} numberOfLines={3}>
                  {option}
                </Text>
                {icon && (
                  <Ionicons name={icon.name} size={22} color={icon.color} style={styles.optionIcon} />
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Scenario questions (open-ended): show hint to think about answer */}
      {isScenario && !showResult && (
        <View style={styles.scenarioPrompt}>
          <Ionicons name="bulb-outline" size={20} color="#F2A900" />
          <Text style={styles.scenarioText}>
            Think about your answer, then tap "Show Answer" to see a sample response.
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}

      {isScenario && !showResult && (
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.showAnswerButton}
          onPress={() => onSelectAnswer('viewed')}
        >
          <Text style={styles.showAnswerText}>Show Answer</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      )}

      {/* Explanation / Answer (shown after answering) */}
      {showResult && (
        <View style={styles.explanationCard}>
          {isScenario && (
            <View style={styles.sampleAnswer}>
              <Text style={styles.sampleAnswerLabel}>Sample Answer:</Text>
              <Text style={styles.sampleAnswerText}>{question.correct_answer}</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          {question.explanation && (
            <>
              <View style={styles.explanationHeader}>
                <Ionicons name="information-circle" size={18} color="#2196F3" />
                <Text style={styles.explanationTitle}>Explanation</Text>
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.explanationText}>{question.explanation}</Text>
            </>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={{ height: 20 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

<file path="components/ScoreCircle.tsx">
import { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Circle } from 'react-native-svg';

interface ScoreCircleProps {
  percentage: number;
  size?: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  label?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export default function ScoreCircle({
  percentage,
  size = 160,
  strokeWidth = 12,
  label = 'Score',
  color: customColor,
}: ScoreCircleProps) {
  const radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const progress = Math.min(Math.max(percentage, 0), 100);
  const strokeDashoffset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;

  const getColor = () => {
    if (progress >= 80) return '#4CAF50';
    if (progress >= 60) return '#F2A900';
    return '#F44336';
  };

  const getMessage = () => {
    if (progress >= 90) return 'Outstanding!';
    if (progress >= 80) return 'Great Job!';
    if (progress >= 70) return 'Good Work!';
    if (progress >= 60) return 'Keep Practicing!';
    return 'Keep Studying!';
  };

  const color = customColor || getColor();

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
        <Svg width={size} height={size}>
          {/* Background circle */}
          <Circle
            cx={size / 2}
            cy={size / 2}
            r={radius}
            stroke="#e0e0e0"
            strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
            fill="none"
          />
          {/* Progress circle */}
          <Circle
            cx={size / 2}
            cy={size / 2}
            r={radius}
            stroke={color}
            strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
            fill="none"
            strokeDasharray={circumference}
            strokeDashoffset={strokeDashoffset}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}
          />
        </Svg>
        {/* Center text */}
        <View style={[styles.center, { width: size, height: size }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.percentage, { color }]}>{Math.round(progress)}%</Text>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{label}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <Text style={[styles.message, { color }]}>{getMessage()}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  center: {
    position: 'absolute',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  percentage: {
    fontSize: 36,
    fontWeight: '800',
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: '#888',
    marginTop: 2,
  },
  message: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: '700',
    marginTop: 12,
  },
});
</file>

<file path="components/TimerDisplay.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Theme } from '@/constants/theme';

interface TimerDisplayProps {
  totalSeconds: number;
  onTimeUp: () => void;
  isRunning: boolean;
}

export default function TimerDisplay({ totalSeconds, onTimeUp, isRunning }: TimerDisplayProps) {
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(totalSeconds);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setRemaining(totalSeconds);
  }, [totalSeconds]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isRunning && remaining > 0) {
      intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setRemaining((prev) => {
          if (prev <= 1) {
            if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
            onTimeUp();
            return 0;
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
    }

    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [isRunning]);

  const minutes = Math.floor(remaining / 60);
  const seconds = remaining % 60;
  const isLow = remaining < 60;
  const isCritical = remaining < 30;

  return (
    <View style={[
      styles.container, 
      isLow && styles.containerLow, 
      isCritical && styles.containerCritical
    ]}>
      <Ionicons 
        name="timer-outline" 
        size={18} 
        color={isCritical ? '#fff' : isLow ? '#F44336' : Theme.colors.accent} 
      />
      <Text style={[styles.time, isLow && styles.timeLow, isCritical && styles.timeCritical]}>
        {String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(242,169,0,0.1)',
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 8,
    borderRadius: 20,
    gap: 6,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: 'rgba(242,169,0,0.2)',
  },
  containerLow: {
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(244,67,54,0.1)',
    borderColor: 'rgba(244,67,54,0.3)',
  },
  containerCritical: {
    backgroundColor: '#F44336',
    borderColor: '#F44336',
  },
  time: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: Theme.colors.accent,
    letterSpacing: 0.5,
  },
  timeLow: {
    color: '#F44336',
  },
  timeCritical: {
    color: '#fff',
  },
});
</file>

export function getContestById(id: string): Contest | undefined {
  return ALL_CONTESTS.find(c => c.id === id);
}
</file>

<file path="constants/creed.ts">
// The FFA Creed by E.M. Tiffany
// Official text used for Creed Speaking LDE

export const FFA_CREED_PARAGRAPHS = [
  'I believe in the future of agriculture, with a faith born not of words but of deeds \u2013 achievements won by the present and past generations of agriculturists; in the promise of better days through better ways, even as the better things we now enjoy have come to us from the struggles of former years.',

  'I believe that to live and work on a good farm, or to be engaged in other agricultural pursuits, is pleasant as well as challenging; for I know the joys and discomforts of agricultural life and hold an inborn fondness for those associations which, even in hours of discouragement, I cannot deny.',

  'I believe in leadership from ourselves and respect from others. I believe in my own ability to work efficiently and think clearly, with such knowledge and skill as I can secure, and in the ability of progressive agriculturists to serve our own and the public interest in producing and marketing the product of our toil.',

  'I believe in less dependence on begging and more power in bargaining; in the life abundant and enough honest wealth to help make it so \u2013 for others as well as myself; in less need for charity and more of it when needed; in being happy myself and playing square with those whose happiness depends upon me.',

  'I believe that American agriculture can and will hold true to the best traditions of our national life and that I can exert an influence in my home and community which will stand solid for my part in that inspiring task.',
];

export const FFA_CREED_FULL = FFA_CREED_PARAGRAPHS.join('\n\n');

export const FFA_CREED_AUTHOR = 'E.M. Tiffany';

// Scoring rules from Texas FFA LDE Rules
// Each recitation error (missed, added, or switched word) = 20 point deduction
export const CREED_SCORING = {
  maxScore: 100,
  errorPenalty: 1, // points deducted per error (Adjusted from 20 for practice mode)
  // Errors include: missed words, added words, switched words
  // All recitation errors must be tracked
};

// Word count for reference (helps with timing estimates)
export const FFA_CREED_WORD_COUNT = FFA_CREED_FULL.split(/\s+/).length;

// Expected recitation time in seconds (4 minutes max per LDE rules)
export const CREED_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS = 240;
</file>

<file path="constants/spanish-creed.ts">
// El Credo de FFA - Official Texas FFA Spanish Translation
// Approved by Texas FFA Board of Directors, September 11, 2017

export const FFA_CREED_SPANISH_PARAGRAPHS = [
  'Creo en el porvenir de la agricultura con una fe que no surge de las palabras, sino de los logros de los agricultores en generaciones pasadas y en la presente; en la promesa de días mejores gracias a la práctica de buenas normas de trabajo, así como creo que los beneficios que disfrutamos hoy son nuestros por los esfuerzos de nuestros antepasados.',

  'Creo que vivir y trabajar en una finca, o estar involucrado en otros intereses agrícolas, es grato y retador porque conozco los goces e inconvenientes de la vida de campo, y le profeso una devoción que no le negaré ni siquiera en las horas de infortunio.',

  'Creo que debemos ser nuestros propios líderes y en el respeto de los demás. Creo en mi propia habilidad para trabajar con eficacia y tener claridad de pensamiento gracias a los conocimientos y destrezas que vaya adquiriendo. Creo también en el poder de los agricultores progresistas para servir nuestros intereses y los del público en cuanto a la producción y mercadeo del producto de nuestra labor.',

  'Creo que debe haber menos dependencia de la caridad y más en nuestras habilidades comerciales; en una vida de abundancia y en la obtención honrada de los medios económicos que la hacen posible, tanto para los demás como para mi; en que haya menos necesidad de la caridad, y en la caridad cuando ésta sea necesaria; en mi propia dicha, y en que debo proceder honestamente con aquellos cuyo bienestar dependa de mí.',

  'Creo que la industria agrícola de Estados Unidos puede y debe mantener las mejores tradiciones de nuestra experiencia nacional y que yo puedo ejercer influencia en mi hogar y la comunidad, los cuales serán siempre sólidos gracias a mi contribución en esta tarea vivificante.',
];

export const FFA_CREED_SPANISH_FULL = FFA_CREED_SPANISH_PARAGRAPHS.join('\n\n');

export const FFA_CREED_SPANISH_AUTHOR = 'E.M. Tiffany';

export const FFA_CREED_SPANISH_WORD_COUNT = FFA_CREED_SPANISH_FULL.split(/\s+/).length;

// Expected recitation time in seconds (4 minutes max per LDE rules)

/**
 * Anthropic Claude Service for AI Feedback
 * Analyzes transcriptions for tone, pace, and performance quality
 */

const ANTHROPIC_API_URL = 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages';

import { generateAnalysis } from './gemini';

export interface AIAnalysisResult {
  score: number;
  feedback: string[];
  sentiment: string;
}

/**
 * Analyzes a presentation transcription using Claude
 */
export async function analyzePresentation(
  transcription: string,
  event: string,
  apiKey: string
): Promise<AIAnalysisResult> {
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.log('No Anthropic key, falling back to Gemini for analysis');
    return generateAnalysis(`Analyze this ${event} presentation`, transcription);
  }

  const prompt = `
    You are an expert FFA LDE (Leadership Development Event) judge.
    Analyze the following transcription of a student's ${event} presentation.
    
    Transcription: "${transcription}"
    
    Provide constructive feedback in the following format:
    1. A qualitative score from 0-100 for "Delivery & Presence" (based on the text alone).
    2. 3-4 specific bullet points of feedback.
    3. An overall sentiment (e.g., "Excellent", "Confident", "Needs Practice").
    
    Respond in JSON format:
    {
      "score": number,
      "feedback": ["point 1", "point 2", "point 3"],
      "sentiment": "string"
    }
  `;

  try {
    const response = await fetch(ANTHROPIC_API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-api-key': apiKey,
        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
        max_tokens: 1000,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Claude API failed with status ${response.status}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    const content = data.content[0].text;
    
    // Parse the JSON from Claude's response
    try {
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      // Fallback if Claude doesn't return perfect JSON
      return {
        score: 80,
        feedback: ["Good attempt, keep practicing your delivery."],
        sentiment: "Good Progress"
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Claude analysis failed:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Evaluates a student's answer to a Creed question
 */
export async function evaluateAnswer(
  question: string,
  transcription: string,
  apiKey: string
): Promise<AIAnalysisResult> {
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.log('No Anthropic key, falling back to Gemini for answer evaluation');
    return generateAnalysis(`Evaluate answer to: ${question}`, transcription);
  }

  const prompt = `
    You are an expert FFA LDE judge. Evaluate the student's answer to this FFA Creed question.
    
    Question: "${question}"
    Student Answer: "${transcription}"
    
    Provide constructive feedback in JSON format:
    {
      "score": number (0-100),
      "feedback": ["point 1", "point 2"],
      "sentiment": "string (e.g., Thoughtful, Incomplete, Excellent)"
    }
  `;

  try {
    const response = await fetch(ANTHROPIC_API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-api-key': apiKey,
        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
        max_tokens: 1000,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Claude API failed with status ${response.status}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    const content = data.content[0].text;
    
    try {
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        score: 75,
        feedback: ["Keep practicing your critical thinking on the Creed's meaning."],
        sentiment: "Needs Depth"
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Claude evaluation failed:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

<file path="lib/ai/gemini.ts">
import { GoogleGenerativeAI } from "@google/generative-ai";

/**
 * Gemini Service for the "FFA Brain"
 * Uses Gemini 1.5 Flash for grounded knowledge and quiz generation.
 */

const API_KEY = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY || "";
const genAI = API_KEY ? new GoogleGenerativeAI(API_KEY) : null;

import { useAuthStore } from "../store/auth";

export interface BrainResponse {
  answer: string;
  sources: string[];
}

/**
 * Checks if the user has enough credits and deducts one if they are a student.
 */
async function checkAndDeductCredits(): Promise<void> {
  const { user, role, demoMode } = useAuthStore.getState();
  
  // Teachers and non-students have unlimited for now
  if (role !== 'student') return;

  const currentCredits = user?.user_metadata?.credits ?? 0;

  if (currentCredits <= 0) {
    throw new Error("You have run out of API credits. Please ask your Ag Teacher to add more credits to your account!");
  }

  // Deduct a credit
  if (demoMode && user) {
    user.user_metadata.credits = currentCredits - 1;
    // In a real app, we would update Supabase/Store here
  }
}

export interface GeneratedQuestion {
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correctAnswer: string;
  explanation: string;
}

export interface CreedGradingResult {
  oralScore: number;
  nonVerbalScore: number;
  qaScore?: number;
  detailedScores?: {
    oral: { hesitation: number; pace: number; tone: number; pronunciation: number; volume: number; };
    non_verbal: { eye_contact: number; mannerisms: number; gestures: number; poise: number; };
    qa: { details: number; unrehearsed: number; examples: number; };
  };
  feedback: string[];
  sentiment: string;
}

export interface LDEGradingResult {
  scores: Record<string, Record<string, number>>; // categoryId -> itemId -> score
  totalScore: number;
  feedback: string[];
  sentiment: string;
}

const RETRY_DELAYS = [500, 1000, 2000]; // More aggressive for UX: 0.5s, 1s, 2s

async function retryOperation<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>, operationName: string): Promise<T> {
  let lastError: any;
  
  for (let i = 0; i <= RETRY_DELAYS.length; i++) {
    try {
      console.log(`[GEMINI] ${operationName} - Starting attempt ${i + 1}...`);
      const startTime = Date.now();
      
      // Add a 45s timeout to the operation
      const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Request timed out after 45 seconds')), 45000);
      });

      const result = await Promise.race([
          operation(),
          timeoutPromise
      ]) as T;
      
      console.log(`[GEMINI] ${operationName} - Success (${Date.now() - startTime}ms)`);
      return result;
    } catch (error: any) {
      lastError = error;
      console.warn(`${operationName} failed (Attempt ${i + 1}/${RETRY_DELAYS.length + 1}):`, error.message);
      
      const isRetryable = error.message?.includes('503') || error.message?.includes('overloaded') || error.message?.includes('429') || error.message?.includes('rate limit');
      if (!isRetryable || i === RETRY_DELAYS.length) break;
      
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, RETRY_DELAYS[i]));
    }
  }
  
  throw lastError;
}

/**
 * Asks the "Brain" a question based on a specific context/manual.
 */
export async function askBrain(question: string, context: string): Promise<BrainResponse> {
  await checkAndDeductCredits();

  if (!genAI) {
    return {
      answer: "I'm currently in demo mode. Please configure EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY to enable my full intelligence!",
      sources: ["Demo Mode"]
    };
  }

  const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
    model: "gemini-flash-latest",
    systemInstruction: `
      ROLE & PERSONA:
      You are "Ag Coach Pro," a veteran Texas FFA Advisor. 
      Your mission is to provide clear, actionable coaching based strictly on the provided FFA manuals.
      
      TONE & STYLE:
      - Use a "Texas FFA" voice: Professional, straightforward, and supportive. 
      - Use phrases like "Howdy," "Alright," or "Listen up" sparingly but effectively.
      - Be extremely direct. Cut to the chase.
      
      GUARDRAILS:
      - FORMAT: All responses MUST be concise and heavily use bullet points. 
      - JARGON: Strictly avoid AI jargon (no "swarms," "loops," or "models").
      - RELEVANCE: Focus ONLY on the specific contest asked. No knowledge dumping.
      - MISSING TOPIC: If the topic is missing from the manual, state "This topic is not in the provided manual" clearly and then give general contest best practices.
      
      RESPONSE TEMPLATE:
      1. Direct Answer (Concise bullet)
      2. Key Facts/References (Only if relevant to the specific topic)
      3. Coaching Tip (One actionable step)
    `
  });

  const prompt = `
    TASK:
    Analyze the following Context and Question.
    Provide a concise, bulleted response as Ag Coach Pro.
    
    CONTEXT:
    ${context}
    
    QUESTION:
    ${question}
  `;

  try {
    const result = await retryOperation(() => model.generateContent(prompt), "askBrain");
    const text = result.response.text();
    return {
      answer: text,
      sources: ["Official FFA Material"]
    };
  } catch (error: any) {

    throw new Error(`Failed to consult the Brain. Details: ${error.message || error}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Specialized Grader for FFA Creed
 * Strictly follows the 30/30/40 rubric format
 */
export async function gradeCreedRecitation(
  transcription: string,
  rubricContext: string
): Promise<CreedGradingResult> {
  if (!genAI) {
    return {
      oralScore: 25,
      nonVerbalScore: 24,
      feedback: ["Demo Mode: Simulated feedback."],
      sentiment: "Good Start"
    };
  }

  const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
    model: "gemini-flash-latest",
    generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" },
    systemInstruction: `
      ROLE: Expert FFA Creed Speaking Judge.
      TASK: Grade a student's recitation based on the official 1000-point rubric.
      
      RUBRIC STRUCTURE & WEIGHTS:
      1. Oral Communication (Max 400pts): 
         - Hesitation (25), Pace (10), Tone (15), Pronunciation (15), Volume (15)
      2. Non-Verbal Communication (Max 300pts): 
         - Eye Contact (15), Mannerisms (15), Gestures (15), Poise (15)
      3. Q&A (Max 300pts):
         - Details (20), Unrehearsed (20), Examples (20)

      SCORING METHOD:
      For each sub-item above, assign a quality score from 1 (Low) to 5 (Mastery).
      The final points for that item = Score * Weight.

      NOTE: Since you are analyzing a transcription, you must infer Non-Verbal quality based on:
      - Fluency (lack of 'um', 'uh', restarts)
      - Pacing indicators in text
      - General cohesiveness
    `
  });

  const prompt = `
    RECITATION TRANSCRIPT:
    "${transcription}"

    TASK:
    Evaluate the performance and return a detailed JSON object. 
    Be strict but fair.
    
    RETURN JSON FORMAT:
    {
      "detailedScores": {
        "oral": { "hesitation": 1-5, "pace": 1-5, "tone": 1-5, "pronunciation": 1-5, "volume": 1-5 },
        "non_verbal": { "eye_contact": 1-5, "mannerisms": 1-5, "gestures": 1-5, "poise": 1-5 },
        "qa": { "details": 1-5, "unrehearsed": 1-5, "examples": 1-5 }
      },
      "feedback": string[] (4 specific coaching points),
      "sentiment": string
    }
  `;

  try {
    const result = await retryOperation(() => model.generateContent(prompt), "gradeCreedRecitation");
    const data = JSON.parse(result.response.text());
    
    // Calculate totals based on weights
    const oral = data.detailedScores.oral;
    const oralScore = (oral.hesitation * 25) + (oral.pace * 10) + (oral.tone * 15) + (oral.pronunciation * 15) + (oral.volume * 15);
    
    const nv = data.detailedScores.non_verbal;
    const nonVerbalScore = (nv.eye_contact * 15) + (nv.mannerisms * 15) + (nv.gestures * 15) + (nv.poise * 15);
    
    const qa = data.detailedScores.qa;
    const qaScore = (qa.details * 20) + (qa.unrehearsed * 20) + (qa.examples * 20);

    return {
      ...data,
      oralScore,
      nonVerbalScore,
      qaScore
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Creed Grading Error:", error);
    return {
      oralScore: 280, // Return something visible on error
      nonVerbalScore: 210,
      qaScore: 210,
      detailedScores: {
        oral: { hesitation: 3, pace: 3, tone: 3, pronunciation: 3, volume: 3 },
        non_verbal: { eye_contact: 3, mannerisms: 3, gestures: 3, poise: 3 },
        qa: { details: 3, unrehearsed: 3, examples: 3 }
      },
      feedback: ["The AI judge had trouble parsing the performance. Please ensure the recording is clear and try again."],
      sentiment: "Processing Error"
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Dynamic Grader for all LDE contests.
 * Uses the LDERubric definition to generate a custom prompt and parse results.
 */
export async function gradeLDEContest(
  transcription: string,
  rubric: any // LDERubric
): Promise<LDEGradingResult> {
  if (!genAI) {
    return {
      scores: {},
      totalScore: 850,
      feedback: ["Demo Mode: AI feedback is simulated."],
      sentiment: "Good Performance"
    };
  }

  // Generate a mapping of category/item descriptions for the prompt
  const rubricDescription = rubric.categories.map((cat: any) => {
    const items = cat.items.map((item: any) => `- ${item.name} (${item.weight} pts)`).join('\n');
    return `### ${cat.name} (Max ${cat.maxPoints} pts)\n${items}`;
  }).join('\n\n');

  const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
    model: "gemini-flash-latest",
    generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" },
    systemInstruction: `
      ROLE: Expert Texas FFA LDE Judge for ${rubric.contestName}.
      TASK: Grade a student's performance transcript strictly against the provided rubric.
      
      RUBRIC CRITERIA:
      ${rubricDescription}

      SCORING METHOD:
      For each item listed in the rubric, assign a quality score from 1 (Low/Poor) to 5 (Mastery/Excellent).
      1 = Needs significant improvement
      2 = Satisfactory but lacks depth
      3 = Good, meets standard requirements
      4 = Very good, demonstrates strong skill
      5 = Mastery, perfect execution

      NOTE: If you are judging based on a transcript, you must infer non-verbal or delivery quality from:
      - Fluency (lack of 'um', 'uh', restarts)
      - Clarity and structure of the speech
      - Command of the subject matter
    `
  });

  const prompt = `
    PERFORMANCE TRANSCRIPT:
    "${transcription}"

    TASK:
    Evaluate the performance and return a detailed JSON object.
    You MUST provide a 1-5 score for EVERY sub-item in the rubric.
    
    RETURN JSON FORMAT:
    {
      "scores": {
        "category_id": { "item_id": 1-5, ... },
        ...
      },
      "feedback": string[] (At least 4 specific, contest-specific coaching points),
      "sentiment": string (One word describing the tone of the performance)
    }
  `;

  try {
    const result = await retryOperation(() => model.generateContent(prompt), `gradeLDEContest:${rubric.contestId}`);
    const rawText = result.response.text();
    
    // Clean up markdown code blocks if AI included them
    const cleanJson = rawText.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim();
    const data = JSON.parse(cleanJson);

    // Calculate total weighted score
    let totalScore = 0;
    rubric.categories.forEach((cat: any) => {
      cat.items.forEach((item: any) => {
        const score1to5 = data.scores[cat.id]?.[item.id] || 3; // Default to 3 if AI misses an item
        totalScore += (score1to5 / 5) * item.weight;
      });
    });

    return {
      scores: data.scores,
      totalScore: Math.round(totalScore),
      feedback: data.feedback,
      sentiment: data.sentiment
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(`LDE Grading Error (${rubric.contestId}):`, error);
    throw new Error(`Failed to grade ${rubric.contestName}. Details: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

<file path="lib/ai/openai.ts">
const OPENAI_API_URL = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions';

export interface OpenAIResponse {
  answer: string;
}

/**
 * Generic function to call OpenAI Chat Completion
 */
export async function askOpenAI(
  systemPrompt: string, 
  userPrompt: string, 
  model: string = 'gpt-4o'
): Promise<OpenAIResponse> {
  const apiKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2;

  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error('OpenAI API key is not configured');
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(OPENAI_API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: model,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
        ],
        temperature: 0.7,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
        const errorText = await response.text();
        throw new Error(`OpenAI API request failed with status ${response.status}: ${errorText}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    const content = data.choices[0].message.content;

    return {
      answer: content
    };

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('OpenAI Request Failed:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

<file path="lib/ai/whisper.ts">
/**
 * OpenAI Whisper Speech-to-Text Service
 * Handles audio transcription for LDE events like Creed Speaking
 */

import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

const OPENAI_API_URL = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions';

interface TranscriptionResult {
  text: string;
  duration?: number;
}

/**
 * Transcribes an audio file using OpenAI Whisper API
 * @param audioUri - Local URI of the audio file
 * @param apiKey - OpenAI API key
 * @param language - Language code for transcription (default: 'en')
 * @returns Transcription result with text
 */
export async function transcribeAudio(
  audioUri: string,
  apiKey: string,
  language: string = 'en'
): Promise<TranscriptionResult> {
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error('OpenAI API key is required for transcription');
  }

  try {
    // Check if running on web
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      console.log('Web platform detected - using CORS proxy for Whisper API');
      console.warn('Ensure local proxy is running: node scripts/whisper-proxy.js');
      
      const audioResponse = await fetch(audioUri);
      const audioBlob = await audioResponse.blob();
      
      // Safety check for Web file size (25MB limit)
      const sizeInMB = audioBlob.size / (1024 * 1024);
      console.log(`[WHISPER] Web File size: ${sizeInMB.toFixed(2)} MB`);
      if (sizeInMB > 25) {
        throw new Error(`File is too large (${sizeInMB.toFixed(2)}MB). Limit is 25MB. Please try a shorter recording.`);
      }

      const mimeType = audioBlob.type.split(';')[0];
      const ext = mimeType.split('/')[1] || 'webm';
      const filename = `audio.${ext}`;

      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', audioBlob, filename);
      formData.append('model', 'whisper-1');
      formData.append('language', language);
      formData.append('response_format', 'json');

      // For web: Use local proxy server to bypass CORS
      // Run: node scripts/whisper-proxy.js (port 3001)
      const proxyUrl = 'http://localhost:3001/transcribe';
      
      console.log('[WHISPER] Calling Whisper via local proxy...');
      
      // Add a 60s timeout for the fetch request
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 60000);

      const response = await fetch(proxyUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        },
        body: formData,
        signal: controller.signal
      });
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorText = await response.text();
        console.error('Whisper API error:', errorText);
        let errorMessage = `Transcription failed with status ${response.status}`;
        try {
          const errorData = JSON.parse(errorText);
          errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || errorMessage;
        } catch {}
        
        if (response.status === 404 || response.status === 500) {
            errorMessage += ' (Is the proxy running? Run: node scripts/whisper-proxy.js)';
        }
        throw new Error(errorMessage);
      }

      const result = await response.json();
      console.log('Whisper transcription successful:', result.text?.substring(0, 50) + '...');
      return {
        text: result.text || '',
        duration: result.duration,
      };
    }

    // Native implementation
    const fileInfo = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(audioUri);
    if (!fileInfo.exists) {
      throw new Error('Audio file not found');
    }

    // Check file size (OpenAI Whisper limit is 25MB)
    const sizeInMB = fileInfo.size / (1024 * 1024);
    console.log(`File size: ${sizeInMB.toFixed(2)} MB`);
    
    if (sizeInMB > 25) {
      throw new Error(`File is too large (${sizeInMB.toFixed(2)}MB). Limit is 25MB. Please try a shorter recording.`);
    }

    // Use FileSystem.uploadAsync explicitly for Native reliability (fixes "Load failed")
    console.log('Uploading audio via FileSystem.uploadAsync...');
    
    // Force .mp4 extension even for iOS .mov to bypass OpenAI file type checks
    // (The underlying container is usually compatible)
    const fileType = 'video/mp4';
    const fileName = 'recording.mp4';

    console.log(`Preparing upload: ${fileName} (${fileType}) from ${audioUri}`);

    const uploadResult = await FileSystem.uploadAsync(OPENAI_API_URL, audioUri, {
        httpMethod: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        },
        fieldName: 'file',
        mimeType: fileType,
        uploadType: FileSystem.FileSystemUploadType.MULTIPART,
        parameters: {
            'model': 'whisper-1',
            'language': language,
            'response_format': 'json',
        },
    });

    console.log('Upload Status:', uploadResult.status);

    if (uploadResult.status !== 200) {
        let errorMessage = `Transcription failed with status ${uploadResult.status}`;
        try {
            const errorData = JSON.parse(uploadResult.body);
            errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || errorMessage;
        } catch (e) {
             console.error('Failed to parse error body:', uploadResult.body);
        }
        throw new Error(errorMessage);
    }

    const result = JSON.parse(uploadResult.body);
    
    return {
      text: result.text || '',
      duration: result.duration,
    };

  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error('Failed to transcribe audio: ' + String(error));
  }
}

/**
 * Get MIME type for audio file extension
 */
function getMimeType(extension: string): string {
  const mimeTypes: Record<string, string> = {
    mp3: 'audio/mpeg',
    mp4: 'audio/mp4',
    m4a: 'audio/m4a',
    wav: 'audio/wav',
    webm: 'audio/webm',
    ogg: 'audio/ogg',
  };
  return mimeTypes[extension] || 'audio/mp4';
}

SECTION 3: AG ISSUES FORUM
- Purpose: Present both pros and cons of a controversial agricultural issue.
- Team Size: 3-7 members.
- Time Limit: 15 minutes max presentation, 5 minutes Q&A.
- Scoring:
  - Portfolio (95 pts): Summary, Bibliography, Forum Visits.
  - Presentation (650 pts): Intro, Pro, Con, Summary/Effectiveness.
  - Questions (250 pts).

SECTION 4: CHAPTER CONDUCTING
- Purpose: Demonstrate parliamentary procedure and opening/closing ceremonies.
- Team Size: 7-10 members (Greenhand), 7-10 (Senior).
- Components: 
  - Written Exam (Parliamentary Law).
  - Opening/Closing Ceremonies.
  - Mock Meeting (demonstrating assigned motions).
  - Oral Questions (Senior Division only).

SECTION 5: JOB INTERVIEW
- Purpose: Simulate real-world employment process.
- Components: 
  - Cover Letter & Resume (submitted prior).
  - Application (completed on-site).
  - Telephone Interview.
  - Personal Interview.
  - Follow-up Letter.

KEY PARLIAMENTARY RULES (Gray's Guide):
1. Main Motion Rank: Lowest precedence.
2. Previous Question: Requires 2/3 vote, undebatable, unamendable.
3. Reconsider: Must be made by a member who voted on the prevailing side.
4. Lay on the Table: Temporarily delays action; undebatable, unamendable.
5. Point of Order: No second required, undebatable, may interrupt.

KEY TEXAS FARM FACTS (2025 Edition):
1. Cattle: Texas has 12.2 million head (#1), more than the human population of 43 states.
2. Cotton: Texas is the #1 cotton-producing state.
3. Rice: Texas is the 5th largest producer.
4. Citrus: Texas is 3rd largest producer (> $300 million impact).
5. Farmer Impact: One U.S. farm feeds 169 people annually.
SECTION 6: FFA BROADCASTING (RADIO)
- Purpose: Present an informative and engaging radio program covering agricultural news and issues.
- Team Size: 3 members.
- Time Limit: 5-8 minutes.
- Scoring:
  - Content (100): News value, creativity, organization.
  - Delivery (100): Voice quality, diction, timing.
  - Technical (50): Sound effects, transitions.

SECTION 7: PUBLIC RELATIONS
- Purpose: Present a program to a specific target audience promoting FFA/Ag Ed.
- Team Size: 2-4 members.
- Time Limit: 5-8 minutes.
- Scoring:
  - Presentation (600): Organization, creativity, effectiveness.
  - Q&A (400): Knowledge, poise, response quality.

SECTION 8: AG SKILL DEMONSTRATION
- Purpose: Demonstrate an actual agricultural skill (e.g., wiring, grafting, branding).
- Team Size: 3-5 members.
- Time Limit: 20 minutes max.
- Scoring:
  - Introduction (10).
  - Demonstration (50): Accuracy, safety, clarity.
  - Summary (10).
  - Q&A (30).

SECTION 9: GREENHAND FFA QUIZ
- Purpose: Test first-year members on FFA knowledge.
- Format: 100 Question Exam (Multiple Choice & True/False).
- Sources: 
  - FFA Manual.
  - Gray's Parliamentary Guide.
  - District Officer Study Guide.

SECTION 10: CREED SPEAKING (Greenhand & Senior)
- Purpose: Memorized delivery of the FFA Creed by E.M. Tiffany.
- Time Limit: 4 minutes.
- Scoring:
  - Oral Communication (60): Voice, stage presence, power, expression.
  - Accuracy (20): Deductions for missed/added words.
  - Answer to Questions (20): Insight, logic, poise.

SECTION 11: SPANISH CREED SPEAKING (Greenhand & Senior)
- Purpose: Recitation of the FFA Creed in Spanish.
- Rules: 
  - Delivered entirely in Spanish.
  - Questions (5 min) asked and answered in Spanish.
- Time Limit: 4 minutes (1 point deduction per second over).
- Scoring: Same categories as English Creed (Oral Communication, Non-Verbal, Q&A).
- Accuracy: -20 points per missed/added word.

KEY PARLIAMENTARY RULES (Gray's Guide):
1. Main Motion Rank: Lowest precedence.
2. Previous Question: Requires 2/3 vote, undebatable, unamendable.
3. Reconsider: Must be made by a member who voted on the prevailing side.
4. Lay on the Table: Temporarily delays action; undebatable, unamendable.
5. Point of Order: No second required, undebatable, may interrupt.

KEY TEXAS FARM FACTS (2025 Edition):
1. Cattle: Texas has 12.2 million head (#1), more than the human population of 43 states.
2. Cotton: Texas is the #1 cotton-producing state.
3. Rice: Texas is the 5th largest producer.
4. Citrus: Texas is 3rd largest producer (> $300 million impact).
5. Farmer Impact: One U.S. farm feeds 169 people annually.
`;

export type Division = 'greenhand' | 'senior';

export interface Motion {
  name: string;
  class: 'Privileged' | 'Subsidiary' | 'Main' | 'Incidental' | 'Motions That Bring a Question Again Before the Assembly';
  requiredIn: ('greenhand' | 'senior')[];
  description?: string;
}

export interface ParliamentaryQuestion {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  division: ('greenhand' | 'senior')[];
}

export const MOTIONS: Motion[] = [
  { name: 'Adjourn', class: 'Privileged', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Recess', class: 'Privileged', requiredIn: ['senior'] }, 
  { name: 'Raise a Question of Privilege', class: 'Privileged', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  { name: 'Call for the Orders of the Day', class: 'Privileged', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  
  { name: 'Lay on the Table', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Previous Question', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Limit or Extend Limits of Debate', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  { name: 'Postpone to a Certain Time (Definitely)', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Commit or Refer', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Amend', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Postpone Indefinitely', class: 'Subsidiary', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  
  { name: 'Main Motion', class: 'Main', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  
  { name: 'Appeal', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Division of the Assembly', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Division of a Question', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  { name: 'Object to the Consideration of a Question', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['senior'] },
  { name: 'Parliamentary Inquiry', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Point of Order', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Suspend the Standing Rules', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Withdraw a Motion', class: 'Incidental', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  
  { name: 'Reconsider', class: 'Motions That Bring a Question Again Before the Assembly', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Rescind', class: 'Motions That Bring a Question Again Before the Assembly', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Take from the Table', class: 'Motions That Bring a Question Again Before the Assembly', requiredIn: ['greenhand', 'senior'] },
  { name: 'Discharge a Committee', class: 'Motions That Bring a Question Again Before the Assembly', requiredIn: ['senior'] }
];

  "I believe in the future of agriculture, with a faith born not of words but of deeds - achievements won by the present and past generations of agriculturists; in the promise of better days through better ways, even as the better things we now enjoy have come to us from the struggles of former years.",
  "I believe that to live and work on a good farm, or to be engaged in other agricultural pursuits, is pleasant as well as challenging; for I know the joys and discomforts of agricultural life and hold an inborn fondness for those associations which, even in hours of discouragement, I cannot deny.",
  "I believe in leadership from ourselves and respect from others. I believe in my own ability to work efficiently and think clearly, with such knowledge and skill as I can secure, and in the ability of progressive agriculturists to serve our own and the public interest in producing and marketing the product of our toil.",
  "I believe in less dependence on begging and more power in bargaining; in the life abundant and enough honest wealth to help make it so--for others as well as myself; in less need for charity and more of it when needed; in being happy myself and playing square with those whose happiness depends upon me.",
  "I believe that American agriculture can and will hold true to the best traditions of our national life and that I can exert an influence in my home and community which will stand solid for my part in that inspiring task."
].join(" ");

<file path="lib/data/index.ts">
import { Contest, Question, PracticeSession, UserProgress } from '@/types';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { ALL_CONTESTS } from '@/constants/contests';
import { getLocalQuestions, getLocalQuestionCount, CONTESTS_WITH_QUESTIONS } from './questions';

// Track whether Supabase is available
let supabaseAvailable: boolean | null = null;

async function checkSupabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (supabaseAvailable !== null) return supabaseAvailable;
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('contests').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true });
    supabaseAvailable = !error;
  } catch {
    supabaseAvailable = false;
  }
  return supabaseAvailable;
}

export function isSupabaseAvailable(): boolean {
  return supabaseAvailable === true;
}

// ==========================================
// CONTESTS
// ==========================================

export async function getContests(category?: 'CDE' | 'LDE'): Promise<Contest[]> {
  const online = await checkSupabase();

  if (online) {
    try {
      let query = supabase.from('contests').select('*').eq('is_active', true).order('sort_order');
      if (category) query = query.eq('category', category);
      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return data || [];
    } catch {
      // Fall through to local data
    }
  }

  // Offline fallback
  let contests = ALL_CONTESTS.filter(c => c.is_active);
  if (category) contests = contests.filter(c => c.category === category);
  return contests.sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);
}

export async function getContest(id: string): Promise<Contest | null> {
  const online = await checkSupabase();

  if (online) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('contests').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to local data
    }
  }

  // Offline fallback
  return ALL_CONTESTS.find(c => c.id === id) || null;
}

// ==========================================
// QUESTIONS
// ==========================================

export async function getQuestions(contestId: string): Promise<Question[]> {
  const online = await checkSupabase();

  if (online) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('questions')
        .select('*')
        .eq('contest_id', contestId)
        .eq('is_active', true);
      if (error) throw error;
      if (data && data.length > 0) return data;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to local data
    }
  }

  // Offline fallback
  return getLocalQuestions(contestId);
}

export async function getQuestionCount(contestId: string): Promise<number> {
  const online = await checkSupabase();

  if (online) {
    try {
      const { count, error } = await supabase
        .from('questions')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
        .eq('contest_id', contestId)
        .eq('is_active', true);
      if (error) throw error;
      if (count !== null && count > 0) return count;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to local data
    }
  }

  // Offline fallback
  return getLocalQuestionCount(contestId);
}

export function hasQuestionsAvailable(contestId: string): boolean {
  return CONTESTS_WITH_QUESTIONS.includes(contestId);
}

// ==========================================
// PRACTICE SESSIONS
// ==========================================

export async function saveSession(session: Omit<PracticeSession, 'id'>): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!(await checkSupabase())) return null;

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('practice_sessions')
      .insert(session)
      .select('id')
      .single();
    if (error) throw error;
    return data?.id || null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Could not save session (offline mode):', err);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function saveResponses(responses: Array<{
  session_id: string;
  question_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  user_answer: string;
  is_correct: boolean;
  time_spent_seconds: number;
}>): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await checkSupabase())) return;

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('question_responses').insert(responses);
    if (error) throw error;
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Could not save responses (offline mode):', err);
  }
}

// ==========================================
// USER PROGRESS
// ==========================================

export async function getUserProgress(userId: string): Promise<UserProgress[]> {
  if (!(await checkSupabase())) return [];

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('user_progress')
      .select('*, contests(name)')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .order('last_practiced_at', { ascending: false });
    if (error) throw error;
    return (data || []).map((d: any) => ({
      ...d,
      contest_name: d.contests?.name || 'Unknown Contest',
    }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function updateProgress(
  userId: string,
  contestId: string,
  score: number,
  timeSeconds: number,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await checkSupabase())) return;

  try {
    // Check if progress record exists
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('user_progress')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .eq('contest_id', contestId)
      .single();

    if (existing) {
      const newAttempts = existing.total_attempts + 1;
      const newAvg = ((existing.average_score * existing.total_attempts) + score) / newAttempts;
      const newBest = Math.max(existing.best_score, score);
      const newTime = existing.total_time_seconds + timeSeconds;

      await supabase
        .from('user_progress')
        .update({
          total_attempts: newAttempts,
          average_score: Math.round(newAvg * 100) / 100,
          best_score: newBest,
          total_time_seconds: newTime,
          last_practiced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('contest_id', contestId);
    } else {
      await supabase.from('user_progress').insert({
        user_id: userId,
        contest_id: contestId,
        total_attempts: 1,
        best_score: score,
        average_score: score,
        total_time_seconds: timeSeconds,
        last_practiced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Could not update progress (offline mode):', err);
  }
}

// ==========================================
// USER STATS (for dashboard)
// ==========================================

export async function getUserStats(userId: string): Promise<{
  totalSessions: number;
  totalTime: number;
  contestsPracticed: number;
  averageScore: number;
}> {
  const defaultStats = { totalSessions: 0, totalTime: 0, contestsPracticed: 0, averageScore: 0 };

  if (!(await checkSupabase())) return defaultStats;

  try {
    const { data: sessions } = await supabase
      .from('practice_sessions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId);

    if (!sessions || sessions.length === 0) return defaultStats;

    const totalTime = sessions.reduce((sum: number, s: any) => sum + (s.time_spent_seconds || 0), 0);
    const scores = sessions.filter((s: any) => s.score != null).map((s: any) => s.score);
    const avgScore = scores.length > 0 ? scores.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / scores.length : 0;
    const uniqueContests = new Set(sessions.map((s: any) => s.contest_id)).size;

    return {
      totalSessions: sessions.length,
      totalTime: Math.round(totalTime / 60),
      contestsPracticed: uniqueContests,
      averageScore: Math.round(avgScore),
    };
  } catch {
    return defaultStats;
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/data/lde-rubrics.ts">
export interface RubricItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  weight: number;
  description?: string;
}

export interface RubricCategory {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  maxPoints: number;
  items: RubricItem[];
}

export interface LDERubric {
  contestId: string;
  contestName: string;
  categories: RubricCategory[];
  totalPoints: number;
  deductions?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    penalty: number;
    rule: string;
  }[];
}

export const LDE_RUBRICS: Record<string, LDERubric> = {
  'lde-creed': {

    contestName: 'Creed Speaking',
    totalPoints: 1000,
    categories: [
      {
        id: 'oral',

        maxPoints: 400,
        items: [
          { id: 'hesitation', name: 'Hesitation/Flow', weight: 125 },
          { id: 'pace', name: 'Pace', weight: 50 },
          { id: 'tone', name: 'Tone/Clarity', weight: 75 },
          { id: 'pronunciation', name: 'Pronunciation', weight: 75 },
          { id: 'volume', name: 'Volume/Projection', weight: 75 },

      {
        id: 'non_verbal',
        name: 'Non-Verbal Communication',
        maxPoints: 300,

    explanation: "The Santa Gertrudis was the first American breed of beef cattle, developed at the King Ranch from a Brahman and Shorthorn cross.",

    subcategory: "Breeds"
  },
  {

    explanation: "Angora goats are specifically raised for the production of mohair fiber.",
    difficulty: 2,
    subcategory: "Breeds"
  },

    options: [
      "Belgium",

    correct_answer: "Belgium",
    explanation: "The Pietrain breed, known for its muscle, originated in Belgium.",
    difficulty: 4,
    subcategory: "Breeds"
  },
  {

// Combined question bank with contest ID mapping
export const SAMPLE_QUESTIONS: Record<string, Question[]> = {
  'cde-agronomy': agronomyQuestions,
  'cde-livestock': livestockQuestions,
  'cde-vet-sci': vetScienceQuestions,
  'lde-sr-quiz': seniorQuizQuestions,
  'lde-gh-quiz': greenhandQuizQuestions,
  'lde-creed': [...creedQuestions, ...creedFlashcards],
  'lde-spanish-creed': SPANISH_CREED_QUESTIONS,
};

export function getLocalQuestions(contestId: string): Question[] {
  return SAMPLE_QUESTIONS[contestId] || [];
}

export function getLocalQuestionCount(contestId: string): number {
  return (SAMPLE_QUESTIONS[contestId] || []).length;
}

// Contest IDs that have sample questions available
export const CONTESTS_WITH_QUESTIONS = Object.keys(SAMPLE_QUESTIONS);

import { askOpenAI } from '@/lib/ai/openai';

export interface AgAdvocacyScore {
  creativity: number; // 150
  knowledge: number; // 150
  overallQuality: number; // 125
  expression: number; // 125
  organization: number; // 100
  responseToQuestions: number; // 200
  clarity: number; // 50
  interest: number; // 50
  participation: number; // 50
  totalScore: number; // 1000
  feedback: string;
  strengths: string[];
  improvements: string[];
}

export async function generateAgAdvocacyQuestions(topic: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const fallbackQuestions = [
    "How does your team propose we fund this advocacy initiative?",
    "What specific role can local FFA chapters play in your plan?",
    "How does this issue directly impact the average consumer's grocery bill?",
    "What is the biggest opposition to your viewpoint and how do you address it?",
    "How does technology integrate into the solution you presented?"
  ];

  try {
    const prompt = `
      Generate 5 challenging Q&A questions for an FFA Agricultural Advocacy team presenting on the topic: "${topic}".
      
      The questions should:
      1. Be open-ended and require critical thinking.
      2. Challenge the team to defend their position or elaborate on details.
      3. sound like they serve as a follow-up to a presentation.
      4. Be concise (1-2 sentences).
      
      Return ONLY the questions as a JSON array of strings.
    `;

    const response = await askOpenAI(prompt, 'json_object') as any;
    const content = response.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '[]';
    
    let parsed: any[] = [];
    try {
        const json = JSON.parse(content);
        parsed = Array.isArray(json) ? json : (json.questions || []);
    } catch {
        // Regex fallback
        parsed = content.match(/[?]/g) 
            ? content.split('\n').filter((l: string) => l.includes('?')).map((l: string) => l.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '').trim())
            : [];
    }

    if (parsed.length < 3) return fallbackQuestions;
    return parsed.slice(0, 5);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error generating Ag Advocacy questions:', error);
    return fallbackQuestions;
  }
}

export async function analyzeAgAdvocacy(transcript: string, questionsAsked: string[]): Promise<AgAdvocacyScore> {
  // 1. Sanity Check: If transcript is too short or empty, fail immediately.
  if (!transcript || transcript.trim().length < 50 || transcript.includes("[Simulated")) {
      return {
          creativity: 0, knowledge: 0, overallQuality: 0, expression: 0, organization: 0,
          responseToQuestions: 0, clarity: 0, interest: 0, participation: 0,
          totalScore: 0,
          feedback: "No audio detected or transcript was too short to analyze. Please ensure your microphone is working and you speak clearly.",
          strengths: [],
          improvements: ["Check microphone settings", "Speak louder and clearly"]
      };
  }

  const prompt = `
    You are an expert FFA Judge for the Agricultural Advocacy LDE.
    Your task is to score a presentation based on the official Texas FFA Rubric (1000 points).
    
    TRANSCRIPT:
    "${transcript}"
    
    QUESTIONS ASKED:
    ${questionsAsked.map((q, i) => `${i + 1}. ${q}`).join('\n')}
    
    RUBRIC GUIDELINES:
    - If the transcript is nonsense, irrelevant, or very short, give 0-10 points total.
    - Be STRICT. A perfect score (1000) is extremely rare. Average is 600-800.
    
    CATEGORIES:
    1. Creativity & Innovation (150 pts): Unique approach? Novel ideas?
    2. Ag Industry Knowledge (150 pts): Accurate facts? Depth of understanding?
    3. Overall Quality (125 pts): effective advocacy?
    4. Expression & Enthusiasm (125 pts): Convincing delivery?
    5. Organization (100 pts): Logical flow?
    6. Response to Questions (200 pts): Did they answer directly and effectively?
    7. Conciseness/Clarity (50 pts)
    8. Ability to Hold Interest (50 pts)
    9. Equal Participation (50 pts): (Assume full points if transcript shows multiple speakers, else deduct).
    
    OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON):
    {
      "creativity": number, "knowledge": number, "overallQuality": number,
      "expression": number, "organization": number, "responseToQuestions": number,
      "clarity": number, "interest": number, "participation": number,
      "feedback": "string", "strengths": ["string"], "improvements": ["string"]
    }
  `;

  try {
    const response = await askOpenAI(prompt, 'json_object') as any;
    const result = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content || '{}');
    
    const total = 
      (result.creativity || 0) + (result.knowledge || 0) + (result.overallQuality || 0) +
      (result.expression || 0) + (result.organization || 0) + (result.responseToQuestions || 0) +
      (result.clarity || 0) + (result.interest || 0) + (result.participation || 0);

    return {
      creativity: result.creativity || 0,
      knowledge: result.knowledge || 0,
      overallQuality: result.overallQuality || 0,
      expression: result.expression || 0,
      organization: result.organization || 0,
      responseToQuestions: result.responseToQuestions || 0,
      clarity: result.clarity || 0,
      interest: result.interest || 0,
      participation: result.participation || 0,
      totalScore: total,
      feedback: result.feedback || "Feedback generated.",
      strengths: result.strengths || [],
      improvements: result.improvements || []
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error scoring Ag Advocacy:", error);
    return {
      creativity: 0, knowledge: 0, overallQuality: 0, expression: 0,
      organization: 0, responseToQuestions: 0, clarity: 0, interest: 0, participation: 0,
      totalScore: 0,
      feedback: "AI Scoring failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.",
      strengths: [],
      improvements: ["Network Error - Could not grade"]
    };
  }
}
</file>
