<file path="lib/senior-quiz.ts">
import { GoogleGenerativeAI } from "@google/generative-ai";

const API_KEY = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY || "";
const genAI = API_KEY ? new GoogleGenerativeAI(API_KEY) : null;

export interface QuizQuestion {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  type: 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false';
  options?: string[]; // For MC
  correctAnswer: string; // "A", "B", "C", "D" or "True", "False"
  explanation: string;
  source: string; // e.g. "FFA Manual", "Parlia Guide"
}

export type QuizSource = string;

export interface QuizSettings {
  topics: QuizSource[];
  questionCount: number;
  type: 'mixed' | 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false';
  isMock: boolean;
}

// Constants
const NOTEBOOK_URL = "https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/c4e1c21c-30cd-463d-bbfa-46bc44945bc0";

/**
 * Robustly parse JSON from AI response, handling potential markdown fencing
 */
export function parseAIJson(text: string): any {
  try {
    const cleanJson = text.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
    return JSON.parse(cleanJson);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to parse AI JSON:", e);
    console.debug("Raw text:", text);
    throw new Error("Invalid AI response format");
  }
}

export async function generateQuizQuestions(settings: QuizSettings): Promise<QuizQuestion[]> {
  const isMockMode = settings.isMock;
  
  console.log(`Generating Quiz. Mode: ${isMockMode ? 'MOCK (Strict 150)' : 'CUSTOM'}, Count: ${settings.questionCount}`);
  
  if (isMockMode) {
    // MOCK MODE: Strict 15 T/F + 15 MC per source
    const sources = [
        { 
            name: "FFA Manual", 
            rules: "Questions from: Mission/Strategies, History, Tradition, Ceremonies, Chapter Ops (EXCLUDE Summary of Parliamentary Motions), Teacher Outreach, Programs/Platforms, Awards." 
        },
        { 
            name: "Parliamentary Guide", 
            rules: "Chapters 1-4, Misc pages 56-67. MOTIONS TO INCLUDE: Main Motion, Adjourn, Close Noms, Postpone Def, Reopen Noms, Lay on Table, Make Noms, Prev Question, Parli Inquiry, Commit, Withdraw, Amend, Take from Table, Point of Order, Discharge Comm, Appeal, Reconsider, Suspend Rules, Rescind, Division. EXCLUDE: Fix Time, Postpone Indef, Recess, Objection, Privilege, Division of Q, Limit/Extend Debate." 
        },
        { 
            name: "Leadership Guide", 
            rules: "2025-2026 District Officer Guide. EXCLUDE: Texas FFA Association Constitution and Bylaws sections." 
        },
        { 
            name: "Farm Facts", 
            rules: "2025 Texas Farm Facts publication." 
        },
        { 
            name: "Current Events", 
            rules: "2025 Ag Issues and Current Events Briefs (Max 10 pages)." 
        }
    ];

    try {
        console.log("Generating Mock Exam (150 Qs) - Batched Mode (OpenAI)...");
        
        // Helper to generate a specific batch
        const generateBatch = async (srcName: string, srcRules: string, type: 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false', count: number) => {
            const typeRules = type === 'multiple_choice' 
                ? `- ${count} Multiple Choice Questions (4 options: A, B, C, D)`
                : `- ${count} True/False Questions (Options: True, False)`;
            
            const jsonFormat = type === 'multiple_choice'
                ? `[{ "text": "...", "type": "multiple_choice", "options": ["Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3", "Option 4"], "correctAnswer": "Option 1", "explanation": "...", "source": "${srcName}" }]`
                : `[{ "text": "...", "type": "true_false", "options": ["True", "False"], "correctAnswer": "True", "explanation": "...", "source": "${srcName}" }]`;

            const prompt = `
                Generate exactly ${count} practice questions for the Texas FFA Senior Quiz (${srcName}).
                
                STRICT CONFIGURATION:
                ${typeRules}
                
                SOURCE MATERIAL: "${NOTEBOOK_URL}" (Pages 24-25 Rules)
                SPECIFIC RULES: ${srcRules}
                
                GENERAL RULES:
                - NO "All/None of the above".
                - Must be challenging.
                
                OUTPUT FORMAT:
                Return ONLY a strictly valid JSON array of objects. No conversational preamble or postscript.
                The "source" field MUST be EXACTLY "${srcName}".
                Format: ${jsonFormat}
            `;
            
            if (!genAI) throw new Error("GenUI not initialized");

            const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
                model: "gemini-flash-latest",
                generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" }
            });

            const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
            const questions = parseAIJson(result.response.text());

            try {
                if (questions.length !== count) {
                    console.warn(`${srcName} ${type} returned ${questions.length}/${count}`);
                }
                return questions;
            } catch (pErr) {
                console.error(`Error processing results for ${srcName} ${type}:`, pErr);
                throw pErr;
            }
        };

        const batches = sources.flatMap(src => [
            { src: src.name, rules: src.rules, type: 'multiple_choice' as const, count: 15 },
            { src: src.name, rules: src.rules, type: 'true_false' as const, count: 15 }
        ]);

        const allQuestions: any[] = [];
        
        // OpenAI Paid Tier: Can handle parallel requests much better.
        // Batch 5 at a time for speed.
        const CHUNK_SIZE = 5;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < batches.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
            const chunk = batches.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE);
            console.log(`Processing batch ${i/CHUNK_SIZE + 1}/${Math.ceil(batches.length/CHUNK_SIZE)}...`);
            
            const promises = chunk.map(b => generateBatch(b.src, b.rules, b.type, b.count));
            const results = await Promise.all(promises);
            results.forEach(r => allQuestions.push(...r));
            
            // Minimal wait
            if (i + CHUNK_SIZE < batches.length) {
                console.log("Waiting 2s...");
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
            }
        }
        
        console.log(`Mock Exam Generated. Total Questions: ${allQuestions.length}`);

        return allQuestions.flat().map((q: any, index: number) => ({
            ...q,
            id: `q-mock-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
            options: q.type === 'true_false' ? ['True', 'False'] : q.options,
        }));

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to generate mock exam:", error);
        throw new Error("Failed to generate full mock exam. Please try again.");
    }
  }

  // CUSTOM MODE (Simpler)
  const topicString = settings.topics.join(", ");
  const count = settings.questionCount;
  
  let typeInstruction = "";
  if (settings.type === 'mixed') {
    typeInstruction = "Mix of Multiple Choice and True/False questions.";
  } else if (settings.type === 'multiple_choice') {
    typeInstruction = "All Multiple Choice questions.";
  } else {
    typeInstruction = "All True/False questions.";
  }

  const prompt = `
    Generate ${count} distinct practice questions for the Texas FFA Senior Quiz contest.
    
    TOPICS TO COVER: ${topicString}
    FORMAT: ${typeInstruction}
    SOURCE MATERIAL: STRICTLY use the provided "${NOTEBOOK_URL}" notebook content.
    
    RULES:
    - Multiple Choice questions must have 4 options (A, B, C, D).
    - True/False questions must have options "True" and "False".
    - Questions must be challenging and specific to the official Texas FFA contest rules and source material for ${topicString}.
    - If the source material (manuals) doesn't directly cover a niche CDE/LDE specifically, generate high-quality foundational questions relevant to that general agricultural area (e.g. for "Agronomy," focus on soil/plant science facts found in the FFA manuals).
    - Uniformly distribute questions across the selected topics.
    - NO "All of the above" or "None of the above".

    OUTPUT FORMAT:
    Return a strictly valid JSON array of objects. Do not include markdown formatting (like '''json).
    [
      {
        "text": "Question text here...",
        "type": "multiple_choice" | "true_false",
        "options": ["Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3", "Option 4"] (Null/Empty for T/F),
        "correctAnswer": "The full string of the correct option" (or "True"/"False"),
        "explanation": "Brief explanation citing the specific source and page if possible.",
        "source": "Topic Name"
      }
    ]
  `;

  try {
    if (!genAI) throw new Error("GenUI not initialized");

    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
        model: "gemini-flash-latest",
        generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" }
    });

    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
    const questions = parseAIJson(result.response.text());
    
    // Add IDs and validate
    return questions.map((q: any, index: number) => ({
      ...q,
      id: `q-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
      options: q.type === 'true_false' ? ['True', 'False'] : q.options,
    }));

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Gemini Quiz Generation Error:", error);
    // Fallback to demo questions on error
    return MOCK_DEMO_QUESTIONS.map((q, idx) => ({
      ...q,
      id: `q-fallback-${Date.now()}-${idx}`
    })).slice(0, settings.questionCount);
  }
}

// Fallback questions for Demo Mode
const MOCK_DEMO_QUESTIONS: QuizQuestion[] = [
    {
        id: 'demo-1',
        text: "What year was the FFA founded?",
        type: "multiple_choice",
        options: ["1928", "1917", "1930", "1969"],
        correctAnswer: "1928",
        explanation: "The Future Farmers of America was founded in 1928 in Kansas City, Mo.",
        source: "FFA Manual"
    },
    {

    },
    {
        id: 'demo-3',

        type: "multiple_choice",
        options: ["Secretary", "Treasurer", "Sentinel", "Reporter"],
        correctAnswer: "Secretary",
        explanation: "The Secretary is stationed by the ear of corn.",
        source: "District Officer Guide"
    },
     {
        id: 'demo-4',

        type: "true_false",
        options: ["True", "False"],
        correctAnswer: "False",
        explanation: "Adjourn requires a majority vote.",

    },
    {

export async function generateStudyGuide(topic: QuizSource): Promise<string> {
    const prompt = `
      Create a comprehensive study guide summary for the topic: "${topic}" 
      based on the "Texas FFA Sr Quiz Materials" notebook (${NOTEBOOK_URL}).
      
      Focus on key facts, dates, numbers, and lists that are likely to appear on the Senior Quiz (150 question exam).
      Format with clear headings and bullet points using Markdown.
    `;
  
    try {
      if (!genAI) throw new Error("GenUI not initialized");

      const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ model: "gemini-flash-latest" });
      const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
      return result.response.text();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to generate study guide:", error);
      return "## Error\nCould not generate study guide at this time.";
    }
}

<file path="lib/supabase.ts">
import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!;

const ExpoStorageAdapter = {
  getItem: (key: string) => {
    try {
      return AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
  },
  setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
    try {
      return AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
  },
  removeItem: (key: string) => {
    try {
      return AsyncStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
  },
};

export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: ExpoStorageAdapter,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    detectSessionInUrl: false,
  },
});
</file>

<file path="scripts/convert-livestock-csv.ts">
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { parse } from 'csv-parse/sync';

const CSV_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), 'assets/documents/Texas Livestock CDE Questions.csv');
const OUTPUT_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), 'lib/data/imported-livestock.ts');

const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(CSV_PATH, 'utf-8');

const records = parse(fileContent, {
  columns: true,
  skip_empty_lines: true,
  trim: true,
});

const questions = records.map((record: any, index: number) => {
  return {
    id: `livestock-2025-${index + 1}`,
    contest_id: 'cde-livestock',
    question_text: record['Cdequestion'],
    question_type: 'multiple_choice',
    options: [
      record['answer_option_a'],
      record['answer_option_b'],
      record['answer_option_c'],
      record['answer_option_d'],
    ].filter(Boolean),
    correct_answer: record['Answer Correct'],
    explanation: `${record['Category']} - ${record['CDE event type']}`,
    difficulty: 'intermediate',
    subcategory: record['Category'] || 'General',
    image_url: undefined,
    is_active: true,
  };
});

const fileOutput = `import { Question } from '../../types';

export const IMPORTED_LIVESTOCK_QUESTIONS: Question[] = ${JSON.stringify(questions, null, 2)};
`;

fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_PATH, fileOutput);

console.log(`Successfully converted ${questions.length} questions to ${OUTPUT_PATH}`);
</file>

<file path="scripts/run-scoring-tests.js">
/**
 * Direct test runner for scoring logic (no jest overhead)
 */
const path = require('path');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

// Resolve @/ path aliases before any other require
const Module = require('module');
const originalResolve = Module._resolveFilename;
Module._resolveFilename = function(request, parent, isMain, options) {
  if (request.startsWith('@/')) {
    request = path.join(ROOT, request.slice(2));
  }
  return originalResolve.call(this, request, parent, isMain, options);
};

require('@babel/register')({
  configFile: false,
  presets: [
    ['@babel/preset-env', { targets: { node: 'current' } }],
    '@babel/preset-typescript',
  ],
  extensions: ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx'],
});

// Simple test framework
let passed = 0, failed = 0;

function test(name, fn) {
  try {
    fn();
    console.log(`  PASS  ${name}`);
    passed++;
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`  FAIL  ${name}: ${e.message}`);
    failed++;
  }
}

function expect(val) {
  return {
    toBe(expected) {
      if (val !== expected) throw new Error(`Expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(val)}`);
    },
    toContain(item) {
      if (!val.includes(item)) throw new Error(`Expected array/string to contain "${item}"`);
    },
    toHaveLength(len) {
      if (val.length !== len) throw new Error(`Expected length ${len}, got ${val.length}`);
    },
    toBeGreaterThan(n) {
      if (!(val > n)) throw new Error(`Expected ${val} > ${n}`);
    },
    toBeLessThan(n) {
      if (!(val < n)) throw new Error(`Expected ${val} < ${n}`);
    },
  };
}

function describe(suiteName, fn) {
  console.log(`\n${suiteName}`);
  fn();
}

// --- English Creed Scoring ---
const { calculateAccuracy, FFA_CREED } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/scoring/creed'));

describe('calculateAccuracy (English Creed)', () => {
  test('returns 100% for perfect paragraph match', () => {
    const r = calculateAccuracy(FFA_CREED.paragraphs[0], 0);
    expect(r.score).toBe(100);
    expect(r.missedWords).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(r.extraWords).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test('detects missing word "agriculture"', () => {
    const input = "I believe in the future of, with a faith born not of words but of deeds";
    const r = calculateAccuracy(input, 0);
    expect(r.missedWords).toContain('agriculture');
    expect(r.missedWords.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test('detects substitution: agriculture -> farming', () => {
    const input = FFA_CREED.fullText.replace('agriculture', 'farming');
    const r = calculateAccuracy(input);
    expect(r.missedWords).toContain('agriculture');
    expect(r.extraWords).toContain('farming');
  });

  test('full text scores 100%', () => {
    const r = calculateAccuracy(FFA_CREED.fullText);
    expect(r.score).toBe(100);
  });
});

// --- Spanish Creed Scoring ---
const { calculateSpanishAccuracy, FFA_CREED_SPANISH } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/scoring/spanish-creed'));

describe('calculateSpanishAccuracy (Spanish Creed)', () => {
  test('returns 100% for perfect paragraph match', () => {
    const r = calculateSpanishAccuracy(FFA_CREED_SPANISH.paragraphs[0], 0);
    expect(r.score).toBe(100);
    expect(r.missedWords).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test('detects missing word "agricultura"', () => {
    const input = "Creo en el porvenir de la con una fe que no surge de las palabras";
    const r = calculateSpanishAccuracy(input, 0);
    expect(r.missedWords).toContain('agricultura');
  });

  test('detects substitution: agricultura -> farming', () => {
    const input = FFA_CREED_SPANISH.fullText.replace('agricultura', 'farming');
    const r = calculateSpanishAccuracy(input);
    expect(r.missedWords).toContain('agricultura');
    expect(r.extraWords).toContain('farming');
  });

  test('accented characters match correctly (paragraph 2)', () => {
    const r = calculateSpanishAccuracy(FFA_CREED_SPANISH.paragraphs[1], 1);
    expect(r.score).toBe(100);
  });

  test('returns <10% for unrelated English text', () => {
    const r = calculateSpanishAccuracy("This is completely unrelated English text with no Spanish words", 0);
    expect(r.score).toBeLessThan(10);
  });
});

// --- Summary ---
const line = '─'.repeat(40);
console.log(`\n${line}`);
const status = failed > 0 ? 'FAILED' : 'PASSED';
console.log(`${status}: ${passed}/${passed + failed} tests passed`);
if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);
</file>

<file path="scripts/stress-test-ai.ts">
const { GoogleGenerativeAI } = require("@google/generative-ai");

// MOCKED DATA FOR TEST
const LDE_RUBRICS = {
  'lde-advocacy': {
    contestId: 'lde-advocacy',
    contestName: 'Agricultural Advocacy',
    totalPoints: 1000,
    categories: [
      {
        id: 'delivery',
        name: 'Presentation Delivery',
        maxPoints: 800,
        items: [
          { id: 'clarity', name: 'Conciseness/Clarity', weight: 50 },
          { id: 'organization', name: 'Organization', weight: 100 },
          { id: 'interest', name: 'Hold Audience Interest', weight: 50 },
          { id: 'creativity', name: 'Innovativeness/Creativity', weight: 150 },
          { id: 'fluency', name: 'Power of Expression/Fluency', weight: 125 },
          { id: 'participation', name: 'Equal Participation', weight: 50 },
          { id: 'quality', name: 'Overall Quality/Effectiveness', weight: 125 },
          { id: 'industry_knowledge', name: 'Industry Knowledge/Depth', weight: 100 },
        ]
      },
      {
        id: 'knowledge',
        name: 'Response to Questions',
        maxPoints: 200,
        items: [
          { id: 'qa', name: 'Response to Questions', weight: 200 },
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
};

const API_KEY = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY || "";
const genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(API_KEY);

async function gradeLDEContest(transcription, rubric) {
  const rubricDescription = rubric.categories.map((cat) => {
    const items = cat.items.map((item) => `- ${item.name} (${item.weight} pts)`).join('\n');
    return `### ${cat.name} (Max ${cat.maxPoints} pts)\n${items}`;
  }).join('\n\n');

  const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
    model: "gemini-flash-latest",
    generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" },
    systemInstruction: `ROLE: Expert Texas FFA LDE Judge for ${rubric.contestName}. Grade transcript strictly against rubric.`
  });

  const prompt = `
    PERFORMANCE TRANSCRIPT: "${transcription}"
    RUBRIC: ${rubricDescription}
    RETURN JSON: { "scores": { "category_id": { "item_id": 1-5 } }, "feedback": string[], "sentiment": string }
  `;

  const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
  const data = JSON.parse(result.response.text());

  let totalScore = 0;
  rubric.categories.forEach((cat) => {
    cat.items.forEach((item) => {
      const score1to5 = data.scores[cat.id]?.[item.id] || 3;
      totalScore += (score1to5 / 5) * item.weight;
    });
  });

  return { totalScore: Math.round(totalScore) };
}

async function runTest() {
  console.log('--- STARTING AI LATENCY BENCHMARK ---');
  const rubric = LDE_RUBRICS['lde-advocacy'];
  const transcript = "Howdy judges! Today I am here to advocate for the Texas agricultural industry...";

  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    const start = Date.now();
    try {
      console.log(`Run ${i}: Requesting Gemini...`);
      await gradeLDEContest(transcript, rubric);
      console.log(`Run ${i}: SUCCESS | Time: ${Date.now() - start}ms`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(`Run ${i}: FAILED | Time: ${Date.now() - start}ms | Error: ${e.message}`);
    }
  }
  console.log('--- BENCHMARK COMPLETE ---');
}

runTest();
</file>

const p1Target = FFA_CREED.paragraphs[0];
console.log('Target Text (P1):', p1Target.substring(0, 50) + '...');

// Case 1: Perfect Match
const perfectScore = calculateAccuracy(p1Target, 0);
console.log(`\nPerfect Match Score: ${perfectScore.score}% (Expected: 100)`);
console.log(`Missed Words: ${perfectScore.missedWords.length}`);

// Case 2: Minor Errors (missing "faith", "deeds")
const minorErrorText = p1Target.replace('faith', '').replace('deeds', '');
const minorScore = calculateAccuracy(minorErrorText, 0);
console.log(`\nMinor Error Score: ${minorScore.score}%`);
console.log(`Missed Words: ${minorScore.missedWords.join(', ')}`);

// Case 3: Major Errors (Half text)
const halfText = p1Target.substring(0, p1Target.length / 2);
const halfScore = calculateAccuracy(halfText, 0);
console.log(`\nHalf Text Score: ${halfScore.score}%`);

// Case 4: Full Creed vs Single Paragraph (The bug I thought I fixed)
const singleParaVsFull = calculateAccuracy(p1Target, undefined); // undefined = full text
console.log(`\nSingle Paragraph vs Full Creed Score: ${singleParaVsFull.score}% (Expected: Low ~20%)`);

console.log('\n--- Testing Spanish Creed Scoring ---');

const spP1Target = FFA_CREED_SPANISH.paragraphs[0];

// Case 5: Spanish Perfect Match
const spPerfectScore = calculateSpanishAccuracy(spP1Target, 0);
console.log(`\nSpanish Perfect Score: ${spPerfectScore.score}% (Expected: 100)`);

// Case 6: Spanish Punctuation Check
// Simulate transcription with different quotes/dashes
const spPunctuationText = spP1Target.replace('—', '-').replace(';', ',');
const spPunctScore = calculateSpanishAccuracy(spPunctuationText, 0);
console.log(`\nSpanish Punctuation Robustness: ${spPunctScore.score}% (Expected: 100)`);
if (spPunctScore.score < 100) {
    console.log('Missed:', spPunctScore.missedWords);
    console.log('Extra:', spPunctScore.extraWords);
}

const { GoogleGenerativeAI } = require("@google/generative-ai");
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// 1. Setup Env
const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env');
const envConfig = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
const match = envConfig.match(/EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY=(.*)/);

if (!match || !match[1]) {
  console.error("❌ No EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY found.");
  process.exit(1);
}
const apiKey = match[1].trim();

// 2. Setup Gemini
const genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(apiKey);
const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
    model: "gemini-flash-latest",
    systemInstruction: `
      ROLE & PERSONA:
      You are the AntiGravity Orchestrator, managing the "Ag Coach Pro" swarm for Texas FFA. 
      Your purpose is to autonomously bridge deep research (NotebookLM style) with agentic action.
      
      TASK:
      Analyze the provided document/image against the specific rubric provided in the context.
      Be extremely strict with "Format" and "Grammar" points as per the rubric.
      
      TONE:
      Constructive, professional, strict but helpful.
    `
});

// 3. Mock Data (1x1 Red Pixel JPEG)
const base64Image = "/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD/2wBDAP//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////wgALCAABAAEBAREA/8QAFBABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAP/aAAgBAQABPxA=";
const mimeType = "image/jpeg";

const RUBRIC = `
OFFICIAL FFA JOB INTERVIEW RUBRIC - RESUME (200 Points Total)
1. Contact Info (10 pts): Name prominent, address, email, phone.
2. Employment Objective (10 pts): Focused on company goals.
3. Education (35 pts): Reverse chronological, courses, GPA.
4. Experience (45 pts): Action verbs, Quantified results.
5. Achievements (25 pts): Relevant honors.
6. References (10 pts): 3 references with details.
7. Grammar/Spelling (25 pts): <2 errors for max points.
8. Format (40 pts): Max 2 pages, professional layout.
`;

// 4. Test Function
async function testDocumentScoring() {
    console.log("📄 Testing Document Scoring...");
    
    try {
        const prompt = `
            CONTEXT (RUBRIC):
            ${RUBRIC}
            
            TASK:
            Grade this resume based on the rubric. Check specifically for formatting and grammar errors.
            Note: This is a test image (1x1 pixel), so just acknowledge it's a test and give a mock score based on 'Format'.
        `;

        const result = await model.generateContent([
            prompt,
            {
                inlineData: {
                    data: base64Image,
                    mimeType: mimeType
                }
            }
        ]);

        const text = result.response.text();
        console.log("✅ Response Received:");
        console.log(text);

        // Verify JSON parse-ability (since app expects JSON)
        try {
             // Clean up markdown code blocks if present
            const cleanJson = text.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
            const json = JSON.parse(cleanJson);
            console.log("\n✅ JSON Parsed Successfully:");
            console.log(json);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("\n⚠️ Response was not valid JSON (App might fail parsing):");
            console.warn(e.message);
        }

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("❌ Test Failed:", error);
    }
}

testDocumentScoring();

    if (!process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2) {
        console.error("ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2 is missing. Please ensure it is in your .env file.");
    }

    const startTime = Date.now();

    try {
        const settings = {
            topics: [], // Mock mode ignores this
            questionCount: 100,
            type: 'mixed' as const, // mocking mixed
            isMock: true
        };
        
        console.log(`Settings: ${JSON.stringify(settings, null, 2)}`);

        const questions = await generateGreenhandQuiz(settings);

        const duration = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
        console.log(`\nGeneration Complete in ${duration.toFixed(2)}s`);
        console.log(`Total Questions Generated: ${questions.length}`);

        // Verify counts
        if (questions.length === 100) {
            console.log("✅ SUCCESS: Count is 100.");
        } else {
            console.error(`❌ FAILURE: Expected 100, got ${questions.length}`);
        }

        // Breakdown by Source
        const sources = questions.reduce((acc: any, q) => {
            acc[q.source] = (acc[q.source] || 0) + 1;
            return acc;
        }, {});

        console.log("\n--- Source Breakdown ---");
        // Manual (17+17=34), Parli (17+17=34), Leadership (16+16=32)
        const expected: any = { "FFA Manual": 34, "Parliamentary Guide": 34, "Leadership Guide": 32 };

        Object.entries(sources).forEach(([src, count]) => {
            if (expected[src] === count) {
                console.log(`✅ ${src}: ${count} (Expected ${expected[src]})`);
            } else {
                console.log(`⚠️ ${src}: ${count} (Expected ${expected[src]})`);
            }
        });

        // Breakdown by Type
        const types = questions.reduce((acc: any, q) => {
            const key = `${q.source} (${q.type === 'multiple_choice' ? 'MC' : 'T/F'})`;
            acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + 1;
            return acc;
        }, {});

        console.log("\n--- Type Breakdown (Expected 15 each) ---");
        Object.entries(types).sort().forEach(([key, count]) => {
            console.log(`${count === 15 ? '✅' : '⚠️'} ${key}: ${count}`);
        });

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Test Failed:", error);
    }
}

testGreenhandMockExam();

const { GoogleGenerativeAI } = require("@google/generative-ai");
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// Mock Rubric (Shortened for test, but structurally identical)
const PERSONAL_INTERVIEW_RUBRIC = `
OFFICIAL FFA JOB INTERVIEW RUBRIC - PERSONAL INTERVIEW (500 Points Total)
1. First Impressions (50 pts): Analysis of confidence.
2. Knowledge of Job/Industry (50 pts): Understanding of role.
3. Response to Questions (100 pts): Content, depth, examples (STAR method).
4. Communication Skills (50 pts): Grammar, vocabulary.
5. Poise and Presence (50 pts): Confidence.
6. General Effect (100 pts): Overall fit.
`;

async function testScoring() {
  try {
    // 1. Read .env
    const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env');
    const envConfig = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
    const match = envConfig.match(/EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY=(.*)/);
    
    if (!match || !match[1]) {
      console.error("❌ No EXPO_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY found.");
      return;
    }
    const apiKey = match[1].trim();

    // 2. Initialize Gemini
    const genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(apiKey);
    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({ 
        model: "gemini-flash-latest",
        generationConfig: { responseMimeType: "application/json" }
    });

    console.log("🧠 Sending Interview Simulation to Gemini...");

    // 3. Construct Prompt (Identical to app logic)
    const questionText = "What do you consider to be your greatest strength?";
    const transcript = "My greatest strength is my ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people. For example, in my chapter, I organized a community garden project where I had to coordinate between students, teachers, and local business owners. This required clear communication and adaptability.";

    const prompt = `
      You are an expert FFA Judge evaluating a Job Interview CDE participant.
      
      RUBRIC TO USE:
      ${PERSONAL_INTERVIEW_RUBRIC}

      TASK:
      Score the student's response to the question: "${questionText}"
      based ONLY on the audio transcript provided below.
      
      TRANSCRIPT:
      "${transcript}"
      
      OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON only):
      {
        "score": number (0-100, representing the quality of this specific answer),
        "feedback": "string (constructive feedback using judging terminology)",
        "strengths": ["string", "string"],
        "improvements": ["string", "string"]
      }
    `;

    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
    const response = await result.response;
    const text = response.text();

    console.log("✅ API Response Received:");
    console.log(text);

    // 4. Verify JSON Parsing
    const data = JSON.parse(text);
    if (data.score && data.feedback) {
        console.log("\n✅ SCORING VERIFIED!");
        console.log(`Score: ${data.score}/100`);
        console.log(`Feedback: ${data.feedback}`);
    } else {
        console.error("❌ JSON structure invalid.");
    }

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Scoring Test Failed:", error.message);
  }
}

testScoring();

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// Manually load .env since dotenv might not be installed
try {
    const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env');
    if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
        const envConfig = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
        envConfig.split('\n').forEach((line: string) => {
            const match = line.match(/^([^=]+)=(.*)$/);
            if (match) {
                const key = match[1].trim();
                const value = match[2].trim().replace(/^['"](.*)['"]$/, '$1'); // Remove quotes
                if (!process.env[key]) {
                    process.env[key] = value;
                }
            }
        });
        console.log("Loaded .env file");
    } else {
        console.warn(".env file not found at " + envPath);
    }
} catch (e) {
    console.warn("Could not load .env file:", e);
}

// Check for API Key
if (!process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2) {
    console.error("ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_KEY_V2 is missing. Please ensure it is in your .env file.");

}

<file path="scripts/verify-rubrics.ts">
import { LDE_RUBRICS } from '../lib/data/lde-rubrics';

function verifyRubrics() {
  console.log('--- LDE Rubric Verification ---');
  let errors = 0;

  Object.values(LDE_RUBRICS).forEach(rubric => {
    let calculatedTotal = 0;
    rubric.categories.forEach(cat => {
      let catTotal = 0;
      cat.items.forEach(item => {
        catTotal += item.weight;
      });
      
      console.log(`[${rubric.contestId}] Category: ${cat.name} -> Items Total: ${catTotal} / Max: ${cat.maxPoints}`);
      if (catTotal !== cat.maxPoints) {
        console.error(`  ERROR: Category total mismatch! calc: ${catTotal}, expected: ${cat.maxPoints}`);
        errors++;
      }
      calculatedTotal += catTotal;
    });

    console.log(`[${rubric.contestId}] Calculated Total: ${calculatedTotal} / Expected: ${rubric.totalPoints}`);
    if (calculatedTotal !== rubric.totalPoints) {
      console.error(`  ERROR: Total points mismatch! calc: ${calculatedTotal}, expected: ${rubric.totalPoints}`);
      errors++;
    }
    console.log('-----------------------------');
  });

  if (errors === 0) {
    console.log('SUCCESS: All rubrics verified correctly.');
  } else {
    console.warn(`FAILED: ${errors} errors found in rubrics.`);
  }
}

verifyRubrics();
</file>

<file path="scripts/whisper-proxy.js">
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Simple CORS proxy server for OpenAI Whisper API
 * Run this alongside your Expo dev server
 * Usage: node scripts/whisper-proxy.js
 */

const http = require('http');
const https = require('https');

const PORT = 3001;
const OPENAI_API_URL = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions';

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  // CORS headers
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'POST, OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type, Authorization');

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204);
    res.end();
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/transcribe') {
    console.log(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] Received POST /transcribe`);
    
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));
    req.on('end', () => {
      const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
      console.log(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] Body received. Size: ${body.length} bytes`);
      
      const url = new URL(OPENAI_API_URL);
      const options = {
        hostname: url.hostname,
        path: url.pathname,
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': req.headers['authorization'],
          'Content-Type': req.headers['content-type'],
          'Content-Length': body.length
        }
      };

      const proxyReq = https.request(options, (proxyRes) => {
        console.log(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] OpenAI response: ${proxyRes.statusCode}`);
        res.writeHead(proxyRes.statusCode, proxyRes.headers);
        proxyRes.pipe(res);
      });

      proxyReq.on('error', (e) => {
        console.error(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] Proxy error:`, e);
        res.writeHead(500);
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }));
      });

      proxyReq.write(body);
      proxyReq.end();
    });
  } else {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: 'Whisper proxy server running', endpoint: 'POST /transcribe' }));
  }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`🎤 Whisper proxy server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`   POST /transcribe -> forwards to OpenAI Whisper API`);
});
</file>

<file path="supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql">
-- ============================================
-- FFA Training App - Complete Database Schema
-- ============================================

-- Enable UUID extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- ============================================
-- 1. SCHOOLS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schools (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  city TEXT,
  district TEXT,
  area TEXT,
  region TEXT,
  state TEXT DEFAULT 'TX',
  advisor_name TEXT,
  advisor_email TEXT,
  subscription_status TEXT DEFAULT 'inactive' CHECK (subscription_status IN ('active', 'inactive', 'trial', 'expired')),
  subscription_tier TEXT DEFAULT 'starter' CHECK (subscription_tier IN ('starter', 'professional', 'enterprise')),
  max_students INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 2. USERS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT DEFAULT 'student' CHECK (role IN ('student', 'teacher', 'admin')),
  school_id UUID REFERENCES schools(id),
  grade_level INTEGER,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  total_practice_time INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  total_sessions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 3. CONTESTS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contests (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('CDE', 'LDE')),
  description TEXT,
  time_limit_minutes INTEGER,
  team_size INTEGER DEFAULT 4,
  has_quiz BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  has_video BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  has_practicum BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  icon TEXT,
  difficulty_level INTEGER DEFAULT 3 CHECK (difficulty_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 4. QUESTIONS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  contest_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_type TEXT DEFAULT 'multiple_choice' CHECK (question_type IN ('multiple_choice', 'true_false', 'fill_blank', 'matching', 'image_id', 'scenario')),
  options JSONB,
  correct_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  explanation TEXT,
  difficulty INTEGER DEFAULT 3 CHECK (difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  subcategory TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 5. PRACTICE SESSIONS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS practice_sessions (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contest_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contests(id),
  session_type TEXT DEFAULT 'practice' CHECK (session_type IN ('practice', 'test', 'flashcard', 'video')),
  score NUMERIC(5,2),
  total_questions INTEGER,
  correct_answers INTEGER,
  time_spent_seconds INTEGER,
  completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- ============================================
-- 6. QUESTION RESPONSES TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS question_responses (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_answer TEXT,
  is_correct BOOLEAN,
  time_spent_seconds INTEGER,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 7. VIDEO SUBMISSIONS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS video_submissions (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contest_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contests(id),
  session_id UUID REFERENCES practice_sessions(id),
  video_url TEXT,
  audio_url TEXT,
  transcription TEXT,
  accuracy_score NUMERIC(5,2),
  delivery_score NUMERIC(5,2),
  body_language_score NUMERIC(5,2),
  overall_score NUMERIC(5,2),
  ai_feedback JSONB,
  scoring_details JSONB,
  duration_seconds INTEGER,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'scored', 'error')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- 8. USER PROGRESS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_progress (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contest_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES contests(id),
  mastery_level NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_score NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
  average_score NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_time_seconds INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_practiced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  streak_days INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  weak_areas JSONB,
  strong_areas JSONB,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(user_id, contest_id)
);

-- ============================================
-- 9. SUBSCRIPTIONS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (
  id UUID DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() PRIMARY KEY,
  school_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES schools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan TEXT DEFAULT 'professional' CHECK (plan IN ('starter', 'professional', 'enterprise')),
  price_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 45000,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'trialing')),
  stripe_customer_id TEXT,
  stripe_subscription_id TEXT,
  current_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ,
  current_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================
-- INDEXES
-- ============================================
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_school ON users(school_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_role ON users(role);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_questions_contest ON questions(contest_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_questions_difficulty ON questions(difficulty);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_practice_sessions_user ON practice_sessions(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_practice_sessions_contest ON practice_sessions(contest_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_question_responses_session ON question_responses(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_question_responses_user ON question_responses(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_video_submissions_user ON video_submissions(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_progress_user ON user_progress(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_progress_contest ON user_progress(contest_id);

-- ============================================
-- ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS)
-- ============================================
ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE schools ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE contests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE questions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE practice_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE question_responses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE video_submissions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE user_progress ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE subscriptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Users can read their own data
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile" ON users FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON users FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own profile" ON users FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);

-- Everyone can read contests and questions
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view contests" ON contests FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view questions" ON questions FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- Users manage their own practice data
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own sessions" ON practice_sessions FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can create sessions" ON practice_sessions FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own sessions" ON practice_sessions FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can view own responses" ON question_responses FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can create responses" ON question_responses FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can view own videos" ON video_submissions FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can upload videos" ON video_submissions FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own videos" ON video_submissions FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can view own progress" ON user_progress FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own progress" ON user_progress FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can modify own progress" ON user_progress FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Schools visible to members
CREATE POLICY "School members can view school" ON schools FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- Subscriptions visible to school admins
CREATE POLICY "View subscriptions" ON subscriptions FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'What is the optimal soil pH range for most crop production?', 'multiple_choice', '["4.0 - 5.0", "6.0 - 7.0", "7.5 - 8.5", "8.5 - 9.5"]', '6.0 - 7.0', 'Most crops thrive in slightly acidic to neutral soil with a pH between 6.0 and 7.0.', 2, 'Soil Science'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'Which soil texture has the highest water-holding capacity?', 'multiple_choice', '["Sandy", "Clay", "Loamy sand", "Gravel"]', 'Clay', 'Clay particles are the smallest and have the greatest surface area, giving clay soils the highest water-holding capacity.', 2, 'Soil Science'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'What are the three primary macronutrients needed by plants?', 'multiple_choice', '["Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium", "Calcium, Magnesium, Sulfur", "Iron, Zinc, Boron", "Carbon, Hydrogen, Oxygen"]', 'Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium', 'N-P-K are the three primary macronutrients shown on fertilizer bags.', 1, 'Plant Nutrition'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'Nitrogen deficiency in plants typically causes yellowing of which leaves first?', 'multiple_choice', '["Newest leaves", "Oldest (lower) leaves", "Middle leaves", "All leaves equally"]', 'Oldest (lower) leaves', 'Nitrogen is mobile, so plants move it from older to newer growth when deficient.', 3, 'Plant Nutrition'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'What does the K in N-P-K fertilizer stand for?', 'multiple_choice', '["Krypton", "Potassium", "Kalcium", "Kelp"]', 'Potassium', 'K is the chemical symbol for Potassium from the Latin kalium.', 1, 'Plant Nutrition'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'Which type of soil erosion is caused by water flowing in small channels?', 'multiple_choice', '["Sheet erosion", "Rill erosion", "Gully erosion", "Wind erosion"]', 'Rill erosion', 'Rill erosion occurs when water concentrates into small channels.', 3, 'Soil Conservation'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'What is the primary purpose of crop rotation?', 'multiple_choice', '["Increase seed variety", "Break pest and disease cycles", "Reduce labor costs", "Improve appearance"]', 'Break pest and disease cycles', 'Crop rotation disrupts pest cycles and can improve soil health.', 2, 'Crop Management'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'Which soil horizon is commonly known as topsoil?', 'multiple_choice', '["O horizon", "A horizon", "B horizon", "C horizon"]', 'A horizon', 'The A horizon is the topsoil layer containing most organic matter and biological activity.', 2, 'Soil Science'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'What is the ideal soil composition by volume for plant growth?', 'multiple_choice', '["50% minerals, 25% water, 25% air", "45% minerals, 25% water, 25% air, 5% organic matter", "70% minerals, 20% water, 10% air", "33% each minerals, water, air"]', '45% minerals, 25% water, 25% air, 5% organic matter', 'Ideal soil is roughly 45% minerals, 25% water, 25% air, and 5% organic matter.', 3, 'Soil Science'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Agronomy'), 'Which nutrient is most responsible for root development?', 'multiple_choice', '["Nitrogen", "Phosphorus", "Potassium", "Calcium"]', 'Phosphorus', 'Phosphorus promotes root growth, flowering, and seed development.', 2, 'Plant Nutrition');

-- ============================================

((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'What is the gestation period for cattle?', 'multiple_choice', '["114 days", "150 days", "283 days", "340 days"]', '283 days', 'Cattle have a gestation period of approximately 283 days (about 9.5 months).', 2, 'Cattle'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'Which breed of cattle is known as the oldest in the United States?', 'multiple_choice', '["Angus", "Hereford", "Longhorn", "Brahman"]', 'Longhorn', 'Texas Longhorns are among the oldest breeds in the US, descended from Spanish cattle.', 2, 'Cattle Breeds'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'What is the ideal body condition score for a beef cow at calving?', 'multiple_choice', '["3", "5", "7", "9"]', '5', 'A BCS of 5 to 6 is ideal at calving for optimal reproductive performance.', 3, 'Cattle Management'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'Which cut of beef comes from the loin section?', 'multiple_choice', '["Brisket", "Chuck roast", "T-bone steak", "Shank"]', 'T-bone steak', 'T-bone steaks are cut from the short loin section of the beef carcass.', 2, 'Meat Science'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'What does EPD stand for in cattle breeding?', 'multiple_choice', '["Expected Progeny Difference", "Estimated Production Data", "Early Performance Development", "Environmental Protection Division"]', 'Expected Progeny Difference', 'EPDs predict the expected difference in offspring performance.', 3, 'Genetics'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'What is the normal body temperature of cattle?', 'multiple_choice', '["99.5F", "101.5F", "103.5F", "105.5F"]', '101.5F', 'Normal cattle body temperature is approximately 101.5F.', 2, 'Animal Health'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'Which part of a sheep is evaluated first in judging?', 'multiple_choice', '["Legs", "Loin", "Shoulder", "Overall balance and structure"]', 'Overall balance and structure', 'Judges first evaluate the overall balance and structural correctness.', 3, 'Sheep'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'What is the gestation period for swine?', 'multiple_choice', '["63 days", "114 days", "150 days", "283 days"]', '114 days', 'Swine have a gestation period of 3 months, 3 weeks, and 3 days (about 114 days).', 2, 'Swine'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'A castrated male bovine is called a?', 'multiple_choice', '["Bull", "Steer", "Heifer", "Calf"]', 'Steer', 'A steer is a castrated male bovine typically raised for beef production.', 1, 'Terminology'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Livestock'), 'Which USDA beef quality grade is the highest?', 'multiple_choice', '["Select", "Choice", "Prime", "Standard"]', 'Prime', 'Prime is the highest USDA quality grade, with the most marbling.', 2, 'Meat Science');

INSERT INTO questions (contest_id, question_text, question_type, options, correct_answer, explanation, difficulty, subcategory) VALUES
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Veterinary Science'), 'What is the normal resting heart rate for an adult horse?', 'multiple_choice', '["12-20 bpm", "28-44 bpm", "60-100 bpm", "100-150 bpm"]', '28-44 bpm', 'A healthy adult horse at rest has a heart rate of 28-44 beats per minute.', 2, 'Equine'),
((SELECT id FROM contests WHERE name = 'Veterinary Science'), 'Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?', 'multiple_choice', '["Vitamin A", "Vitamin C", "Vitamin D", "Vitamin K"]', 'Vitamin K', 'Vitamin K is essential for the synthesis of clotting factors in the blood.', 2, 'Nutrition'),

-- ============================================
-- SENIOR FFA QUIZ QUESTIONS (10 sample)

export interface Contest {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'CDE' | 'LDE';
  description: string;
  difficulty_level: number;
  has_quiz: boolean;
  has_video: boolean;
  has_practicum: boolean;
  time_limit_minutes: number;
  team_size: number | string;
  icon: string;
  sort_order: number;
  is_active: boolean;
}

export interface Question {
  id: string;
  contest_id: string;
  question_text: string;
  question_type: 'multiple_choice' | 'true_false' | 'fill_blank' | 'matching' | 'image_id' | 'scenario' | 'flashcard';
  options: string[] | null;
  correct_answer: string;
  explanation: string | null;
  difficulty: number;
  subcategory: string | null;
  image_url?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

export interface PracticeSession {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  contest_id: string;
  session_type?: 'practice' | 'test' | 'flashcard' | 'video';
  score: number | null;
  total_questions?: number;
  correct_answers?: number;
  time_spent_seconds: number;
  completed?: boolean;
  started_at?: string;
  completed_at: string | null;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface QuestionResponse {
  id: string;
  session_id: string;
  question_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  user_answer: string;
  is_correct: boolean;
  time_spent_seconds: number;
}

export interface UserProgress {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  contest_id: string;
  contest_name?: string;
  mastery_level: number;
  total_attempts: number;
  best_score: number;
  average_score: number;
  total_time_seconds: number;
  last_practiced_at: string | null;
  streak_days: number;
  weak_areas: string[] | null;
  strong_areas: string[] | null;
}

export interface VideoSubmission {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  contest_id: string;
  session_id: string | null;
  video_url: string | null;
  duration_seconds: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'scored' | 'error';
  overall_score: number | null;
  ai_feedback: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

<file path="utils/grading/creed-rubric.ts">
/**
 * Creed Speaking Rubric & Accuracy Engine
 * Matches official FFA Creed Speaking rubric
 */

import { FFA_CREED } from '@/lib/scoring/creed';

export interface CreedScoreSheet {
  id: string;
  contestantName: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  
  oral: {
    hesitation: number;
    pace: number;
    tone: number;
    pronunciation: number;
    volume: number;
  };
  
  nonVerbal: {
    eye_contact: number;
    mannerisms: number;
    gestures: number;
    poise: number;
  };
  
  qa: {
    details: number;
    unrehearsed: number;
    examples: number;
  };
  
  deductions: {
    time_seconds_over: number;
    missed_word_count: number;
  };
}

export interface CreedScoreWeights {
  oral: {
    hesitation: number;
    pace: number;
    tone: number;
    pronunciation: number;
    volume: number;
  };
  nonVerbal: {
    eye_contact: number;
    mannerisms: number;
    gestures: number;
    poise: number;
  };
  qa: {
    details: number;
    unrehearsed: number;
    examples: number;
  };
  deductions: {
    time_seconds_over: number;
    missed_word_count: number;
  };
}

export const CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS: CreedScoreWeights = {
  oral: {
    hesitation: 25,
    pace: 10,
    tone: 15,
    pronunciation: 15,
    volume: 15,
  },
  nonVerbal: {
    eye_contact: 15,
    mannerisms: 15,
    gestures: 15,
    poise: 15,
  },
  qa: {
    details: 20,
    unrehearsed: 20,
    examples: 20,
  },
  deductions: {
    time_seconds_over: 1,
    missed_word_count: 20,
  },
};

export const ORAL_MAX = 400;
export const NONVERBAL_MAX = 300;
export const QA_MAX = 300;
export const DEDUCTIONS_MULTIPLIER = 1;
export const MISSED_WORD_MULTIPLIER = 20;
export const MAX_SCORE = ORAL_MAX + NONVERBAL_MAX + QA_MAX;

export function createEmptyScoreSheet(contestantName: string = ''): CreedScoreSheet {
  return {
    id: `creed-${Date.now()}`,
    contestantName,
    timestamp: new Date(),
    oral: {
      hesitation: 5,
      pace: 5,
      tone: 5,
      pronunciation: 5,
      volume: 5,
    },
    nonVerbal: {
      eye_contact: 5,
      mannerisms: 5,
      gestures: 5,
      poise: 5,
    },
    qa: {
      details: 5,
      unrehearsed: 5,
      examples: 5,
    },
    deductions: {
      time_seconds_over: 0,
      missed_word_count: 0,
    },
  };
}

export function calculateCreedScore(sheet: CreedScoreSheet): {
  oral: number;
  nonVerbal: number;
  qa: number;
  deductions: number;
  total: number;
} {
  const oral = 
    (sheet.oral.hesitation * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.hesitation) +
    (sheet.oral.pace * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.pace) +
    (sheet.oral.tone * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.tone) +
    (sheet.oral.pronunciation * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.pronunciation) +
    (sheet.oral.volume * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.oral.volume);

  const nonVerbal = 
    (sheet.nonVerbal.eye_contact * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.eye_contact) +
    (sheet.nonVerbal.mannerisms * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.mannerisms) +
    (sheet.nonVerbal.gestures * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.gestures) +
    (sheet.nonVerbal.poise * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.nonVerbal.poise);

  const qa = 
    (sheet.qa.details * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.details) +
    (sheet.qa.unrehearsed * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.unrehearsed) +
    (sheet.qa.examples * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.qa.examples);

  const deductions = 
    (sheet.deductions.time_seconds_over * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.deductions.time_seconds_over) +
    (sheet.deductions.missed_word_count * CREED_SCORE_WEIGHTS.deductions.missed_word_count);

  const total = oral + nonVerbal + qa - deductions;

  return {
    oral: Math.round(oral),
    nonVerbal: Math.round(nonVerbal),
    qa: Math.round(qa),
    deductions: Math.round(deductions),
    total: Math.round(total),
  };
}

export interface WordDiff {
  word: string;
  status: 'matched' | 'missed' | 'added' | 'switched';
  position?: number;
}

export interface CreedAccuracyResult {
  missed_word_count: number;
  added_word_count: number;
  switched_count: number;
  total_errors: number;
  diff: WordDiff[];
}

function normalizeText(text: string): string[] {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[.,\/#!$%\^&\*;:{}=\-_`~()–—""'']/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(' ')
    .filter(w => w.length > 0);
}

function computeLCSMatrix(target: string[], student: string[]): number[][] {
  const m = target.length;
  const n = student.length;
  const C = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => Array(n + 1).fill(0));

  for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      if (target[i - 1] === student[j - 1]) {
        C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
      } else {
        C[i][j] = Math.max(C[i][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
      }
    }
  }
  return C;
}

function backtrackWithSwitchDetection(
  C: number[][],
  target: string[],
  student: string[]
): WordDiff[] {
  let i = target.length;
  let j = student.length;
  const diff: WordDiff[] = [];

  while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
    if (i > 0 && j > 0 && target[i - 1] === student[j - 1]) {
      diff.unshift({ word: target[i - 1], status: 'matched' });
      i--;
      j--;
    } else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || C[i][j - 1] >= C[i - 1][j])) {
      const prevMatch = i > 0 && j > 1 && target[i - 1] === student[j - 2];
      if (prevMatch && i > 0) {
        diff.unshift({ word: student[j - 1], status: 'switched' });
      } else {
        diff.unshift({ word: student[j - 1], status: 'added' });
      }
      j--;
    } else if (i > 0) {
      diff.unshift({ word: target[i - 1], status: 'missed' });
      i--;
    }
  }

  return diff;
}

export function calculateCreedAccuracy(
  studentTranscription: string,
  officialCreed: string = FFA_CREED.fullText
): CreedAccuracyResult {
  const targetWords = normalizeText(officialCreed);
  const studentWords = normalizeText(studentTranscription);

  const lcsMatrix = computeLCSMatrix(targetWords, studentWords);
  const diff = backtrackWithSwitchDetection(lcsMatrix, targetWords, studentWords);

  const missed_count = diff.filter(d => d.status === 'missed').length;
  const added_count = diff.filter(d => d.status === 'added').length;
  const switched_count = diff.filter(d => d.status === 'switched').length;

  const total_errors = missed_count + added_count + switched_count;

  return {
    missed_word_count: missed_count,
    added_word_count: added_count,
    switched_count,
    total_errors,
    diff,
  };
}

export function getDeductionFromAccuracy(accuracyResult: CreedAccuracyResult): number {
  return accuracyResult.missed_word_count * MISSED_WORD_MULTIPLIER;
}
</file>

<file path="creed.rubric.txt">
I need to upgrade the grading system for the "Creed Speaking" contest in my Ag Coach app. 

1. DATA STRUCTURE: Create a new TypeScript interface `CreedScoreSheet` that matches this official rubric exactly:
   - **Oral Communication (400 pts)**:
     - `hesitation` (Weight: 25)
     - `pace` (Weight: 10)
     - `tone` (Weight: 15)
     - `pronunciation` (Weight: 15)
     - `volume` (Weight: 15)
   - **Non-Verbal (300 pts)**:
     - `eye_contact` (Weight: 15)
     - `mannerisms` (Weight: 15)
     - `gestures` (Weight: 15)
     - `poise` (Weight: 15)
   - **Q&A (300 pts)**:
     - `details` (Weight: 20)
     - `unrehearsed` (Weight: 20)
     - `examples` (Weight: 20)
   - **Deductions**:
     - `time_seconds_over` (multiply by 1)
     - `missed_word_count` (multiply by 20)

2. ACCURACY ENGINE: Create a function `calculateCreedAccuracy` that takes the student's transcribed text and compares it against the official FFA Creed.
   - It must detect **Missed**, **Added**, or **Switched** words.
   - Return the total `missed_word_count` to automatically calculate the deduction (Errors x 20).

3. UI COMPONENT: Build a `CreedGradingScreen.tsx`.
   - Use a step-by-step wizard format (Page 1: Oral, Page 2: Non-Verbal, Page 3: Q&A).
   - Display the "Net Total Points" in real-time at the bottom.
   - Use the "Dark Obsidian" glassmorphism theme we established.

# FFA Training App - Quick Reference

## 📂 File Structure Explained

```
app/
├── (auth)/              # Login & Signup screens
│   ├── login.tsx       # Login screen
│   └── signup.tsx      # Signup screen
│
├── (tabs)/             # Main app (after login)
│   ├── index.tsx       # Dashboard/Home

│   ├── lde.tsx         # LDE list
│   └── profile.tsx     # User profile
│
└── _layout.tsx         # Root navigation

lib/
├── supabase.ts         # Database connection
└── store/
    └── auth.ts         # User authentication state

supabase/
└── migrations/
    └── 001_initial_schema.sql  # Database tables
```

## 🔑 Key Files to Know

### `lib/supabase.ts`
- Connects to your database
- Handles authentication
- Import this whenever you need database access

### `app/_layout.tsx`
- Controls navigation
- Protects routes (must be logged in)
- Redirects to login if not authenticated

### Database Migration
- Creates all tables
- Run once in Supabase SQL Editor
- Defines the entire database structure

## 💾 Database Tables

| Table | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **users** | Student & teacher accounts |
| **schools** | FFA chapters |
| **contests** | All 40 contests (29 CDEs + 11 LDEs) |
| **questions** | Practice questions for CDEs |
| **practice_sessions** | User practice history |
| **video_submissions** | LDE video recordings |
| **user_progress** | Learning analytics |
| **subscriptions** | School billing |

## 🎨 Styling Guide

```javascript
Primary Blue: #003366
Background: #f5f5f5
White: #fff
Text Dark: #333
Text Light: #666

```

### Spacing
```javascript
Small: 8
Medium: 12
Large: 16
XLarge: 20
XXLarge: 32
```

## 🔧 Common Commands

```bash
# Start development server
npm start

# Clear cache and restart
npm start -- --clear

# Run on iOS (Mac only)
npm run ios

# Run on Android
npm run android

# Install new package
npm install package-name

# Check TypeScript errors
npm run type-check

# View Supabase database
# Go to: https://supabase.com/dashboard
```

## 📝 How to Add a New Screen

1. Create file in `app/` folder:
```typescript
// app/new-screen.tsx
import { View, Text } from 'react-native';

export default function NewScreen() {
  return (
    <View>
      <Text>New Screen!</Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

2. Navigate to it:
```typescript
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';

const router = useRouter();
router.push('/new-screen');
```

## 🗄️ How to Query Database

```typescript
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

// Get all CDEs
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('contests')
  .select('*')
  .eq('category', 'CDE');

// Insert new practice session
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('practice_sessions')
  .insert({
    user_id: userId,
    contest_id: contestId,
    score: 85
  });

// Update user profile
const { error } = await supabase
  .from('users')
  .update({ name: 'New Name' })
  .eq('id', userId);
```

## 🔐 How to Get Current User

```typescript
import { useAuthStore } from '@/lib/store/auth';

function MyComponent() {
  const { user, session } = useAuthStore();
  
  // user.id - User's UUID
  // user.email - User's email
  // user.user_metadata.name - User's name
}
```

<file path="README.md">
# FFA Training App - Complete Starter Code

## 🎯 Project Overview

A comprehensive mobile training application for Texas FFA students to practice all 29 Career Development Events (CDEs) and 11 Leadership Development Events (LDEs).

**Target:** 20,000 students across 400 Texas FFA chapters
**Pricing:** $450/school/year subscription
**Tech Stack:** React Native (Expo) + Supabase + AI Services

---

## 📋 Prerequisites

Before starting, make sure you have:

- **Node.js** (v18 or higher): https://nodejs.org/
- **Git**: https://git-scm.com/
- **Expo CLI**: We'll install this together
- **Code Editor**: VS Code recommended
- **Supabase Account**: https://supabase.com (free tier)

---

## 🚀 Quick Start Guide

### Step 1: Install Dependencies

```bash
# Install Expo CLI globally
npm install -g expo-cli

# Navigate to project directory
cd ffa-training-app

# Install all dependencies
npm install
```

### Step 2: Setup Supabase

1. Go to https://supabase.com and create a free account
2. Create a new project (name it "ffa-training-app")
3. Wait for database to provision (~2 minutes)
4. Go to Project Settings → API
5. Copy your `Project URL` and `anon public` key

### Step 3: Configure Environment

```bash
# Copy the example environment file
cp .env.example .env

# Edit .env and add your Supabase credentials:
# EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your-project-url
# EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key
```

### Step 4: Setup Database Schema

```bash
# This will create all necessary tables
npm run db:setup
```

### Step 5: Start Development

```bash
# Start the Expo development server
npm start

# Then:
# - Press 'i' for iOS simulator (Mac only)
# - Press 'a' for Android emulator
# - Scan QR code with Expo Go app on your phone
```

---

## 📁 Project Structure

```
ffa-training-app/
├── app/                          # Main application code (Expo Router)
│   ├── (auth)/                  # Authentication screens
│   │   ├── login.tsx

│   ├── contest/                 # Individual contest screens
│   │   ├── [id].tsx            # Dynamic contest screen
│   │   └── _layout.tsx
│   └── _layout.tsx             # Root layout
│
├── components/                  # Reusable UI components
│   ├── ui/                     # Basic UI elements
│   │   ├── Button.tsx
│   │   ├── Card.tsx
```

```bash
# Install Homebrew if you don't have it
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

# Install Node.js
brew install node
```

**Windows:**
- Download and install from: https://nodejs.org/
- Choose "LTS" version (recommended)

**Verify installation:**
```bash
node --version
# Should show v18.x.x or higher

npm --version
# Should show 9.x.x or higher
```

### Step 2: Download the Project

You'll need to download the complete project folder. I've created all the files, but you'll need to:

1. Copy the entire `ffa-training-app` folder to your computer
2. Open Terminal (Mac) or Command Prompt (Windows)
3. Navigate to the project:

```bash
cd path/to/ffa-training-app
```

### Step 3: Install Dependencies

```bash
# Install all project dependencies
npm install

# This will take 2-5 minutes
# You should see a progress bar
```

### Step 4: Setup Supabase (Your Backend)

1. **Create Supabase Account**
   - Go to https://supabase.com
   - Click "Start your project"
   - Sign up with your email

2. **Create a New Project**
   - Click "New Project"
   - Name: `ffa-training-app`
   - Database Password: Choose a strong password (save it!)
   - Region: Choose closest to you
   - Click "Create new project"
   - Wait 2-3 minutes for database to provision

3. **Get Your API Keys**
   - In Supabase dashboard, click "Settings" (gear icon)
   - Click "API" in the sidebar
   - You'll see two important values:
     - `Project URL` (looks like: https://xxxxx.supabase.co)
     - `anon public` key (long string starting with "eyJ...")
   - **Keep this page open!**

4. **Setup Database Schema**
   - In Supabase dashboard, click "SQL Editor"
   - Click "New Query"
   - Copy the ENTIRE contents of `supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql`
   - Paste into the SQL Editor
   - Click "Run" button
   - You should see "Success. No rows returned"
   - Click "Tables" in sidebar - you should see 9 tables!

### Step 5: Configure Environment Variables

```bash
# Copy the example environment file
cp .env.example .env

# Open .env file in a text editor
# On Mac:
open .env

# On Windows:
notepad .env
```

**Edit the .env file** and add your Supabase credentials:

```env
EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project-id.supabase.co
EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key-here

# Leave these for now (we'll add later)
OPENAI_API_KEY=
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=

EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development
EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_AI_SCORING=false
EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_VIDEO_ANALYSIS=false
EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_OFFLINE_MODE=true
```

**Save the file!**

### Step 6: Start the App!

```bash
# Start the Expo development server
npx expo start

# You should see a QR code and menu options
```

You'll see something like:

```
› Metro waiting on exp://192.168.1.x:8081
› Scan the QR code above to open in Expo Go

› Press a │ open Android
› Press i │ open iOS simulator
› Press w │ open web
```

### Step 7: Run on Your Phone (Easiest!)

**For iPhone:**
1. Download "Expo Go" from App Store
2. Open Expo Go app
3. Tap "Scan QR Code"
4. Scan the QR code in your terminal
5. App will load on your phone!

**For Android:**
1. Download "Expo Go" from Play Store
2. Open Expo Go app
3. Tap "Scan QR Code"
4. Scan the QR code in your terminal
5. App will load on your phone!

### Step 8: Create Your First Account

1. App should open to login screen
2. Tap "Sign Up"
3. Enter:
   - Name: Your name
   - Email: your.email@example.com
   - Password: at least 6 characters
4. Tap "Create Account"
5. Go back and login!

---

## 🎯 What You'll See

After login, you'll see:

1. **Dashboard** - Your stats (currently 0 because you haven't practiced yet)
2. **CDEs Tab** - List of all 29 Career Development Events
3. **LDEs Tab** - List of all 11 Leadership Development Events
4. **Profile Tab** - Your account info and settings

---

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Problem: "Cannot find module..."

**Solution:**
```bash
# Delete node_modules and reinstall
rm -rf node_modules
npm install
```

### Problem: "Network request failed" when logging in

**Solution:**
- Check your .env file has correct Supabase URL and key
- Make sure you ran the database migration SQL
- Try restarting the Expo server:
  - Press `Ctrl+C` in terminal
  - Run `npx expo start` again

### Problem: "Module not found: react-native-url-polyfill"

**Solution:**
```bash
npm install react-native-url-polyfill
```

### Problem: Database tables don't exist

**Solution:**
- Go back to Supabase SQL Editor
- Re-run the migration SQL from Step 4
- Check "Tables" sidebar - should see 9 tables

### Problem: Can't see QR code (it's cut off)

**Solution:**
- Make terminal window bigger
- Or use direct URL: Copy the exp://... URL
- Type it in Expo Go app manually

---

## 📱 Testing Your App

Try these things to make sure everything works:

1. ✅ Sign up with a new account
2. ✅ Log out
3. ✅ Log back in
4. ✅ View CDE list (should show 29 contests)
5. ✅ View LDE list (should show 11 contests)
6. ✅ Check profile page
7. ✅ Log out

---

## 🎓 Next Steps

Once your app is running, we can:

1. **Build the Creed Speaking feature** (video recording + AI scoring)
2. **Add CDE question banks** (practice quizzes)
3. **Create teacher dashboard** (analytics)
4. **Add more LDE features** (Job Interview, etc.)

---

## 💡 Tips

### Keep the Expo server running
- Don't close the terminal while testing
- The app reloads automatically when you make changes
- Shake your phone to open developer menu

### Check database in Supabase
- Use "Table Editor" to view data
- You can manually add test data
- Use "Authentication" to see registered users

### Code Changes
- Edit any `.tsx` file in `app/` folder
- Save the file
- App reloads automatically on your phone!

---

## 🆘 Need Help?

If you get stuck:

1. **Read the error message carefully** - it usually tells you what's wrong
2. **Check the terminal** - errors show here first
3. **Ask me!** - I can help debug any issue

---

## 🎉 Ready to Go!

If you've made it this far and your app is running, congratulations! 🎊

You now have:
- ✅ A working React Native mobile app
- ✅ User authentication system
- ✅ Database with all FFA contests
- ✅ Foundation to build all features

**Let me know when you're ready to build the Creed Speaking feature!** 🚀
</file>

<file path="supabase_schema.sql">
-- Create Classrooms Table
create table if not exists public.classrooms (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  teacher_id uuid references auth.users(id) not null,
  name text not null,
  description text,
  join_code text unique,
  google_classroom_id text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- Create Classroom Students (Join Table)
create table if not exists public.classroom_students (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  classroom_id uuid references public.classrooms(id) on delete cascade not null,
  student_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade not null,
  joined_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  status text default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'archived', 'pending'))
);

-- Create Subscriptions Table
create table if not exists public.subscriptions (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users(id) not null,
  plan_id text not null,
  status text not null check (status in ('active', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'trialing')),
  current_period_end timestamp with time zone not null,
  stripe_customer_id text,
  stripe_subscription_id text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- Set Row Level Security (RLS) policies
alter table public.classrooms enable row level security;
alter table public.classroom_students enable row level security;
alter table public.subscriptions enable row level security;

-- Policies for Classrooms
create policy "Teachers can view their own classrooms"
  on public.classrooms for select
  using (auth.uid() = teacher_id);

create policy "Teachers can insert their own classrooms"
  on public.classrooms for insert
  with check (auth.uid() = teacher_id);

create policy "Teachers can update their own classrooms"
  on public.classrooms for update
  using (auth.uid() = teacher_id);

create policy "Teachers can delete their own classrooms"
  on public.classrooms for delete
  using (auth.uid() = teacher_id);

-- Policies for Classroom Students
create policy "Teachers can view students in their classrooms"
  on public.classroom_students for select
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.classrooms
      where classrooms.id = classroom_students.classroom_id
      and classrooms.teacher_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

create policy "Students can view their own classroom memberships"
  on public.classroom_students for select
  using (auth.uid() = student_id);

-- Policies for Subscriptions
create policy "Users can view their own subscription"
  on public.subscriptions for select
  using (auth.uid() = user_id);
</file>

<file path="test-babel-deps.js">
const pkg = require('./node_modules/@babel/core/package.json');
const deps = Object.keys(pkg.dependencies);

console.log('Testing dependencies of @babel/core...');
for (const dep of deps) {
  try {
    console.log(`Requiring ${dep}...`);
    require(dep);
    console.log(`${dep} loaded.`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`Failed to load ${dep}:`, e.message);
  }
}
console.log('All dependencies tested.');
</file>

<file path="test-babel-isolated.js">
const babel = require('@babel/core');
console.log('Starting isolated Babel parse...');
try {
  const result = babel.parseSync('const x = 1;', {
    configFile: false,
    babelrc: false,
    browserslistConfigFile: false,
  });
  console.log('Isolated Parse successful!');
} catch (e) {
  console.error('Isolated Parse failed:', e);
}
</file>
