<file path="test-babel.js">
const babel = require('@babel/core');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const code = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'app/index.tsx'), 'utf8');
console.log('Starting Babel transformation...');
try {
  const result = babel.transformSync(code, {
    presets: ['babel-preset-expo'],
    plugins: ['react-native-reanimated/plugin'],
    filename: 'app/index.tsx',
    configFile: path.join(__dirname, 'babel.config.js'),
  });
  console.log('Transformation successful!');
} catch (e) {
  console.error('Transformation failed:', e);
}
</file>

<file path="test-chapter-prompt.ts">
import { MOTIONS, MAIN_MOTIONS } from './lib/data/chapter-conducting';

console.log(`Total Motions: ${MOTIONS.length}`);
console.log(`Total Main Motions: ${MAIN_MOTIONS.length}`);

function testGen(division: 'greenhand' | 'senior') {
    const allowed = MOTIONS.filter(m => m.requiredIn.includes(division) && m.class !== 'Main');
    console.log(`\nDivision: ${division}`);
    console.log(`Allowed Motions Pool: ${allowed.length}`);
    
    if (allowed.length < 4) {
        console.error("ERROR: Not enough motions for this division!");
    } else {
        console.log("Pool size OK.");
    }

    const shuffled = [...allowed].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const selected = shuffled.slice(0, 4);
    
    console.log("Sample Set:");
    selected.forEach(m => console.log(`- ${m.name} (${m.class})`));
}

testGen('greenhand');
testGen('senior');
</file>

<file path="verify_store.ts">
import { useHistoryStore } from './lib/store/history';

// Mock AsyncStorage since we are in a node environment for this test script
// In a real app, this is handled by the React Native environment or Jest setup
const mockStorage = new Map<string, string>();
const mockAsyncStorage = {
  getItem: async (key: string) => mockStorage.get(key) || null,
  setItem: async (key: string, value: string) => mockStorage.set(key, value),
  removeItem: async (key: string) => mockStorage.delete(key),
};

// We need to patch the storage mechanism for this test since we can't easily mock the import 
// inside the store file without a bundler test runner. 
// However, we can test the *logic* of the store if we assume the persist middleware works 
// or if we rely on the in-memory state which Zustand maintains well.

async function verifyHistoryStore() {
  console.log("Starting History Store Verification...");

  const store = useHistoryStore.getState();
  
  // 1. Initial State
  console.log("Checking initial state...");
  if (store.results.length !== 0) {
      console.error("FAIL: Initial results should be empty");
  } else {
      console.log("PASS: Initial results are empty");
  }

  // 2. Add a result
  console.log("Adding a test result...");
  const testResult = {
      type: 'job-interview' as const,
      score: 85,
      maxScore: 100,
      details: { feedback: "Good job" },
      metadata: { mode: 'phone' }
  };
  
  store.addResult(testResult);

  // 3. Verify addition
  const results = useHistoryStore.getState().results;
  if (results.length === 1 && results[0].score === 85 && results[0].type === 'job-interview') {
      console.log("PASS: Result added successfully");
  } else {
      console.error("FAIL: Result not added correctly", results);
  }

  // 4. Verify ID and Date generation
  if (results[0].id && results[0].date) {
      console.log("PASS: ID and Date automatically generated");
  } else {
      console.error("FAIL: ID or Date missing");
  }

  // 5. Get by type
  console.log("Testing getResultsByType...");
  const interviewResults = useHistoryStore.getState().getResultsByType('job-interview');
  const quizResults = useHistoryStore.getState().getResultsByType('greenhand-quiz');
  
  if (interviewResults.length === 1 && quizResults.length === 0) {
      console.log("PASS: Filtering by type works");
  } else {
      console.error("FAIL: Filtering failed", { interview: interviewResults.length, quiz: quizResults.length });
  }

  // 6. Clear history
  console.log("Testing clearHistory...");
  useHistoryStore.getState().clearHistory();
  if (useHistoryStore.getState().results.length === 0) {
      console.log("PASS: History cleared successfully");
  } else {
      console.error("FAIL: History not cleared");
  }
  
  console.log("Verification Complete.");
}
